title: Account Executive, Commercial (Nagoya)
description:
Headquarters:  Remote - Japan
 

  Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform. 
 We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.    役割  
 セールスと市場開拓（Go-to-Market）部門の一員としてご活躍いただける、アカウント エグゼクティブを募集しています。この職務は日本を拠点とし、リージョナルディレクター直属となります。 
 世界中のプロフェッショナルと連携しながら、お客様の期待を超える価値提供を実現し、安全でクラウドを前提としたデジタルの未来を推進していくポジションです。
また、Customer Success／Enablement／Architecture各チームと密に協働し、Zscalerが実現するクラウド・トランスフォーメーションの力を提案・体現することで、クラウドセキュリティ分野のグローバルリーダーとしての当社のポジションをさらに強固なものにしていただきます。 
  業務内容 (役割と期待されること)  
 ・顧客の経営幹部を含む主要な関係者との信頼関係を構築すること。 
 ・顧客の目標に基づく長期的なアカウント戦略を設計すること。 
 ・社内関係者との連携による顧客ニーズを反映したアカウント計画を策定すること。 
 ・ 顧客のビジネスを理解し、具体的な目標を掲げ、Zscalerソリューションを提案し、信頼できるパートナーとしての役割を発揮すること。 
  求める人物像 (成功のための資質)  
  不確実さを力に変えられる人 ：正解が見えない状況でも前に進むことが出来る方。歩きながら道をつくることに前向きで、曖昧さを「障害」ではなく、価値あるものを生み出すための素材として捉えられる方。 
  オーナーシップを持って動ける人 ：ミッションへの熱意が行動力につながり、自ら意思決定し、最後までやり切ることが出来る方。成果に本気で向き合うからこそ誠実にふるまい、戦略の議論から現場の実行まで、必要に応じて自在に行き来できる方。 
  課題解決を楽しめる人 ：難しい課題ほど熱意をもって取り組める方。課題に集中し、解決までやり抜くことで最大のインパクトを生み出せると知っている方。 
  信頼をつくるコラボレーター ：自分の成功だけでなく、チームの成功にコミットできる方。明確さと敬意のある率直さを大切にし、フィードバックを「与える・受け取る」を継続できる方。これこそが最高のチームワークであり、信頼を最速で築く方法だと理解している方。

 学び続ける人 ：学び続ける姿勢を持っている方。真の成長志向を持ち、自己啓発に情熱を注ぎ、より良いパートナー、より強力なチームメイトになるために積極的にフィードバックを求める方。仕事を心から楽しみ、目的意識を持って取り組める方。 
  応募資格(必須条件)  
 ・ソフトウェアまたはセキュリティ業界における5年以上のフルサイクルセールス経験 
 ・学士号またはそれに相当する実務経験 
 ・法人顧客との関与および経営幹部への販売を含む戦略的営業の経験 
 ・ビジネスレベルの日本語力(読み書き、会話) 
 ・AI／機械学習（ML）技術の基礎的な理解を有し、自身の担当領域における成果を最大化するために、AIを活用したソリューションの活用・提案・セキュリティ確保のいずれかに携わった経験を有すること 
  他の候補者との差別化要素(歓迎条件)  
 ・既存顧客や見込み客との確立されたネットワークを活かし、持続的な成果を生み出すスキル 
 ・顧客の目的や課題を深く理解し、テクノロジーによるデジタルトランスフォーメーションの促進についての深い理解 
 ・戦略的な営業計画に関する知識と新規顧客を獲得した実績

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Headquarters:  Hurst, TX
      URL:   http://bbemarketing.com/ 
 

 We’re looking for a highly driven, organized, and persistent  Business Development Manager  to help us build and maintain relationships with representatives across the entertainment industry, including music, sports, film/TV, digital media, and more. 
 This is an  outbound-heavy role . A large part of the job involves researching contacts, sending high-quality emails, following up consistently, tracking conversations in HubSpot, and working toward clear outreach and response goals. 
 This is not a passive data-entry role. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable initiating conversations, managing a large pipeline of contacts, and staying disciplined with follow-ups even when people don’t respond right away.

 
  What You’ll Be Doing:  
 
  Conduct high-volume outreach  to entertainment industry representatives through email and social media. 
  Write polished outreach emails  that are clear, professional, natural, and personalized when needed. 
  Follow up consistently  with contacts who have not responded and keep conversations moving over time. 
  Manage a large contact pipeline  and make sure outreach, follow-ups, notes, and next steps are accurately tracked. 
  Use HubSpot or similar CRM tools  to organize contacts, tasks, follow-ups, communication history, and outreach progress. 
  Work toward measurable goals  around outreach volume, follow-ups, responses, verified updates, and relationship-building activity. 
  Build long-term industry relationships  so representatives are more likely to respond, share updates, and view us as a reliable industry resource. 
  Think creatively about outreach  and develop new ways to improve response rates, keep relationships warm, and strengthen our network.

 
 
  Who We’re Looking For:  
 
  Excellent written English —you’re comfortable writing professional messages and outreach emails with clarity and polish. Must have strong English writing and speaking abilities. 
  Extremely organized —you can juggle many accounts and keep your outreach and follow-ups on track. 
  Self-motivated and driven —you take initiative, meet goals, and stay focused without constant supervision. 
  Relationship-minded —you enjoy connecting with people and maintaining positive, long-term communication. 
 Familiarity with CRM tools like  HubSpot  is a plus. 
  Spanish fluency is a plus , but not required. 
 A genuine  interest in the entertainment industry —especially music, sports, film/TV, or digital media—will help you succeed in this role. 
 

  To apply:   https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bbe-marketing-inc-business-development-manager-1

title: Data Engineer / Scientist – Multimodal Clinical Data Integration & AI (m/f/d)
description:
About aiPTO

aiPTO is a TechBio startup spun off from the German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ), taking on one of medicine's hardest problems: brain cancer. We are building a disruptive approach — pairing next-generation patient-derived living tumor with fit-for-purpose virtual-tumor AI models. By recreating a patient's tumor biology in vitro and decoding it in silico, we aim to revolutionize brain cancer drug discovery and precision medicine. More details can be found on our publications (Individualized patient tumor organoids faithfully preserve human brain tumor ecosystems and predict patient response to therapy, DELPHAI predicts heterogeneous perturbation responses with learned single-cell fitness) and LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/company/aipto/).

The project

aiPTO has been selected as the data and AI partner of a newly funded Horizon Europe consortium that unites world-class neuro-oncologists, pathologists and drug-discovery pioneers across Europe. Together we are generating patient profiles of unprecedented depth: multi-omics, high-resolution digital pathology, 3D imaging and longitudinal clinical records, alongside single-cell drug-perturbation data from patient-derived organoids.

As the first member of our Heidelberg hub, you will build the data engine that turns these massive, disparate streams into AI-ready data atlas — the foundation for virtual tumor models and agentic systems designed to predict patient-specific drug response, decode resistance and reveal drug mechanisms.

What you will do

  • Architect the scientific data engine: design, build and scale the infrastructure that unifies multi-omics, spatial transcriptomics, digital pathology, radiological imaging and clinical data

  • Make data AI-ready: harmonise and standardise multimodal datasets for deep-learning models and agentic workflows, working hand-in-hand with our machine-learning and computer-vision scientists

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

 

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

 

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

 

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

 

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

 

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

title: Containerization & Virtualisation Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

This is a general selection process for software engineers focused on virtualisation and container technology - from the kernel through userspace. Apply here if you are an exceptional Go, Rust, or C/C++ software engineer and want to work on next-generation open source VMM or container technology, or related open source networking and storage.

Container, virtualisation and cloud infrastructure have become essentials of modern software deployments. We invest in open source related to application isolation, workload orchestration, system or OCI containers, micro service architecture or cloud infrastructure.

Here are some examples of projects under way at Canonical.

RustVMM has great potential as a new hypervisor for Linux. We are building a team to work on this, with an emphasis on performance, security and operability. Work in Rust and bring your expert knowledge of VMM and related kernel networking and storage capabilities.

Docker images are easy to make and publish on Docker Hub and other registries, but the quality, consistency and security maintenance of those images is broadly very poor. Canonical is in a good position to publish a portfolio of outstanding Docker images. Our Rockcraft team is designing and implementing an elevated Docker image experience for the open source community.

LXD is a modern system container and virtual machine manager that is widely used on Ubuntu, ChromeOS and other Linux platforms. LXD engineering spans the entire software stack from low-level kernel work on namespaces, confinement, security, filesystems, VMMs and networking, to the high level management REST API and CLI.

Members of the Kubernetes product team build MicroK8s for on-rails K8s, and Charmed Kubernetes for more sophisticated integration. We work on K8s itself and on the operations tooling around it.

The OpenStack team deliver Charmed OpenStack, OVN / OVS and Ceph. This work brings cloud platform technologies to large-scale computing environments.

title: Systemadministrator Linux (m/w/d) | Hybrid in Freiburg🌄
description:
Du willst Systemadministrator Linux nicht einfach administrieren, sondern selbst entscheiden, wie eine moderne Open Source IT Landschaft aussehen soll?🚀

Dann bekommst du hier den Freiraum dafür. Unser Kunde ist ein wachsendes, familiengeführtes Technologieunternehmen aus Freiburg, das Hard- und Softwarelösungen für die industrielle Bildverarbeitung und Automation entwickelt. Die eigenen Systeme kommen heute in mehr als 15.000 Maschinen weltweit zum Einsatz.

Als Systemadministrator Linux verstärkst du einen bewusst klein gehaltenen IT Bereich und bekommst entsprechend viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Statt starrer Konzernstrukturen erwarten dich kurze Wege, direkter Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung und die Möglichkeit, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten. 

Der technologische Fokus liegt konsequent auf Linux und Open Source. In den kommenden Jahren stehen spannende Themen an: bestehende Anwendungen sollen auf Open Source Alternativen migriert, Cyber Security und Resilience weiter ausgebaut und ein eigener interner Linux basierter KI Server kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden. 

Wenn Linux dein fachliches Zuhause ist und du lieber neue Lösungen entwickelst, als nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen zu halten, kannst du hier eine IT Landschaft langfristig mitprägen. 

Deine Benefits

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Entscheide aktiv mit, wie sich die interne IT in den Bereichen Linux, Open Source, Cyber Security, Resilience und Automatisierung

description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Science Writer, Nebius Academy (Contract) based in Germany.

As an AI Science Writer, you’ll translate cutting-edge AI and machine learning research into accurate, engaging, and accessible stories.
You’ll work at the intersection of scientific research, technical communication, journalism, and multimedia storytelling.
A core part of the role will be reviewing new models, architectures, papers, and research to identify what is genuinely novel and important.
You’ll turn complex technical concepts into compelling written and visual narratives through articles, explainers, diagrams, charts, and other formats.
You’ll engage directly with researchers, engineers, founders, and scientific leaders to investigate ideas and verify technical claims.
The role also offers opportunities to cover major conferences, host research-focused events, and experiment with AI-assisted editorial workflows.
This is an ongoing contract position with a fixed monthly retainer, flexibility, and potential opportunities for longer-term career growth.


Accountabilities
  • Produce accurate and engaging scientific and technical reviews covering new AI models, architectures, research papers, internal research, and emerging trends.
  • Analyze technical papers and research findings to identify meaningful innovations, understand methodologies, evaluate limitations, and communicate their significance.
  • Transform complex model architectures and technical concepts into clear visual narratives, including infographics, diagrams, charts, and other multimedia elements.
  • Develop written content across multiple formats, including analytical reports, long-form features, interviews, technical explainers, newsletters, webinar scripts, and social media

Key Responsibilities:       • 고객에게 스타일링 조언, 제품 지식 및 매장 경험을 통해 높은 수준의 서비스를 제공   • 판매 정보를 분석하고 매장 관리자와 협력하여 부서 판매 성과를 극대화   • 판매 보조원 팀을 이끌어 우수한 서비스 기준을 달성   • 채용을 지원하고 신규 직원의 오리엔테이션 및 교육이 잘 이루어지도록 관리   • 매장 관리자와 함께 미래의 인재를 발굴하고 그들의 성장을 지원하는 개발 계획을 수립   • 매장 운영을 감독   • 브랜드 Ambassador로서 고객에게 최고의 경험을 제공   • 매장 관리자의 부재 시 그들의 역할을 대신 수행       자격 요건    Department Manager 역할을 위해, 우리는 팀워크, 기업가 정신, 그리고 지속적인 개선의 정신을 구현하는 사람들을 찾고 있습니다. 협력과 공동의 성과를 촉진하는 환경을 조성하는 것이 중요합니다. 변화하는 상황과 고객의 선호에 유연하게 적응하는 낙관적인 시각과 유연성은 우리가 중요하게 여기는 핵심 속성입니다. 또한, 비즈니스와 고객의 요구를 효율적이고 효과적으로 해결할 수 있는 독립적인 주도력을 가지고 있습니다.      Knowledge      • 훌륭한 고객 경험을 만드는 요소를 이해하고 있음   • 이전 소매업 또는 고객을 직접 대하는 경험   • 한국어에 능통      Motivation       • 긍정적인 작업 환경을 조성하고 팀을 이끄는 것을 즐김   • 결과 중심적이며 멀티태스킹을 즐김   • 자신과 다른 사람들의 발전을 즐김      Behaviour       • 잘 기능하는 팀을 구축하는 데 기여하고 다양한 관점을 수용함   • 최신 트렌드/고객의 요구/경쟁자의 활동에 대해 지속적으로 업데이트하고 판매 및 고객 경험을 극대화하는 아이디어를 제시   • 건설적인 피드백을 통해 다른 사람들의 성장을 지원   • 자신에 대해 인식하고, 자신의 행동이 결과를 초래함을 이해하며, 상호작용에서 존중하고 비판하지 않음   • 주도적으로 행동하고 설정된 업무를 완료하며 고객에게 훌륭한 경험을 제공하는 책임을 짐   • 효율적으로 우선순위를 설정하고 갑작스러운 변화에 적응할 수 있음   • 명확하고 간결하게 소통하며 다른 관점을 적극적으로 경청   • 일상적인 프로세스를 개선할 기회를 찾아냄      Past Achievements       • 다른 사람을 통해 매출을 증대시킨 경험           제출 서류     이력서(CV) 및 자기소개서(Cover Letter)를 함께 제출해주시기 바랍니다.        추가 정보     &Other Stories의 팀원은 다음의 혜택을 받고 있습니다.       25 % 직원 할인 (Online + 자매 브랜드)  HIP (장기근속 인센티브 프로그램)  연 2회 의복지원금  직원 건강 검진  건강 지원금  경조사 휴가와 지원금  연차 / 병가  장기 근속자 복리후생(Long service Contribution)  내부 career 승진 및 지원 기회 제공         Inclusion & Diversity       H&M Group 은 포용성과 다양성을 바탕으로 공정한 근무 환경을 만들어가고 있습니다.  우리는 서로 다른 배경과 경험, 관점을 가진 사람들이 함께할 때 더 강한 팀이 된다고 믿습니다. 이러한 다양성은 창의적인 사고를 이끌고, 더 나은 문제 해결을 가능하게 하며, 전 세계의 동료와 고객과 깊이 있는 관계를 형성하는 데 기여합니다.    H&M 그룹은 채용 전 과정에서 다양성을 중요하게 생각하며, 우리가 속한 지역 사회의 가치를 반영하는 인재들과 함께 성장하고자 합니다.

title: Global Key Account Manager (f/m/d)
description: Purpose of Position   Our Account Management Team is looking for a new Global Key Account Manager to come and work on the affiliate programmes for advertisers ranging across different verticals including retail and travel. This is an excellent opportunity to develop your analytical and strategic skills. You will have exposure to large brands and receive in-depth training across multiple subjects with the opportunity to collaborate within a team as well as internationally on wider projects.  The role will involve bringing innovation and strategy to all campaigns and maintaining engagement with clients and publishers alike in order to deliver sophisticated results. As a result, this role is perfect for anyone looking to push forward their career within a fast-paced and dynamic industry.  We value collaboration and team engagement. Work location: Hybrid in Stockholm (3 days per week)  Ideal start date: November 1st or 15th, 2026     Key Tasks   You are responsible for the growth and service level delivery of an account or portfolio of accounts.    Manage accounts with specific features (i.e: Core, premium or bespoke) with a focus on affiliate programs for industry advertisers (sectors vary).   Have a proactive consultative selling approach to achieve growth within your portfolio, by building a solid relationship with clients  Manages client related budgets & regularly discuss face-to-face with clients based on SLA. title: Asiakkuuspäällikkö
description: Asiakkuuspäällikkö – Asiakkuuksien kehittäjä ja myynnin kumppani      Etsimme tiimiimme tavoitteellista ja asiakaslähtöistä Asiakkuuspäällikköä vahvistamaan myynnin kasvua, asiakkuuksien kehittämistä ja kaupallista suorituskykyä. Tässä roolissa pääset yhdistämään asiakkuusjohtamisen, tarjouslaskennan, liiketoiminta-analytiikan sekä yhteistyön asiakkaiden ja sisäisten sidosryhmien kanssa.        Asiakkuuspäällikkönä vastaat nimettyjen asiakkuuksien kasvusta ja kehittämisestä, lisämyynnistä, kannattavuudesta ja uusien liiketoimintamahdollisuuksien tunnistamisesta. Toimit tiiviissä yhteistyössä asiakkaiden, tuotannon sekä muiden liiketoiminnan avainhenkilöiden kanssa varmistaen asiakkaiden tarpeita vastaavat ratkaisut ja pitkäjänteisen yhteistyön.        Päästäksesi tavoitteisiisi sinun tulee:      Vahvistaa asiakkuuksien kokonaisvaltaista kehittämistä ja asiakassuhteita     Kehittää myynnin ja tarjoustoiminnan yhteistyötä sekä tarjouslaskentaa sovittujen parametrien mukaisesti     Tunnistaa asiakkaiden liiketoimintatarpeita ja rakentaa ratkaisuja yhteistyössä sisäisten asiantuntijoiden kanssa     Vastata sopimusneuvotteluista sekä kaupallisten ehtojen valmistelusta ja läpiviennistä     Seurata asiakkuuksien kannattavuutta, kasvua ja asiakastyytyväisyyttä sekä käynnistää kehitystoimenpiteitä     Analysoida myyntidataa, markkinatrendejä ja kilpailutilanteita sekä laatia toimenpide-ehdotuksia     Laatia asiakkuuskohtaisia suunnitelmia sekä koordinoida ja raportoida niiden toteutusta     Tukea uusasiakashankintaa sekä edistää oman vastuualueesi myynnillistä kasvua          Odotamme sinulta      Toivomme, että sinulla on vahva kaupallinen ote, kyky rakentaa pitkäjänteisiä asiakassuhteita sekä ymmärrystä logistiikkaliiketoiminnasta. Olet oma-aloitteinen, tuloshakuinen ja osaat hyödyntää dataa päätöksenteon tukena.        Edellytämme:      Soveltuvaa kaupallisen tai logistiikka-alan koulutusta tai vähintään viiden vuoden kokemusta vastaavista myynti- tai asiakkuudenhallinnan tehtävistä     Kokemusta asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä, myynnistä tai asiakkuusjohtamisesta     Hyviä neuvottelu-, vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja     Ymmärrystä kuljetusratkaisuista, logistiikkapalveluista ja niiden kustannusrakenteista     Kykyä analysoida liiketoimintaa, tunnistaa asiakaspotentiaalia ja tehdä johtopäätöksiä datan pohjalta     Hyviä organisointi- ja koordinointitaitoja sekä kykyä hallita useita kokonaisuuksia samanaikaisesti     Oma-aloitteisuutta ja kykyä viedä asioita itsenäisesti eteenpäin     Sujuvia järjestelmä- ja raportointityökaluvalmiuksia     Englannin kielen sujuvan suullisen ja kirjallisen taidon     Vahvan Excel-osaamisen sekä ERP- ja CRM-järjestelmien tuntemuksen          Tarjoamme sinulle:        Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa myynnin kasvuun ja asiakaskokemukseen sekä keskeisen roolin yrityksemme tärkeimpien asiakkuuksien kehittämisessä     Monipuolisen tehtävänkuvan, jossa yhdistyvät myynti, analytiikka ja asiakkuusjohtaminen     Mahdollisuuden kehi

title: E-commerce Customer Experience Manager
description: Hey there!     We’re looking for a proactive  E-commerce Customer Experience Manager  to join Sereni Parenting.  You’ll manage our customer support team, monitor performance, investigate recurring customer issues, and improve the systems behind customer service.     During your first 2 weeks, you’ll work closely with the founder to review the current customer support operation, investigate issues, improve processes, and build the systems you’ll eventually take ownership of.      Who We Are   Sereni Parenting is a growing e-commerce brand creating products that support children and families.  Our mission is to make everyday life easier for families raising children with autism, ADHD, and sensory needs. We want to build a brand parents genuinely trust and a customer experience that makes them feel supported, understood, and cared for.      Key Responsibilities    Manage and support our existing customer service team.  Monitor response times, resolution times, refunds, complaints, reviews, and other key support metrics.  Investigate recurring customer issues and find the root cause.  Improve SOPs, canned responses, escalation rules, and support processes.  Review tickets and make sure customers are receiving accurate and helpful responses.  Handle difficult customer escalations.  Identify issues like shipping delays, stock problems, or fulfilment issues before they create more complaints.  Report key customer service problems to the founders and recommend what should be fixed.  Help improve refunds, returns, and complaint handling.  Use AI and automation to improve reporting, monitoring, and repetitive support tasks.  Work with fulfilment partners and internal team members when customer problems are caused by operational issues.       Required Experience    2+ years in customer service, customer experience, or e-commerce support.  Expeirence with customer service metrics and reports.  Experience creating or improving SOPs, canned responses, and support processes.  Experience managing or supervising a customer support team.  Experience working in e-commerce.  Experience with  Shopify .  Experience with  Commslayer, Gorgias, Zendesk, or a similar customer support platform .  Experience handling refunds, returns, order tracking, and customer escalations.  Experience using  AI tools .       Role Details    Full-time  Remote  Monday–Friday  Long-term position  Open to candidates in Malaysia or the Philippines  Salary based on experience       Why You’ll Love Working With Us     Fully Remote & Flexible:  Work from home with flexible hours.   Dynamic Environment:  Work with a fast-moving team that values innovation and improvement.   Career Growth:  Take on more responsibility and grow into more senior roles over time.   Real Impact:  Your work will directly influence the customer experience and growth of the company.   Competitive Compensation:  Salary based on experience and capability.

title: Consumer Engagement Manager
description: Summary   We are looking for a  Consumer Engagement Manager  to lead initiatives that strengthen the relationship between the brand and its consumers across the customer journey.  This role sits at the intersection of  CRM, digital marketing, customer experience and community engagement . Rather than relying heavily on traditional paid advertising, the focus is on building meaningful consumer touchpoints through  organic digital channels, customer data, content, events, referrals and lifecycle engagement .  You will be responsible for understanding consumer behaviour, identifying engagement opportunities and creating initiatives that move consumers from awareness and consideration through to purchase, ownership and advocacy.      Key Responsibilities    Develop and execute  consumer engagement and CRM strategies  across the customer journey.  Drive organic engagement through social media, digital platforms, content and community initiatives.  Analyse consumer behaviour and identify opportunities to improve  engagement, conversion and retention .  Develop customer lifecycle, referral and advocacy programmes.  Work closely with Sales, Retail and Customer Experience teams to improve consumer touchpoints.  Monitor engagement and customer data to identify trends and drive improvements.  Support consumer events, experiences and community-building initiatives.       Requirements    Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or related field.   4–7 years of experience  in CRM, consumer marketing, digital marketing, customer experience or related areas.  Strong understanding of  customer journey, consumer behaviour and organic digital marketing .  Experience working with customer data/CRM systems and developing engagement initiatives.  Strong communication, analytical and project management skills.  Proactive, creative and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.    Ideal background:  CRM, Lifecycle Marketing, Consumer Marketing, Digital Marketing, Customer Experience, Community or Brand Engagement.     For Faster Response, Kindly  email to alfred.lim@jobscoper.com.my  or  Whatsapp 018 403 2862

title: Manager, Consumer Moments /Membership Korea
description: Who You'll Work With   This role reports to the Director, Digital Owned Commerce & Experience Korea and sits within Korea's Digital Owned Commerce & Experience team and partners with Marketing, Media, Platform, Operations, Consumer Service, Planning, and Finance. Together, these teams deliver integrated consumer moments and member-led programs that strengthen engagement, deepen consumer relationships, and drive business growth.   Who We Are Looking For   The ideal candidate is a consumer-obsessed and commercially minded professional who is passionate about creating meaningful consumer moments and growing long-term member relationships. They use consumer insights, membership performance, and commercial results to define clear actions. Proactive and adaptable, they navigate ambiguity, manage multiple priorities, and align cross-functional partners in a fast-paced, matrixed organization. They bring strong project leadership, clear communication, and curiosity about evolving consumer behavior and membership trends.    Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.   At least 7 years of relevant experience in digital commerce, membership, or marketing.   Experience leading seasonal campaigns, commercial events, consumer moments, or member programs.   Strong understanding of digital commerce and membership KPIs, with proven ability to translate data and insights into business actions.   Strong project management and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.   Strong written and verbal communication skills in Korean and English.     What You'll Work On   You will lead integrated consumer moments and membership programs that strengthen engagement, deepen member relationships, and drive business growth. You will connect sport, product, seasonal, and cultural priorities with relevant journeys, optimize digital experiences, and use performance insights to improve future plans in partnership with cross-functional teams.    Lead cross-sport consumer moments that drive demand, member engagement, and brand connection.  Connect sport priorities, product launches, and seasonal or cultural moments with relevant membership journeys.  Deliver seamless digital experiences across content, product presentation, promotions, and member benefits.  Monitor revenue, traffic, engagement, conversion, and retention KPIs, translating insights into Read & React actions.  Evaluate event and program performance to improve future plans and strengthen business and member outcomes.  Monitor competitor activity, membership programs, and marketplace trends to identify opportunities that strengthen Nike's consumer and membership strategy.

title: Strategic Account Manager
description: Description   Since 2000, Smartlinx has been redefining how senior care organizations manage their workforce. Our modern, purpose-built solutions, from dynamic scheduling and compliance to integrated payroll and real-time analytics, give providers the agility and intelligence needed to thrive in today's healthcare environment.  As the parent company of BekTek (HostedTime) and StafferLink, Smartlinx brings together a wide range of solutions for managing both full-time and contingent staff. Together, these capabilities give Smartlinx the most comprehensive workforce management solution set in senior care.  We're driven by one mission: to power exceptional senior care through smarter workforce management. Join us as we shape the future of work in long term care.  Position Summary  The Strategic Account Manager (SAM) owns the strategy, executive relationship, and commercial outcomes for an assigned portfolio of Smartlinx clients. The SAM develops a deep understanding of each customer's business and strategic priorities, builds executive alignment, translates those priorities into a comprehensive account strategy, and owns retention and growth outcomes across the portfolio.  The SAM leads a Customer Success Manager (CSM), who reports directly to the SAM and owns much of the day-to-day execution, value realization, and ongoing customer experience. The SAM sets the strategic direction and ensures the CSM has the context, priorities, and support to operate with ownership within that strategy. The SAM is accountable for the quality of the account plan, the effectiveness of the overall account team, and the performance of the portfolio.  The ideal candidate brings strong executive presence, commercial acumen, strategic thinking, and a proven ability to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder accounts. This role requires prior enterprise account experience aligned to the scope and complexity of the position.  Key Responsibilities     Own the overall strategy, executive relationship, and commercial outcomes for an assigned portfolio of customers.   Develop a deep understanding of each customer's business, strategic priorities, operational challenges, and success measures, and align Smartlinx capabilities and resources to the outcomes that matter most to the customer.   Build and maintain strong executive relationships with CFOs, CHROs, and other senior decision makers, serving as the primary strategic contact for the account.   Develop and own high-quality strategic account plans, including stakeholder mapping, customer priorities, success measures, value and ROI opportunities, risk mitigation, renewal strategy, and opportunities to expand the partnership based on customer priorities and demonstrated value.   Lead commercial strategy across the portfolio, including renewals, contract negotiations, change orders, cross-sell, and upsell, with accountability for GRR and NRR performance. title: Product Led Growth Manager
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Led Growth Manager based in Austria.   This is a high-impact growth product role focused on building and optimizing self-serve acquisition journeys for technical audiences.  You’ll own the customer funnel from signup and trial through activation, conversion, expansion, and product-led sales handoffs.  You’ll also serve as product owner for the website and application experience, shaping priorities and working closely with engineering and design.  The role combines product management, experimentation, analytics, lifecycle growth, and developer-focused experiences.  You’ll work with engineers, data teams, AI builders, marketing, customer success, RevOps, and sales to turn insights into measurable growth.  The environment is remote-first, globally distributed, highly autonomous, and focused on rapid experimentation and iterative delivery.  Success will be measured through improvements in activation, paid conversion, self-serve revenue, expansion, funnel velocity, and qualified sales opportunities.  Accountabilities    Own the self-serve growth funnel end-to-end, defining, measuring, and improving signup, trial, activation, paid conversion, and expansion journeys.   Act as product owner for the website and product UI, establishing the roadmap and priorities for experiences that capture demand and improve funnel performance.   Partner with engineers and designers to ship iterative improvements to the website, application, and customer journey.   Design and run conversion experiments, developing hypotheses, launching A/B tests, analyzing results, and scaling successful approaches.   Optimize product-led growth journeys originating in developer ecosystems, open source, documentation, SDKs, code examples, and emerging AI-agent ecosystems.   Develop a deep understanding of developer workflows and identify ways to improve the first hands-on experience and accelerate activation.   Build customer data and segmentation frameworks using product usage and firmographic signals to support personalized onboarding, content, and nurture programs.   Collaborate with RevOps to identify product-qualified accounts and determine when sales engagement can support expansion or account-managed relationships.   Work closely with product marketing, marketing, customer success, sales, and RevOps to align teams around a shared growth funnel.   Use data and customer insights to continuously identify new growth opportunities and prioritize the next set of experiments.   Track and communicate performance across activation, conversion, revenue, expansion, funnel velocity, and the quality of qualified opportunities passed to sales.      Requirements     5–8+ years of experience in growth, growth product management, lifecycle marketing, or funnel-focused product roles. title: Community manager
description: Cerchiamo un/a Community Manager (Appartenente alle Categorie Protette - Art. 1 L. 68/99)      In  Limitless , stiamo rivoluzionando la mobilità e l'autonomia con soluzioni innovative dedicate al mondo della disabilità. Capacità di Analisi Dati:  familiarità con l'interpretazione di metriche e dati di ingaggio.   Lingue:  ottima conoscenza della lingua  inglese  (scritta e parlata).  Organizzazione, autonomia e predisposizione al lavoro in team.      Costituiscono un Plus:   Conoscenza della lingua  spagnola  e/o  francese . Il presente annuncio è rivolto ad entrambi i sessi, ai sensi delle leggi 903/77 e 125/91, e a persone di tutte le età e tutte le nazionalità, ai sensi dei decreti legislativi 215/03 e 216/03.

title: Maintenance Operations Contract Manager
description: Attractive Salary | Company Ute | Health Insurance | Discounted Fuel | Career Growth | Winton and Lumsden based      Southland's roads take a beating, sun, snow, silage trucks, the lot. We need someone who can keep on top of it all, permanently.     SouthRoads is looking for a Contract Manager to run our Maintenance Operations team, covering everything from scheduled reseals to the 2am call-out after a slip takes out a culvert. This isn't a build-it-once-and-move-on role, it's ongoing, it's varied, and no two weeks look the same.      About Us      SouthRoads Ltd is a progressive civil construction contractor with deep roots in Southland and Otago, and part of the HW Richardson Group. Our fleet is modern, our people are the real deal, and our reputation is built one project at a time. If you like being somewhere that still feels like a team rather than a spreadsheet, you'll fit right in.      About The role      You'll own the relationship, Southland District Council on our maintenance contracts, which means you're as comfortable in a contract review meeting as you are standing in the rain looking at a washout. Day to day you're planning reactive and cyclic works, deploying crews and plant where they're needed most in conjunction with other Contract Managers, keeping an eye on contract KPIs, and making the call when weather changes everyone's plans for the day. You will maintain the divisions plant in liaison with our workshop and manage projects.      About you      We need someone who's done this before, genuine maintenance or roading experience, a working knowledge of council requirements, and the kind of calm head that doesn't panic when three things go wrong before smoko. You'll be leading people, so they need to want to follow you, not just report to you.      What we offer      In return, a strong salary, a company ute, health insurance, discounted fuel, and a real path upward in a business that's been part of the Southland and Otago landscape for a long time. We're part of the HW Richardson Group, so there's scale behind us, but we still run like a team that knows each other's names.      Sound like your kind of work? Let's talk.       To apply for this job go to: https://hwrcareers.co.nz/Vacancies       Reference Code: 6933359       Applications close 14 October 2026

title: Founding Customer Training Manager - France (m/f/d)
description: 🎤 Why voize? Because we're more than just a job!  At voize,  we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present.  Today, that time is lost to  busywork and complex systems  that pull them away from what matters most:  people .   Our vision is to change that by building AI companions  that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don't replace humans with technology -  we amplify their impact.   Our mission is backed with a  $50M Series A funding  led by  Balderton Capital , with support from  HV Capital, Y Combinator  and other leading VCs. Today,  2,000+ facilities  trust voize, and  over 200,000 users  rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.  💡 Your Mission: Own the training experience for users in France  As our  Founding   Customer Training Manager , you will be responsible for establishing and scaling the training program for our expansion into France. You'll inherit a proven methodology from the German market and adapt it for French healthcare facilities. You will motivate and engage groups of 10-15 caregivers, empowering them to embrace the technology and improve their documentation workflow.  🚀 Your Daily Business - No two days are alike    Lead in-person training sessions for new customer deployments, training groups of healthcare providers in French-speaking regions.  Refine training materials and playbooks for the French market and for individual customers as needed.  Travel to customer sites (estimated 2-3 weeks per month, depending on deployment schedule) to deliver on-site training and support go-live activities across France.  Collaborate cross-functionally with Customer Success, Product, and our German training team to optimize training approach and share insights.  Measure and report on training effectiveness, using adoption metrics and feedback to continuously improve our approach.  Ensure compliance with French healthcare regulations and documentation requirements (GDPR, standards, etc.).    🤝 Your Skillset - What you bring to the table    3+ years in training, onboarding, or customer enablement in B2B, ideally healthcare or another technical environment - and you have built a program from scratch, not just delivered one  Proven track record designing and delivering in-person training to non-technical and mixed-ability audiences  Business fluent level of French (C2 or bilingual) including regional and cultural nuance, plus working English for the international team  You use adoption metrics and feedback to sharpen your approach, and you can work around legacy EHRs and limited IT infrastructure    🌱 Growing together – what you can expect at voize    Become a co-creator of our success with virtual stock options.  France-based opportunity. Work from anywhere in France (travel to customer sites as needed). We have bases in Berlin and are expanding into France.  Flexible working hours because you know best when you work most efficiently.  Open culture with r

title: Delivery Manager SI Industriel H/F
description: Votre future équipe   Vous rejoignez l'équipe de Loic,Responsable d'Activités, afin d'accompagner les grands programmes de digitalisation des projets industriels et nucléaires.  Vous intervenez au sein d'environnements complexes, fortement réglementés, sur des projets stratégiques liés au  Chantier Numérique , à la digitalisation des processus métiers, à l'intégration des systèmes d'information industriels et au pilotage de solutions digitales à forte visibilité.  En lien avec les directions métiers, les équipes d'ingénierie, les architectes de solutions, les éditeurs et les partenaires, vous assurez le pilotage de projets de transformation depuis le cadrage jusqu'au déploiement opérationnel.   Vos principales missions     Piloter des projets stratégiques de transformation digitale dans des environnements industriels complexes.  Définir et piloter la feuille de route projet en garantissant les coûts, délais, qualité et risques.  Comprendre les besoins métiers et les traduire en solutions concrètes et partagées.  Construire et maintenir une planification réaliste des activités de réalisation.  Coordonner les différentes parties prenantes (métiers, ingénierie, DSI, architectes, éditeurs, intégrateurs et fournisseurs).  Assurer le pilotage transverse de plusieurs équipes intervenant sur un même programme.  Garantir la cohérence des interfaces entre les différents outils du SI industriel (PLM, solutions chantier, GED, outils métiers, plateformes data...).  Accompagner le déploiement de nouvelles solutions digitales et assurer leur adoption par les utilisateurs.  Identifier les risques, proposer les arbitrages nécessaires et sécuriser les décisions projet.  Contribuer à la gouvernance des projets et produire les indicateurs de pilotage destinés aux instances de décision.  Participer à l'amélioration continue des processus, méthodes et pratiques de pilotage.    Pourquoi rejoindre la communauté des Switchers ?  Rejoignez la 1ère société d’ingénierie nucléaire indépendante en Europe et  profitez de près de 60 ans d’expérience sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie des grands  projets énergétiques et industriels.  Construisez un parcours professionnel riche grâce à des passerelles concrètes  entre les métiers de l'ingénierie, du projet, du digital, du commerce et des  fonctions support  Profitez d'une véritable dynamique d'évolution avec près de 300 mobilités  internes réalisées par an et 70 % des managers issus de la promotion interne.  ,  Diplômé(e ) d'une école d'ingénieur ou d'un Master (Bac+5),  vous justifiez d'au moins  8 années d'expérience  en pilotage de projets ou programmes dans des environnements industriels complexes.  Vous avez déjà évolué dans des secteurs tels que le nucléaire, l'énergie, l'industrie lourde, les infrastructures ou l'ingénierie.   Vous Disposez De Solides Compétences En     Pilotage de projets ou de programmes de transformation digitale.  Coordination transverse d'équipes pluridisciplinaires.  Gestion des parties prenantes méti

title: Technical Manager and Projects
description: Hvis du motiveres af at være den person, der kan samle teknik, projekter, salg og HQ – og hvis du trives med at have fingrene nede i teknikken samtidig med, at du holder det store overblik – så kan dette være den rigtige næste rolle for dig.      For vores klient Georg Fischer A/S søger vi en stærk og struktureret profil til en rolle som ”Technical Manager og Projects” ansvarlig.      Du får en helt central rolle på tværs af teknik, projekter og salg   Fra Georg Fischer A/S´ kontor i Roskilde bliver dit stærke overblik og din evne til at skabe struktur helt afgørende for din succes i rollen. Du skal sikre fremdrift i projekterne, involvere de rette personer på det rette tidspunkt og sørge for, at relevant information bliver omsat og koordineret mellem salg, teknik, kunde og HQ.     Det er en rolle for dig, der trives med mange bolde i luften, kan holde det store overblik og samtidig har teknisk forståelse nok til at gå ned i detaljen, når det er nødvendigt.     Du bliver en central person i organisationen og det naturlige tekniske og projektmæssige bindeled mellem virksomhedens eksterne og interne salg, kunder, rådgivere og HQ i Schweiz.     Du får det overordnede projektmæssige og tekniske overblik på tværs af Danmark – ansvaret bliver stort og omfatter bl.a.:   Teknisk sparring til salgsorganisationen  Projektkoordinering på tværs af Danmark  Kontakt og koordinering med HQ i Schweiz  Teknisk afklaring med kunder, rådgivere og samarbejdspartnere  Koordinering af større projekter fra idé til løsning  Sammen med salgschefen sikre fremdrift i projekter og opgaver       Din baggrund   Vi forestiller os, at du har en ingeniør- eller maskinmesterbaggrund – alternativt en anden relevant teknisk uddannelse eller erfaring, der giver dig en stærk forståelse for tekniske systemer, installationer og projekter.     Har du erfaring med kølesystemer til datacentre, er det en klar fordel.     Du skal have en solid forståelse for plastrørsystemer og de komponenter, der får et komplet system til at fungere, herunder at kunne forstå samspillet mellem:    Rørsystem → ventil → aktuator → styring → proces.       Du skal derfor have erfaring med – ventiler, aktuatorer og deres funktion i komplette systemløsninger.     En vigtig del af rollen bliver at kunne forstå og udføre relevante tekniske beregninger. Du skal kunne forstå tallene og bruge dem til at træffe de rigtige tekniske beslutninger.     På IT-siden SKAL du have erfaring med SAP og være stærk i Excel. Du taler og skriver engelsk ubesværet – kan du tysk er det en fordel men ikke et krav.      Dig som person   Vi forventer ikke, at du kan alt. Faktisk forventer vi, at du ikke kan alt. Til gengæld skal du have en stærk lyst til at lære.     Du skal være typen, der tænker:  “Det har jeg ikke arbejdet med før – men det skal jeg nok få styr på.”     Du skal kunne sætte dig ind i nye produkter, teknologier, beregningsmetoder og applikationer – og derefter omsætte din nye viden til noget, resten af organisatione

title: Implementation Manager Japan
description: Ready to take your career global?   Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a Implementation Manager to join our Customer Experience team and help us unleash the potential of our business.   What You’ll Own     Possess expert level of knowledge on all relevant products and services.   This is a customer-facing role, you’ll be responsible for supporting our customers in integrating with Worldpay suite of payment services.  As a go-to expert, you’ll work directly with the customer and Account Management team to fully understand the business and deliver the solutions that are fit for purpose.  Support the customer and their relevant technical team to integrate to our suite of products, designing and setting up their accounts, providing technical guidance, as well as assistance in troubleshooting and resolving incidents.  You will be responsible for defining the finalized scope and managing the project right through completion and post live monitoring, following clear and well-maintained project plans. You will keep all relevant stakeholders updated with regular scheduled meetings to identify any risk early and ensure that the project is going to plan.  You’ll use your exceptional project management skills and experience to work on a high number of projects at any one time.  You’ll also plan and deliver customer demos and training on product functionality, to help maximize the value add to their businesses.  Build awareness of changing technical trends within the payment processing industry as well as wider technical trends such as security, web/browser technologies, mobile technologies etc.  Other related duties as assigned.    What you’ll bring    5 years and up experience and proven background in managing projects and delivering customer technical integrations.  Confidence and experience in managing relationships between internal and external stakeholders. Possess strong communication and interpersonal skills. Speak up in meetings and contribute positively.  Creative and forward thinking with a good aptitude for problem solving.  Be curious, ability to capture customer requirements and familiar with funneling techniques.  Technical expertise in XML, JSON API is preferred.  Experience with implementation involving Web and Mobile SDKs, React Native and JavaScripts  Knowledge of Database technologies: Oracle / SQL.  Ability to perform server log checks with SPLUNK analysis tool.  Someone who can work independently as well as is a team player.  Japanese and English language would be preferred.     About The Team   Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections – it’s unmatched. Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.   What makes a Globalpayer?   Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one

description: 【企業名】 株式会社コアコンセプト・テクノロジー  【職種名】 ERP導入プロジェクトマネージャー◆案件獲得に向けたコンサルティング業務等◆大手取引先多数  【仕事内容(概要)】 ERP導入プロジェクトマネージャー◆案件獲得に向けたコンサルティング業務等◆大手取引先多数  【具体的な仕事内容】 当社製造業DX部門における新規事業領域として、mcframeを中心とした製造業ERPに関する導入支援を行い顧客企業のバックエンドの仕組みづくりを支援しています。 ERP導入支援サービスを拡拡していくために、プロジェクトをリードしていただける方にご参画頂きたいと考え、今回の募集にいたりました。  ■本ポジションでの仕事の内容 コンサルティングから導入まで一気通貫型で行うERP導入プロジェクトにおいて、プロジェクトのマネージャーとしてご活躍いただくことを想定しております。 ・案件獲得に向けたコンサルティング業務 ・顧客業務（As-Is）分析、未来像の業務（To-Be）策定、グランドデザイン構築 ・要件定義や基本設計などの上流工程へのコミット ・プロジェクトのリスク管理、コストコントロール ・プロジェクトメンバーのマネジメント ゆくゆくは組織のマネジメントも担っていただければと考えております。  ■本部門の事業内容 当社では製造業・建設業を中心にDX化の支援を行っております。基幹システム（ERP）や製造実実システム（MES）の導入経験と、ものづくりへの深い知見を活かし、作業効率性・労働生産性の向上や、ベテランが有するノウハウのの標準化などを実現、またスマートファクトリーの構築をコンサルティングから導入までで一気通貫型ででっております。 title: Appointment Setter / Inside Sales
description:
Headquarters:  Tampa, Florida USA
      URL:   https://www.elementalclaims.com 
 

 We are looking for a confident, highly fluent English-speaking  Appointment Setter  to join our  public adjusting firm . 
 We work with homeowners throughout the United States who may need assistance  filing and navigating property insurance claims . Your primary responsibility will be communicating with potential clients who have already responded to our outreach. 
 You will use our proven system to answer text messages, qualify interested homeowners, make calls when necessary, and schedule appointments for our field representatives/public adjusters. 
  What you'll be doing:  
 • Responding to homeowners who engage with our outreach regarding potential property insurance claims
• Speaking with homeowners who may need assistance filing an insurance claim for damage to their property
• Calling interested or potentially interested homeowners when needed
• Following our existing scripts and proven appointment-setting system
• Answering basic questions and handling objections naturally
• Qualifying potential clients and identifying homeowners who may have a valid reason to file a property insurance claim
• Scheduling qualified appointments for our field representatives/public adjusters
• Updating leads and appointments inside our CRM 
  Who we're looking for:  
  Near native American spoken English is REQUIRED.  
 We are specifically looking for someone who is extremely comfortable communicating with American customers and understands U.S. conversational culture. You should be able to have a natural conversation rather than simply read from a script. 
 You do  NOT  need to live in the United States. 
 Experience working with U.S. customers is strongly preferred. Previous experience in appointment setting, outbound sales, call centers, roofing, insurance, public adjusting, real estate, home improvement, or other U.S. home-service industries is a major plus. 
 You should be: 
 • Confident on the phone
• Persuasive without being overly aggressive
• Comfortable handling objections
• Reliable and consistent
• Comfortable using a CRM and learning new software
• Able to follow a system while still sounding natural
• Available during U.S. business hours 
  Compensation:  
 This position offers a  $1,000 monthly base salary plus performance-based commission.  
 In addition to the base salary, you will earn  $200 for every lead that results in a signed client.  
 Our performance expectation is approximately  10 signed clients per month . At that level, compensation would be: 
 • Base Salary:  $1,000/month 
• 10 Signed Clients × $200:  $2,000 commission 
• Expected Total Monthly Compensation:  $3,000  
 There is no set limit on commission—the more qualified leads you convert into signed clients, the more you can earn. 
 We provide the leads, systems, scripts, and workflow. Your responsibility is to communicate with homeowners, identify and qualify potential clients

description:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS
 
Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).

 

VOTRE ROLE


En lien direct avec le studio de création, vous traduisez les croquis et les intentions du directeur artistique en volumes et en premiers patronages. Vous êtes garant(e) de la silhouette, des proportions et du bien-aller des pièces de la Maison.

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don't replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.

As our Founding Customer Training Manager, you will be responsible for establishing and scaling the training program for our expansion into France. Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe's software ecosystem.

Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices, while focusing on what they do best - building products and supporting customers. This is not a reporting role. It's ownership of the financial engine for a portfolio of growing software businesses.

title: ML Research Engineer
description:

Backed by $11M from senior leaders at OpenAI, Anthropic, HuggingFace, Mistral, and DeepMind, White Circle processes 100M+ API calls monthly and runs its own LLMs in production.

  • Turn petabytes of unstructured text into a structured, explorable view: topics, clusters, segments, trends, anomalies.

  • Translate findings into product and operational decisions, and ship self-serve datasets, data models, and dashboards.

  • Work with engineering and research to align pipelines with production constraints (latency, cost, privacy).

  • Strong Python and SQL, with production-grade pipeline engineering (not just notebooks).

  • Applied NLP/ML on real-world text: embeddings, clustering, topic modeling, semantic search, classification.

  • Experience at scale: distributed processing, large-scale storage and querying, performance-cost tradeoffs.

  • Evaluation of fuzzy problems: offline/online metrics, human-in-the-loop labeling, inter-annotator agreement, drift monitoring.

description:
Nous recherchons un assistant ingénieur en techniques expérimentales et réalisation mécanique pour rejoindre l'Université de technologie de Compiègne (UTC).

Vous aurez la possibilité de :

Travailler dans un cadre agréable et stimulant, au service de la communauté universitaire (étudiants, chercheurs, enseignants-chercheurs…),

Intégrer une équipe motivée,

Bénéficier de conditions de travail permettant un bon équilibre vie professionnelle - vie personnelle.

Vos missions

Vous serez chargé(e) de concevoir, fabriquer et instrumenter des dispositifs mécaniques et expérimentaux selon des plans techniques, puis développer, optimiser et adapter les protocoles associés.

Vos activités

  • Participer à la conception et à la mise en place d'expériences en techniques expérimentales : plan ou schéma, calculs de dimensionnement, montage, réglage et essais

  • Assurer la maintenance et le bon fonctionnement des appareillages et/ou des expériences

  • Contribuer à la réalisation mécanique de premières études et de prototypes

  • Former les utilisateurs à la mise en œuvre des dispositifs expérimentaux

  • Assister les chercheurs et les étudiants dans la réalisation de leurs projets

  • Participer à la valorisation des technologies du laboratoire.

En tant que membre de notre équipe, vous aurez l'opportunité de contribuer à des projets innovants et de collaborer avec des experts du domaine.

title: Ingénieur de recherche F/H Détection d’anomalies visuelles complexes par apprentissage très faiblement supervisé : Etudes, applications et transposition des méthodes Visual Large Model à l’industrie du futur.
description:
Ce recrutement s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet PostGenAI piloté par Sorbonne Université. Le projet est soutenu par l'Agence Nationale de la Recherche (ANR), dans le cadre du plan d'investissement gouvernemental France 2030.

Vos missions

  • Assurer une étude scientifique rigoureuse, visant à comparer les performances des modèles VLM sur la détection d’anomalies visuelles complexes.

  • Prendre en charge l’étude complète, dimensionner les critères d’évaluations ainsi que les configurations de déploiement des modèles, mener les expérimentations associées.

  • Contribuer à l’écriture d’articles scientifiques reprenant les résultats de l’étude et proposant des recommandations quant à la transposition et au déploiement des modèles VLM dans l’industrie.

Activités principales

Le sujet traite de la problématique générale de la détection d’anomalies visuelles complexes dans l’industrie. L’industrie doit se doter d’outils d’inspection de confiance rapidement déployables en production. Les solutions d’IA supervisées les plus performantes reposent sur une activité préalable longue et coûteuses d’étiquetage d’images par des experts-process (plusieurs centaines d’étiquetages d’images). Les anomalies visuelles complexes sont : (1) des défauts logiques où les modèles doivent détecter et contrôler la logique de positionnement relatif entre différents objets ou entités de la scène. Il s’agit par exemple : du contrôle de l’absence/présence de pièces ou composants, de la détection d’erreurs de câblages etc. (2), ils sont aussi des défauts de texture, comme des opacités, des fissures

description:

About Fresha

Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices.

title: AI Science Writer, Nebius Academy (Contract)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Science Writer, Nebius Academy (Contract) based in France.

As an AI Science Writer, you’ll translate cutting-edge AI and machine learning research into accurate, engaging, and accessible stories.
You’ll work at the intersection of scientific research, technical communication, journalism, and multimedia storytelling.
A core part of the role will be reviewing new models, architectures, papers, and research to identify what is genuinely novel and important.
You’ll turn complex technical concepts into compelling written and visual narratives through articles, explainers, diagrams, charts, and other formats.
You’ll engage directly with researchers, engineers, founders, and scientific leaders to investigate ideas and verify technical claims.
The role also offers opportunities to cover major conferences, host research-focused events, and experiment with AI-assisted editorial workflows.
This is an ongoing contract position with a fixed monthly retainer, flexibility, and potential opportunities for longer-term career growth.


Accountabilities
  • Produce accurate and engaging scientific and technical reviews covering new AI models, architectures, research papers, internal research, and emerging trends.
  • Analyze technical papers and research findings to identify meaningful innovations, understand methodologies, evaluate limitations, and communicate their significance.
  • Transform complex model architectures and technical concepts into clear visual narratives, including infographics, diagrams, charts, and other multimedia elements.
  • Develop written content across multiple formats, including analytical reports, long-form features, interviews, technical explainers, newsletters, webinar scripts, and social media

title: Electronics / Embedded Robotics Engineer
description:
sensmore is a Berlin/Potsdam-based robotics startup delivering production-proven automation for industries where the world’s raw materials are extracted, moved, and processed. Its automation system transforms heavy machines into intelligent, automated robots powered by Physical AI and vertically integrates them into the full production environment: from the machine and safety infrastructure to network infrastructure, site processes, and operational interfaces.

Co-developed with customers, sensmore is backed by Point Nine Capital, leading industry investors, the State of Brandenburg, and the European Union.

Role Overview:

We are looking for a skilled Electronics / Embedded Engineer to enhance our team. This role requires a strong background in electronics design, embedded firmware, and hardware deployed in harsh environments. The successful candidate will be instrumental in building the electronic systems and firmware that connect our AI stack to real machines and keep them running reliably in the field.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and bring up custom electronics – schematics, PCB layout, and component selection – for sensor interfacing, power distribution, and machine control.

  • Develop and validate embedded firmware on microcontrollers for sensor acquisition, actuator drive, and safety-relevant functions.

  • Own the electrical architecture of the machine kit, covering power budgeting, protection, grounding, EMC, and rugged wire harness design.

  • Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to integrate hardware and firmware into the wider robotic system, from prototype through field testing to repeatable production.

title: Growth Intern - Automation & AI (w/m/d)
description:
Über uns

Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser.

In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. <1% Solardurchdringung. <2% Smart Metering. Kaum Flexibilität oder intelligentes Energiemanagement.

Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur.

Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht.

VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (§42b EnWG).

Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance:

  • Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer,

  • ~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und

  • digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität.

Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt.

Zeit AI builds ZeitMind, the autonomous data engineer for the European mid-market. We connect to the systems companies already run (ERP exports, CRM data, spreadsheets, internal databases) and put agents on top so operators get reliable answers without hiring a data team. As a Business Development Representative, you'll help drive our growth by building our outbound sales engine and creating new customer opportunities.

Cold calling is how we won our first customers, and it's still our strongest channel.

This role is a fast track into sales.

Outbound experience? You'll move to (Junior) AE in 3-6 months.
New to sales? Same path - your ramp speed sets the pace.

We invest in you with daily coaching, clear targets, uncapped upside. You won't be handed a list and left alone – we grow together.

What you will do

  • Outbound Execution: Run high-velocity outbound with cold calling as your primary channel, backed by email and LinkedIn cadences where they add value

title: Forward-Deployed Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
The opportunity

Zeit AI builds ZeitMind, the autonomous data engineer for the European mid-market. We work with real companies and real data: exports from ERP systems, CRM data, spreadsheets, internal databases.   • solve real-world problems where value is hidden inside of data

  • model business logic in ZeitMind and get it running in production

  • own customers end to end and build data applications to make critical business decisions

  • feed what you learn back into the product

 

You will thrive here if you

  • are comfortable and enjoy working directly with customers from Day 1

  • Project duration: 2 months, with potential extension

We create high-quality STEM training data for frontier AI models used by leading AI labs to improve model reasoning in scientific domains.

We are seeking experts in Biology to create challenging, deterministic problems with exactly one verifiable correct answer. Problems should reflect authentic scientific and analytical workflows and be submitted with complete, verified solutions.

Depending on specialization, work may include molecular biology, genetics, systems biology, computational biology, bioinformatics, or adjacent quantitative biology fields.

What you’ll do

  • Design advanced biology problems that challenge frontier AI systems

  • Create deterministic tasks with one correct answer

  • Submit complete, verified solutions

  • Build problems involving experimental reasoning, biological systems, computational analysis, or bioinformatics workflows

  • Use Python and, when relevant, specialized biology or bioinformatics tools

  • Ensure high standards of rigor, reproducibility, and technical clarity

Our models power thousands of agents worldwide and process millions of hours each month.

We are backed by leading early-stage investors including Connect Ventures, Partech, Inovia Capital, as well as angel investors from HuggingFace, DeepMind and Amazon with deep expertise in AI and developer infrastructure. These partners share our vision and are helping us build a world-class team operating with high levels of responsibility and velocity. We look for people who take ownership, think systemically, and want to solve challenging real-world problems in close collaboration with our customers. If you’re motivated by developing technology that is used in production, shaping an emerging category and setting a new standard for how Voice AI works in the real world, you’ll feel at home at ai-coustics.

title: Senior Stress & Thermomechanical FEA Engineer - Propulsion Battery System (all genders)

Your Mission:

As Senior Stress & Thermomechanical FEA Engineer – Propulsion Battery System (all genders) you will join VÆRIDION’s Technology division within the Mechanical Design & Integration team and lead the structural, stress, and thermomechanical finite element analysis (FEA) of the propulsion battery system for VÆRIDION’s CS-23 all-electric aircraft.

You will own the computational modelling of battery packs, power distribution units (PDUs), and their internal hardware, predicting how every component behaves under nominal and emergency conditions – including thermal runaway, the DO-160 environmental qualification conditions applied to the pack and PDU as airborne equipment (temperature and altitude, temperature variation, humidity, operational shocks and crash safety, and vibration), flight loads, and durability over service life. Your analysis will provide engineering evidence that the propulsion battery system is structurally robust, thermally safe, and certifiable.

Within the Mechanical Design & Integration team, you will collaborate with Mechanical Design, Materials & Processes, Test, HV Electrical Systems, Airborne Electronics, Thermal Systems, Aircraft Structures, Certification, Safety, and Quality teams to define analysis methods, apply the material property allowable required for your analyses, and substantiate the qualification of the propulsion battery pack and PDU. You will be the structural and thermomechanical analysis authority for the propulsion battery system, responsible for checking and releasing design against the applicable stress and thermomechanical requirements.

Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION’s mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation.

title: Senior Battery Algorithms Engineer (all genders)
description:
Your Mission:

We are developing a next-generation electric aircraft propulsion system, with the propulsion battery designed, developed, and validated in-house. Accurate real-time observation and prediction of the battery’s State of Function (SoF), the energy and power actually accessible for safe flight and landing, is the safety-critical output of the battery system, and the basis for pre-flight planning, in-flight energy management, and the energy information presented to the crew.

SoF is built on the underlying battery states that your algorithms observe and predict: state of charge (SoC), state of health (SoH), state of power (SoP), state of energy (SoE), and state of balance (SoB). Erroneous observation or prediction of SoF is classified as a catastrophic condition, since it can lead the crew to commit to a flight or an approach the battery cannot support. This makes the function certification-critical and places exacting demands on the accuracy, robustness, and verifiability of every algorithm you deliver.

As a Senior Battery Algorithms Engineer (all genders), you will join the VÆRIDION Technology team and take ownership of the development and validation of the state observers, estimators, and predictors that determine SoF for our lithium-ion propulsion battery systems.

This is a hands-on senior role in which you lead the modeling, simulation, algorithm development, test-data analysis, and validation behind these states, and set the methodology the team works to.

Your work will shape the high-voltage battery system at the center of VÆRIDION’s electric propulsion architecture and carry it through to certification.

Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself.

The problem you'll be solvingA corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder.
GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter.


What we're looking for

description:

Qui sommes-nous ?

Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.

La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux pour rejoindre le département COMELEC à Télécom Paris.

Les fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (Hollow-Core Photonic Crystal Fibers, HCPCF) ont récemment franchi une étape technologique majeure, avec des pertes de propagation pouvant atteindre 0.1 dB/km à 1550 nm, comparables, voire inférieures, à celles des fibres télécoms standards [1–2]. title: Quadrants: Compiler Lead
description:
What Quadrants is

Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research.

The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton.

It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public.

The bet: high-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast.

The role

You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap.

Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further.

It calls for two things at once:

title: Genesis-World: Core Physics Engineer
description:
What we're building

Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future.

Genesis-World is an open-source, general-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from Genesis AI. One unified multi-physics engine: rigid bodies, FEM, MPM, particles, cloth, fluids. A robot arm can pour water onto sand, grasp a deformable object, or cut a soft body, all in the same simulation. Nyx, our in-house renderer, may be the most promising renderer for robotics out there: real-time photo-realistic rendering, advanced features like depth of field, and state-of-the-art techniques never seen before. Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available (paper). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact (paper) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise.

Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non-batched scenes where CPU wins outright.
