title: Principal Product Manager - Personalization
description:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

Spotify Search handles billions of queries across every market, language, and content type — music, podcasts, audiobooks, videos, playlists, and more. We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the Search Personalization within our Conversation Product Area, setting the product strategy for how hundreds of millions of users find and discover content on Spotify. This is a leadership role at the intersection of search systems, AI, and user experience. You’ll own the end-to-end strategy for search results — from ranking and relevance to AI-powered features like semantic search, LLM reranking, and AI Overviews — while leading two key Search squads (results ranking and query suggestions). Search is the front door to Spotify; this role shapes what people find when they walk through it.

What You'll Do
  • Set the product strategy and multi-cycle roadmap for Search Personalization at Spotify — spanning ranking, relevance, retrieval, AI-native features, quality, and trust.
  • Drive the evolution of Search toward AI-native experiences — AI Overviews, semantic search, LLM reranking — balancing innovation velocity with quality and cost discipline.
  • Own the Search quality bar: define how relevance, trust, compliance, and user experience connect into a holistic quality framework with measurable outcomes.
  • Manage Search’s role as a shared surface across many company strategies — build prioritization frameworks, communicate trade-offs, and represent Search at executive forums.

title: AWS Cloud Infrastructure Architect with IRS MBI Clearance
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AWS Cloud Infrastructure Architect with IRS MBI Clearance based in United Kingdom.

This role is responsible for designing and managing secure, scalable AWS cloud infrastructure across complex multi-account environments.
You will shape cloud architecture spanning account governance, networking, identity and access management, security, and compliance.
The position requires hands-on expertise with AWS Organizations, Control Tower, Landing Zone Architecture, and GovCloud environments.
You will help establish resilient cloud foundations while supporting stringent regulatory and security requirements, including FedRAMP.
Working closely with engineering and security teams, you will provide architectural guidance and help drive infrastructure best practices.
The role also includes infrastructure automation, cost optimization, disaster recovery, and technical documentation.
This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on the reliability, security, and scalability of a mission-critical cloud environment.


Accountabilities:
  • Design and implement AWS account structures using AWS Organizations, including Organizational Units aligned with business and technical requirements.
  • Establish account governance policies, standards, consolidated billing, and cost allocation strategies.
  • Deploy and manage AWS Control Tower for automated account provisioning, governance, and organizational controls.
  • Design and implement Landing Zone Architecture for secure, scalable, multi-account AWS environments.
  • Architect and deploy multi-region VPC environments, including subnets, route tables, network ACLs, and network segmentation strategies.
  • Configure and manage Site-to-Site VPN, Client VPN, AWS Direct Connect

At Plumerai, we make it easy and affordable for developers to add highly accurate AI to their camera devices, enabling them to create amazing new products. description:
Our Mission

At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails, and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved.

title: Senior Credit Underwriter | UK
description:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp is looking for a Senior Underwriter to join our Underwriting team in Europe. You’ll evaluate businesses applying to Ramp, make credit and risk decisions, and help improve how we assess customers across our products.

This is an early regional role supporting EU and US applicants. We’re looking for someone with strong financial judgment who can work independently, make clear decisions with incomplete information, and help us build scalable underwriting processes.

What You’ll Do

  • Review applications for Ramp’s corporate card and bill pay products across the EU and US.

  • Analyze financial statements, bank data, bureau information, and other risk signals

title: Office Manager CDD

About Pelico

Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.

We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.

Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.

This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

title: AI Engineer - Full time
description:
TLDR; Davis is hiring an AI Engineer to work on the multi-agent pipeline turning raw, fragmented data into expert-grade real estate deliverables. You will make it more reliable, fast, and indistinguishable from the best human teams, then push it past what any human team could do, owning the stack end to end, from context engineering and orchestration to verification, storage and evaluation.

About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate 4-5 fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they'll need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. title: Internship - Founders' Office
description:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

description:
Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our Platform team.

About the role

Our Engineering and Product Design teams are building multiple verticals on our platform at high speed, leveraging AI and building agentic functionality into the platform itself. As we scale into the world's largest regulated financial institutions, identity and access management (IAM), authorization, and fine-grained permissions have become foundational to our enterprise readiness.

We are hiring a Full-Stack Engineer to join the team building Taktile's IAM and permissions platform: the authorization backbone that powers enterprise-grade access control across our product.

Joining us, you'll design and build permission models and access controls end-to-end, from the React/TypeScript access-management and admin UIs down to the Python (FastAPI) authorization services. You'll take on the problems that make enterprise authorization genuinely hard: multi-tenant isolation, fine-grained permission checks in the hot path of millions of decisions a day, audit and access trails, and the constraints of regulated financial services.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and operate core authorization primitives such as roles, policies, and fine-grained permission checks (RBAC/ReBAC), along with the authentication and SSO/OAuth/OIDC flows that sit on top of them.

Immotalente besetzt kaufmännische Stellen in Hausverwaltungen. Dahinter läuft ein selbstgebautes System: Kandidaten werden gefunden, bewertet und angeschrieben, über sechzehn Mandate hinweg. Dazu ein Wissensspeicher, in dem Mandate, Kunden und Abläufe liegen und aus dem heraus KI-Agenten arbeiten.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
About Us

Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we've built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We're passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so.

Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and roughly 100 countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco.

We're a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things.

Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today.

About The Role

We are hiring Senior Data Scientists across multiple teams at Constructor. Wherever you land, you will work with data from some of the world's largest ecommerce companies, applying statistics and machine learning to problems that directly move business metrics like revenue and conversion rate.

title: Customer Operations Manager
description: Vill du vara med och utveckla en viktig funktion i ett växande internationellt industribolag? Drivs du av att forma och kvalitetssäkra processer och arbetssätt? Är du en trygg ledare med förmåga att skapa delaktighet och engagemang hos människorna omkring dig? Då kan rollen som Customer Operations Manager på KLINGER vara något för dig! Företaget grundades 1886 som ett familjeföretag och är känt som en pionjär inom tätningsteknik. KLINGER har en global kundbas och levererar pålitliga produkter över hela världen för användning inom petrokemi, kemi, industri, infrastruktur och transport.  Idag består KLINGER Group av 3100 medarbetare och omsätter 719 miljoner euro och har 18 produktionsanläggningar globalt. I Sverige består organisationen av 20 medarbetare med huvudkontor i Järfälla. Du kommer att leda ett team om fyra personer som arbetar brett med inköp- och orderhantering, material- och produktfrågor samt andra administrativa ärenden inom customer operations. Vidare kommer du att ha ett nära samarbete med försäljning, lager och ledning. Ditt fokus ligger vid att skapa tydlighet, struktur och ansvar i teamet samt ge medarbetarna rätt förutsättningar att arbeta än mer kvalitativt och effektivt.     I rollen arbetar du strategiskt med att driva förbättringsarbete kring processer, arbetssätt och uppföljning, med särskilt fokus på effektivitet, kvalitet och digitalisering. KLINGER står inför en uppgradering av sitt affärssystem till Business Central, där du får en betydande roll i förändringsarbetet där du säkerställer att rutiner och processer efterlevs och förbättras över tid. KLINGER Sweden AB är ISO-certifierade enligt ISO 9001 och ISO 14001, som är internationella standarder för kvalitets- och miljöledningssystem.     I tjänsten utgår du från KLINGERs nyrenoverade kontor i Järfälla, Stockholm och rapporterar till Head Of Operations.     Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:   Leda och utveckla Operations-teamet med fokus på engagemang, ansvar och produktivitet.  Driva förbättringsarbete inom processer, rutiner och arbetssätt.  Ansvara för uppföljning av KPI:er och säkerställa hög kvalitet och leveransprecision.  Vara delaktig i implementeringen av Business Central samt driva digitalisering och effektivisering av flöden och processer.  Samverka nära försäljning, lager och ledning för att skapa ett effektivt och kundfokuserat arbetssätt. title: Customer Support Team Lead
description: Customer Support Team Lead   ERP Software | Customer Support Leadership | Norway   Join an established, PE-backed international software company providing specialist ERP and operational technology to complex manufacturing and processing industries.  The business combines decades of domain expertise with continued investment in modern cloud technology and AI-assisted solutions, supporting thousands of customers internationally. Backed by private equity, the business is continuing to invest in its products, technology and customer experience, with an increasing focus on connected platforms, AI-assisted capabilities and measurable operational performance.  This particular business unit provides specialist cloud ERP software into the seafood and process manufacturing markets, supporting complex operational environments across areas including inventory, procurement, production, logistics, traceability and commercial workflows. The business wants a strong local leader who can combine people management with operational discipline and enough software knowledge to understand the challenges customers and support teams encounter. title: Palvelupäällikkö taloushallinnon tiimiin Ouluun
description: Johda tiimiä ja kehitä asiakkuuksia   Haluatko yhdistää tiimin ja asiakkuuksien johtamisen sekä kehittämistyön roolissa, jossa pääset oikeasti vaikuttamaan? Sinulla on kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä ja asiakkuuksien johtamisesta  Osaat organisoida, priorisoida ja delegoida  Johdat mielelläsi esimerkillä ja innostat muita onnistumaan  Viestit selkeästi ja rakennat sujuvaa yhteistyötä  Haluat kehittää toimintaa ja viedä asioita eteenpäin       Meillä pääset osaksi yhteisöä, jossa    yhdessä tekeminen näkyy arjessa  tukea saa aina, ja ilmapiiri on avoin ja kannustava  arvostamme kehittämishalua, vastuullisuutta ja aitoa kiinnostusta ihmisten johtamiseen       Toimimme Aallon arvojen mukaisesti:  Osaan, Palvelen, Huolehdin, Kehityn.  Yhdessä  muodostamme tilitoimiston – monimuotoisen työyhteisön, työpaikan ja asiantuntijaorganisaation, jossa jokainen meistä voi työskennellä ylpeyttä, tyytyväisyyttä ja turvallisuutta tuntien. Yhteistyö kanssamme perustuu molemminpuoliseen kunnioitukseen, luottamukseen ja rehellisyyteen. Uskomme menestyksen kumpuavan tyytyväisistä asiantuntijoista, jotka mahdollistavat tyytyväiset asiakkaat. Strategiamme ydinajatus kulminoituu Aallon sloganiin Tilitoimistoni.     Tutustu meihin lisää verkkosivuillamme ja lue Hae töihin-osiosta, mitä tarjoamme sekä mitä odotamme sinulta työntekijänä. title: Myymäläpäällikkö
description: Hae tähän työpaikkaan  Myymäläpäällikkö  Innostutko muiden onnistumisen mahdollistamisesta, tavoitteellisesta myynnistä ja tiimin johtamisesta? Tule tekemään kanssamme suomalaisten silmistä maailman onnellisimmat! Etsimme Loimaa, Forssa ja Somero -tiimiin myymäläpäällikköä, joka johtaa tiimiä esimerkillä ja innostavalla otteella. Tarjoamme työn, jossa pääset toimimaan vahvan asiantuntijuuden, avoimen yhteistyön ja asiakkaiden tarpeita kuuntelevan kulttuurin keskellä.   Esimerkillä johtamista ja henkilöstön kehittämistä   Myymäläpäällikön roolissa yhdistyy myynnillinen tekeminen ja valmentava esihenkilötyö. Valmennat 16 näkemisen asiantuntijasta koostuvan tiimisi toimintaa kokonaisvaltaisesti ja varmistat omalla esimerkilläsi, että tekeminen on Silmäaseman konseptin mukaista ja etenee tavoitteiden suuntaisesti. Rakennat ja ylläpidät tiimiisi kulttuuria, jossa autetaan toisia, jaetaan osaamista ja onnistutaan yhdessä. Myymäläpäällikkönä vastaat myymälöidesi toiminnasta, tuloksesta ja tiimin onnistumisesta.  Tulet osaksi Länsi-Suomen myymäläpäällikkötiimiä, jossa työskentelee 11 kollegaasi. Arjessa tukenasi ovat apulaismyymäläpäällikkö sekä esihenkilösi, aluejohtaja Joni Viili.   Myymäläpäällikkönä     Johdat tiimisi tavoitteita ja varmistat niiden saavuttamisen yhdessä apulaismyymäläpäällikön sekä tiimisi kanssa  Viihdyt myymälässä tiimisi kanssa, johdat tekemistä arjen tilanteissa ja johdat esimerkillä  Vastaat myynnin seurannasta, kehittämisestä ja tuloksellisesta tekemisestä  Valmennat ja sparraat tiimiäsi systemaattisesti sekä käyt jatkuvaa ja säännöllistä vuoropuhelua  Käyt keskusteluja tiimiläistesi kehittymisestä: meillä tavoitekeskustelut, perehdytyskeskustelut ja suoritukseen liittyvät keskustelut ovat osa arkea  Suunnittelet resurssit, laadit työvuorolistat sekä varmistat toiminnan tehokkuuden  Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä myymäläverkoston ja silmäsairaaloiden kanssa    Toimit esihenkilönä tiimillesi ja luot edellytykset onnistumiselle, tuet, ohjaat ja mahdollistat jokaisen kehittymisen. Olet tärkeä esimerkki muille ja varmistat, että tekeminen on asiakaslähtöistä, tavoitteellista ja sujuvaa joka päivä.  Tehtävä on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva. Aloituspäivä sovitaan yhdessä tehtävään valitun henkilön kanssa, toivomme, että voisit aloittaa marraskuun alussa. Vastuullasi ovat Loimaan, Forssan ja Someron myymälät, joiden välillä liikut säännöllisesti. Työ painottuu vahvasti myymälöihin ja tiimin arkeen, mutta osa työstä on mahdollista tehdä joustavasti myös etänä. Käytännössä vietät suurimman osan työajasta myymälöissäsi valmentaen ja kehittäen tiimisi osaamista. Pyrkimys on päästä käyttämään 60 % ajasta tiimisi valmentamiseen, 20 % hallinnollisten tehtävien parissa ja 20 % suunnittelutyöhön   Tulevalta kollegalta odotamme seuraavia ominaisuuksia   Meillä Silmäasemalla menestyt, kun suhtaudut työhösi asiakaslähtöisesti, olet utelias oppimaan uutta ja toimit luontevasti osana tiimiä. title: US Operations Manager
description: "한국의 이야기를 미국의 언어로, Babechat의 첫 미국 유저 경험을 함께 만들어갈 당신을 기다립니다."     안녕하세요, AI 캐릭터 채팅 서비스 'Babechat'과 'Tookit'을 성공적으로 선보이고 운영해 온 주식회사 일레븐입니다. 우리는 사용자와 AI 캐릭터 간의 경계 없는 소통을 통해 새로운 즐거움과 관계의 가능성을 만들어가고 있습니다.     한국과 일본, 대만에 이어 이제 미국 시장으로 향합니다. 미국 유저가 Babechat을 처음 만나는 순간부터 계속 머무르는 경험까지, 서비스 운영과 콘텐츠 현지화를 한 손에 쥐고 이끌어 갈 US Operation Manager를 찾습니다.     📌 이런 일을 해요 (주요 업무)   미국 서비스 출시를 준비하고, 런칭 이후 운영 전반을 오너십을 갖고 담당해요.  미국 유저의 문의(CS)와 피드백을 모니터링하고, 운영 이슈에 빠르게 대응하며 유저의 목소리를 팀에 전달해요.  헬프데스크·FAQ·유저 가이드 등 CS 채널을 처음부터 구축하고 관리해요.  디스코드·레딧 등 영어권 커뮤니티를 운영하며, 유저가 머무르고 싶은 공간을 만들어요.  현지 크리에이터와 소통하며 미국 유저에게 맞는 콘텐츠 소싱을 지원해요.  미국 시장 트렌드와 경쟁 서비스를 모니터링하며, 인사이트를 운영에 반영해요.  국내 콘텐츠·마케팅·제품팀과 긴밀하게 소통하며 한국과 미국을 잇는 다리 역할을 해요.         🎯 이런 분을 찾아요 (자격 요건)   한국어와 영어로 원활하게 업무할 수 있는 분  미국 문화와 온라인 콘텐츠에 대한 이해도가 높은 분  꼼꼼하게 운영 업무를 관리하고, 이슈에 빠르게 대응할 수 있는 분  AI 캐릭터챗, 웹소설, 웹툰, 게임 등 콘텐츠 서비스에 관심이 있는 분         ✨ 이런 분이면 더 좋아요 (우대 사항)   미국향 앱·웹 서비스 운영 경험이 있는 분  디스코드·레딧 등 영어권 커뮤니티 운영 경험이 있는 분  초기 서비스에서 다양한 업무를 주도적으로 수행해 본 분  콘텐츠 번역 또는 현지화 경험이 있는 분         🤝 합류 여정  서류 전형 → 1차(실무진) 인터뷰 → 2차(리더십) 인터뷰 → 레퍼런스 체크 → 최종 합격 및 오퍼 미팅     이력서와 함께 번역·현지화 또는 서비스 운영 경험을 보여줄 수 있는 자료(번역 샘플, 운영 사례 등)가 있다면 함께 제출해 주세요.        🎁 최고의 동료와 함께, 성장에만 집중하세요 (복지 및 문화)   📈 성장을 위한 전폭적인 지원    업무 관련 성장을 위한 식대, 교육, 도서, 소프트웨어 구독 비용은 법인카드로 자율적으로 사용해요.  업계 최고 사양의 장비와 유료 소프트웨어를 지원하며, 회사 인근 주차도 지원해 드려요.  매월 10만 원의 체력단련비와 연 1회 프리미엄 건강검진으로 건강까지 든든하게 챙겨요.    💻 유연하고 효율적인 근무 문화    주 2일 오피스 출근을 기본으로, 나머지 요일은 원격 근무로 유연하게 일해요.  코어타임 외 자율적인 시간 조율, 별도 승인 없는 자율 휴가제로 신뢰 기반의 문화를 만들어요.    💰 성과에 대한 확실한 보상    개인의 기여를 투명하게 반영하여 매년 1회 연봉을 협상해요.  분기별 목표 달성 시 현금 인센티브를 제공하고, 2년마다 유급 리프레시 휴가와 휴가비를 지원해요.         Babechat의 미국 진출을 최전선에서 함께 이끌어 갈 동료를 기다립니다. 많은 지원 부탁드립니다!

title: Front Office Manager
description: Per una realtà alberghiera 4 stelle a gestione familiare, caratterizzata da un approccio fortemente orientato all’ospitalità e alla cura dell’esperienza dell’ospite, siamo alla ricerca di un/una  Front Office Manager . title: Sales & Customer Relationship Manager
description: Kalevala Korun kasvun ytimessä on monikanavainen asiakaskokemus, jossa oma myynti ja vahva jälleenmyyjäverkosto täydentävät toisiaan. Noin 140 jälleenmyyjän verkostomme tuo Kalevalan lähelle kuluttajia ympäri Suomen ja on tärkeässä roolissa rakentamassa brändin tunnettuutta, saavutettavuutta ja asiakaskokemusta. Roolissasi rakennat kasvua yhdessä jälleenmyyjäkumppaneidemme kanssa, kehität asiakkuuksia kaupallisesti kannattavasti sekä vahvistat Kalevalan asemaa jälleenmyyntikanavissa.     Tehtäväsi on tunnistaa uusia myyntimahdollisuuksia, rakentaa yhdessä kumppaneidemme kanssa kaupallisia toimenpiteitä sekä luoda pitkäjänteisiä ja kannattavia asiakassuhteita. title: [쿠팡] CX Program Manager (경력 5년 이상)
description: 회사 소개   쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.  쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.  쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.      직무 소개   CCX Planning 팀은 CX 성과 지표를 관리하고, 조직 목표를 달성하는데 전념합니다. 데이터 기반으로 현재 상황을 분석하고 인사이트를 도출하며, 목표를 달성하기 위한 종합적인 계획을 수립합니다. 주요 이해 관계자와 긴밀히 협력하여 전략적인 솔루션을 제안하고 효과적인 실행을 지원합니다. 또한, 조직의 문화 활동을 지원하여 최고의 조직으로 성장하는데 기여합니다.      업무 내용   CCX performance metrics 수립, 관리, 분석을 통한 insight & action item 도출   고객 여정(Customer Journey) 분석 및 데이터 기반 Pain Point 발굴  CX 개선 프로젝트를 end-to-end로 기획, 실행 및 성과 관리  비즈니스 우선순위를 기반으로 CX 로드맵 수립 및 실행 관리   주요 이해 관계자로부터 비즈니스 우선순위를 명확히 이해하고 목표를 달성할 수 있도록 관련 데이터를 분석을 통해 효과적인 솔루션 제안 및 이행  Ad-hoc 프로젝트성 업무에 참여하여 개발, 데이터, 프로그램, 운영팀 등 여러 부서와의 협업을 통해 프로젝트 추진하여 최고의 고객 경험 창출에 기여      자격   요건    PM / 프로젝트 관리 경력 5년 이상 있으신  디테일에 민감하며 심층 분석에 대한 의지가 있으신 분  분석적이며 구조적인 사고의 보유자로서 여러 데이터에 대한 이해도가 높고 인사이트를 도출하실 수 있는 분  빠르게 변화하는 환경/업무를 즐기고 멀티태스킹이 가능하신 분  능동적인 업무처리하고 항상 기존에 것에 대한 질문을 품고 최적화 하실 수 있는 분  다양한 이해관계자 관리 능력 있으신 분  소비자 지향적 사고방식 지니신 분       우대   사항    재무 / 컨설팅쪽 유관 경력이 있으신 분  프로젝트 기획 / 운영 경험이 있으신 분  비즈니스 영어가 가능하신 분  CS 관련 업무 경험이 있으신 분       전형 절차 및 안내 사항    전형절차    서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격  전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.  전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.    참고사항    본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.  지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.  취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.  직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.  채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.  고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.    개인정보 처리방침    쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다. https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy/    서류 반환 정책    본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.  당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.  위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.  당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.  단, 위 1

title: Delivery & Project Manager
description: Kan du holde mange initiativer i luften på én gang, uden at tabe overblikket?      Comm2ig søger en Delivery & Project Manager til vores Services & Delivery organisation. Vores serviceforretning er i vækst, og vi udvider leveranceorganisationen for at følge med efterspørgslen fra både nye og eksisterende kunder.     Du bliver omdrejningspunktet, når en aftale går fra salg til leverance. Du får også en central rolle i, hvordan vores serviceportefølje udvikler sig.      Om jobbet:   Som Delivery & Project Manager driver du en portefølje af kundeleverancer og interne initiativer parallelt. Det er ikke ét stort projekt ad gangen; det er typisk fem til ti forløb i forskellige faser, som alle skal holdes i bevægelse. Du arbejder tæt sammen med salg, koordinatorer og de tekniske specialister i vores organisation.      Primære ansvarsområder:    Drive onboarding af nye kunder på vores managed services fra kontrakt til stabil drift  Lede implementerings- og udrulningsprojekter hos kunder  Være kundens primære kontaktpunkt i leverancefasen  Holde styr på scope, tidsplan, økonomi og fremdrift på tværs af din portefølje  Drive og bidrage til design og videreudvikling af services sammen med vores tekniske specialister  Sikre at nye services er klar til at blive leveret i skala, inden de går på markedet  Understøtte salgsorganisationen med leveranceperspektiv i tilbud og kundedialog  Identificere muligheder for at udvide samarbejdet med eksisterende kunder       Hvem er vi?   Comm2ig er blandt Danmarks største leverandører af it-infrastruktur og samarbejder med nogle af landets mest betydningsfulde private og offentlige organisationer. Vi er i dag omkring 170 medarbejdere fordelt på vores lokationer i Allerød, Aarhus V, Svenstrup J. og Kokkedal. Med en omsætning på ~1.5 mia. kroner i seneste regnskabsår står vi stærkt i markedet.      Arbejdssted   Stillingen besættes med primært arbejdssted i  Aarhus  eller  Svenstrup J . Der må påregnes rejseaktivitet til kunder og til vores øvrige lokationer.      Vi tilbyder    En central rolle i en serviceforretning i vækst  Bred kontaktflade til kunder, salg, tekniske specialister og koordinatorer  Reel indflydelse på, hvordan vores serviceportefølje udvikler sig  Et fagligt stærkt miljø med høj trivsel og uformelt arbejdsmiljø  Fleksibilitet i hverdagen og plads til at præge både stillingen og vores løsninger       Er det dig?   Du har bred erfaring med it-leverancer og nok teknisk fundament til at tale med både specialister og kunder uden en oversætter. Du behøver ikke selv kunne bygge løsningen. Du skal kunne gennemskue den, udfordre den og forklare den. Du trives med mange bolde i luften og med at prioritere skarpt, når noget skal vente.      Kompetencer    Erfaring med projektledelse og leverance af it-løsninger eller services, gerne fra leverandør- eller MSP-side  Projektledelsesværktøjskassen i orden – og pragmatisk sans for, hvor meget metode den enkelte opgave kræver  Kommerciel forståelse: du ka

title: Asiakkuusvastaava
description: Kasvun myötä haemme nyt Fennoalle toista aktiivista ja kasvuhaluista  Asiakkuusvastaavaa  kokoaikaiseen ja vakituiseen tehtävään. Tehtävä sopii hyvin kaupallisen uransa alkuvaiheessa olevalle henkilölle. Olisitko sinä etsimämme hiomaton timantti kasvamaan osaksi kokenutta ja ammattitaitoista asiakkuustiimiämme?💎   Mistä tehtävässä on kyse? 🔍   Tehtävässä toimit sinulle nimetyn portfolion ensisijaisena yhteyshenkilönä ja vastaat asiakkuuksien tyytyväisyydestä sekä kasvattamisesta. Portfoliosi koostuu jo olemassa olevista asiakkaista, joihin olet aktiivisesti yhteydessä etäkanavia hyödyntäen (puhelin, Teams ja sähköposti), tarjoten heille apua ja lisäarvoa. Analysoit saatavilla olevaa tietoa ja hyödynnät tunnuslukuja sekä AI:ta asiakkuuksien hoitamisessa. Asiakastyön lisäksi rooliin kuuluu sisäisissä projekteissa työskentely ja avustaminen esim. viestiliikeenteeseen liittyvissä tehtävissä.  Asiakkuuksien hoitaminen on kuitenkin tiimityötä ja saatkin selkänojaksi työllesi esihenkilön sekä erittäin osaavan 8 hengen asiakkuustiimin tuen. Tässä tehtävässä sinulla on loistava mahdollisuus kehittyä, oppia uutta ja kasvaa tulevaisuudessa kohti laajempia vastuita.   Millaisia taitoja ja osaamista arvostamme?   Tehtävässä hyvin menestymistä pohjustaa soveltuva koulutustausta (esim. KTM tai Tradenomi) sekä mahdollinen aikaisempi työkokemus B2B-kentästä asiakkuudenhoidon ja/tai myynnin tehtävien parista. Aiempi työkokemus vastaavista tehtävistä ei kuitenkaan ole välttämätöntä, vaan etsimme ennen kaikkea henkilöä, joka on valmis oppimaan ja kasvamaan tehtävässä.  Tärkeimpiä ominaisuuksia, mitä toivomme sinulta, ovat proaktiivisuus, asiakaslähtöinen työskentelyote, erinomaiset vuorovaikutustaidot ja halu kehittyä. Olet vahva tiimipelaaja ja näet, että asiakkuuksien menestyksekäs hoitaminen on tiimityötä. Olet analyyttinen ja kiinnostunut hyödyntämään aktiivisesti myös dataa ja AI:ta asiakkuuksien hoitamisessa. Lisäksi aito kiinnostus seurata toimialan trendejä ja halu oppia uutta auttaa sinua menestymään.   Mistä lähdetään liikkeelle?   Haluamme varmistaa, että saat parhaan mahdollisen startin ja ensimmäinen askel perehdytysjakson jälkeen onkin Fennoan tuotteeseen ja tilitoimistomarkkinaan tutustuminen.  Fennoalla et jää yksin: tukenasi ovat tiiminvetäjä ja Asiakkuusjohtajamme Jesse, kokenut asiakkuustiimi sekä muut loistavat myynti- ja markkinointiosastomme kollegat, jotka kaikki auttavat ja sparraavat sinua matkan varrella.  Asiakkuusvastaavan palkkamalli koostuu kuukausipalkasta (3000-3500€/kk) sekä tavoitteisiin perustuvasta kvartaalibonuksesta, mikä antaa sinulle mahdollisuuden kasvattaa ansioitasi oman menestyksesi perusteella.   Miksi Fennoa?   Fennoa on täysin etäorganisaatio, joten meillä voit työskennellä mistä päin Suomea tahansa. Tarjoamme kotitoimistollesi kaiken tarvittavan sähköpöydästä langattomiin kuulokkeisiin ja maksamme myös kodin internet-yhteytesi, jotta työskentely olisi mahdollisimman sujuvaa missä tahansa oletkin. title: Customer Success Lead till Svea Billing Services
description: Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens kundupplevelse inom Billing Services? Vi befinner oss i en spännande förändringsresa där vi stärker vårt erbjudande, utvecklar våra arbetssätt och bygger en ännu mer kundfokuserad organisation. Nu söker vi en Customer Success Lead som vill ta en central roll i att utveckla kundresan, skapa struktur och säkerställa att våra kunder får maximalt värde av våra lösningar.  Det här är inte en traditionell Customer Success-roll, utan vi söker dig som kombinerar strategisk höjd med operativ handlingskraft och som trivs med att driva förändring genom samarbete och inflytande.   Om rollen   Som Customer Success Lead ansvarar du för att utveckla och samordna kundarbetet genom hela kundresan, från onboarding och implementation till långsiktig kundutveckling, retention och ökat kundvärde. Du kommer att jobba nära den kommersiella verksamheten, produktorganisationen och utvecklingsteamet. Rollen innebär såväl deltagande i det dagliga kundbemötandet och operativa arbetet, liksom fokus på att skapa effektiva arbetssätt, förbättra kundupplevelsen och säkerställa att vi arbetar proaktivt med våra kunder. Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden:    Utveckla kundresan och stärka kundvärdet genom hela kundlivscykeln.  Driva kundutveckling i nära samarbete med affär, produkt och utveckling.  Identifiera och prioritera initiativ som ökar kundnöjdhet och lojalitet.  Omsätta kundinsikter till förbättrade erbjudanden, processer och arbetssätt.  Bygga struktur, uppföljning och KPI:er för ett datadrivet kundarbete     Vem är du?   För att lyckas i rollen är du en prestigelös person som trivs med att växla mellan strategiskt utvecklingsarbete och operativt genomförande. Du är drivande och initiativtagande, tar ansvar för att föra arbetet framåt och ser vad som behöver göras utan att invänta instruktioner.  Du är också en naturlig lagspelare som bygger förtroende, skapar engagemang och får människor att samarbeta mot gemensamma mål. Samtidigt har du ett analytiskt och lösningsorienterat förhållningssätt, där du identifierar förbättringsmöjligheter och omsätter idéer till konkreta resultat.    Minst 5 års relevant erfarenhet inom Customer Success, Customer Experience (CX) eller liknande område  Erfarenhet från SaaS-, tech- eller produktbolag  Erfarenhet av onboarding, implementation och kundutveckling  Förmåga att arbeta tvärfunktionellt mellan kund, affär, produkt och teknik  Erfarenhet av att utveckla processer, arbetssätt och kundflöden  Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift    Det är meriterande om du även har:    Erfarenhet av fintech, betalningslösningar eller närliggande branscher  Erfarenhet av projektledning eller implementeringsprojekt  Erfarenhet av kundnöjdhetsarbete, retention och användardata  Erfarenhet av att leda genom inflytande utan formellt personalansvar  Kunskaper i norska eller finska      Om Svea     Svea Bank är en finansiell koncern med över 2000 anställda och verksamhet i fle

title: Yhteyspäällikkö, Kuopio
description: Mandatum on rahan ja hengen erikoisosaamisen yhdistävä merkittävä finanssipalvelujen tarjoaja. Yhtiö tarjoaa asiakkailleen laajan valikoiman palveluita kattaen omaisuuden- ja varainhoidon, säästämisen ja sijoittamisen, palkitsemisen ja sitouttamisen, eläkeaikaan varautumisen sekä henkilövakuuttamisen. Mandatumin liiketoiminnan menestyksen keskiössä ovat osaava henkilöstö, vahva brändi ja onnistuminen sijoitustoiminnassa.       Mandatumissa panostetaan inspiroivaan ja hyvinvoivaan työyhteisöön ja toimitaan yhtenä joukkueena. Työ meillä on tavoitteellista, mielenkiintoista ja täynnä haasteita. Monipuolisissa tehtävissämme työskentelee yli 600 innostunutta ja kehittymisestään kiinnostunutta rahan ja hengen ammattilaista.       Haluatko rakentaa pitkäaikaisia asiakassuhteita ja luoda kasvua? Hae yhteyspäälliköksi Kuopioon ja tule rakentamaan menestystä yhdessä asiakkaidemme kanssa.       Sinun roolisi      Yhteyspäällikön tehtävässä toimit yritysasiakkaidemme luotettuna kumppanina auttaen heitä hyödyntämään Mandatumin asiantuntemusta riski- ja eläkevakuuttamisen, varainhoidon sekä henkilöstön palkitsemisen ratkaisuissa. Asiakkaasi koostuvat yrittäjistä sekä pienistä ja keskisuurista yrityksistä, ja työsi painottuu aktiiviseen asiakashankintaan, asiakkuuksien kehittämiseen ja pitkäjänteisten kumppanuuksien rakentamiseen.     Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä Mandatumin asiantuntijoiden kanssa, kuten yksityisvarainhoitajien, palkitsemiskonsulttien ja juristien kanssa. Vastaat asiakkaiden tarpeiden tunnistamisesta ja oikeiden asiantuntijoiden osallistamisesta asiakkuuksien kehittämiseen.      Onnistumisen edellytykset      Olet tavoitteellinen ja asiakaslähtöinen myynnin ammattilainen, joka innostuu uusien mahdollisuuksien löytämisestä ja asiakkaiden liiketoiminnan ymmärtämisestä. Sinulla on näyttöjä tuloksellisesta myyntityöstä sekä halu kehittää osaamistasi finanssialan asiantuntijaympäristössä.     Lisäksi toivomme, että   sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva kaupallinen koulutus  hahmotat laajoja kokonaisuuksia ja osaat esittää ne selkeästi  sinulla on erinomaiset vuorovaikutus-, kuuntelu- ja esiintymistaidot  työskentelet oma-aloitteisesti ja viet asioita määrätietoisesti eteenpäin  nautit asiakaskohtaamisista ja aktiivisesta asiakastyöstä.       Johda urasi Mandatumiin       Panostamme palkittuun työntekijäkokemukseemme. Mandatum on valittu useasti Great Place to Work -tutkimuksessa Suomen parhaiden työpaikkojen joukkoon suurten organisaatioiden sarjassa ja on viime vuosina ansainnut Siqni-henkilöstökyselyyn perustuvan Future Workplaces -sertifikaatin erinomaisesta työntekijäkokemuksesta.  Osaamispääoman kasvattaminen. Tuemme työtä huolellisella perehdytyksellä ja jatkuvalla osaamisen kehittämisellä. Tukenasi on valmentava esihenkilö sekä positiivinen ja motivoitunut tiimi.   Työyhteisössämme positiivisuus ja tekemisen asenne tarttuu. Menestyäksemme tarvitsemme toisiamme ja ammattitaitoisia kollegoita. Työskentelemme joustavassa hybridityömallissa

title: Head of Account Management
description: Om JP/Politikens Hus og Business Media   JP/Politikens Hus er en af Skandinaviens førende medievirksomheder og tæller udgivelser som Politiken, Jyllands-Posten, Ekstra Bladet, samt Politikens Forlag, Saxo og distributionsvirksomheden Dao. JP/Politiken Business Media er en særskilt forretningsenhed i JP/Politikens Hus med omkring 500 medarbejdere. Vi er et  house of brands  og driver en vifte af digitale, abonnementsbaserede titler, herunder Watch Medier, Finans, Marketwire, Dezeen og senest Altinget og Mandag Morgen. Vores titler og vidensprodukter henvender sig til professionelle aktører i erhvervslivet i hele Norden samt i Tyskland og UK. Til en ny kommerciel rolle i Århus søges en:      Head of Account Management   Vil du stå i spidsen for at udvikle en moderne og datadrevet Account Management organisation med fokus på at fastholde og vækste nogle af JP/Politiken Business Medias største kunder? Og motiveres du af muligheden for at præge processer, målepunkter, organisation og ledelse? Så kan denne nye rolle hos JP/Politiken Business Media være et naturligt næste karriereskridt for dig.  JP/Politiken Business Media søger en ambitiøs kommerciel leder, der kan løfte arbejdet med kunder på tværs af Danmark, Norge og Sverige. Du får ansvaret for Account Growth på tværs af Watch Medier, Finans, MarketWire og Monitor Medier med fokus på at fastholde kunder, udvikle relationerne og skabe vækst gennem øget penetration, upsell og cross-sell.     Forretningen har gennem de senere år gennemgået en markant kommerciel transformation fra klassisk mediesalg mod skalerbare abonnements-, data- og enterpriseforretninger. Det stiller nye krav til arbejdet med kunder, data og kommercielle processer.      En central rolle i udviklingen af Account Management   Som Head of Account Management bliver din vigtigste opgave at udvikle en professionel og skalerbar Account Management organisation, hvor processer, systemer og data understøtter en systematisk udvikling af eksisterende kunder. Du får 10-15 medarbejdere i direkte reference på tværs af tre lande og betydelig mulighed for at sætte dit eget præg på organisationen, arbejdsmetoderne og den kommercielle tilgang.     En central del af rollen bliver at videreudvikle Account Management processer, CRM-governance, pipeline management, forecast og KPI-strukturer. Du skal definere best practice og arbejdsmetoder, og samtidig sikre en mere strategisk udvikling af de største kunder gennem segmentering, stakeholder mapping og account plans.     Brugerdata, abonnementsmønstre og kundeindsigter bliver vigtige værktøjer til at identificere potentialet hos den enkelte kunde. Det kan eksempelvis være virksomheder med høj organisk brug, hvor der er mulighed for større udbredelse eller for at udvikle individuelle abonnementer til bredere virksomheds- og koncernløsninger.     Du arbejder tæt sammen med New Sales, Marketing, BI, Customer Success og de øvrige kommercielle teams. Rollen er derfor både en ledelses-, udviklings- og tra

title: Head of Support Excellence & Transformation
description: Department:  Customer Support   Employment Type:  Permanent   Location:  Madrid   Reporting To:  Christian Wolf   Description    About osapiens   osapiens helps global companies build transparent, compliant, and sustainable supply chains.  Our platform powers 2 500 + enterprise clients — from leading DAX and S&P 500 companies, to key players in manufacturing, to most major retailers, and all the way down the supply chains to cacao farmers in some of the most remote regions of the world.  If our systems are down, imports into Europe could halt, production lines across industries would stop, and thousands of trucks could no longer deliver worldwide. Our holistic platform for supply-chain transparency, resilience, and automation helps businesses grow responsibly — with sustainability and scalability always in focus.  That’s why our Support organization is mission-critical. When we perform well, global supply chains keep moving; and sustainability goals become reality.   The Challenge   Our Support team currently handles around 2000 tickets per month, ranging from simple knowledge questions to production-critical incidents.  As osapiens continues to scale rapidly, your mission is to decouple customer growth and solution adoption from ticket and FTE growth, by transforming Support into an intelligent, automated, and continuously improving organization. This is not a typical maintenance role, it’s a transformation mission and mandate.  Your Responsibilities     Lead & Inspire: Build and develop a high-performing global Support team that thrives on ownership, learning, and customer obsession.    Transform & Automate: Redesign processes, implement automation, and build scalable systems that absorb growth efficiently.    Drive Deflection: Reduce repetitive tickets by steering customers toward documentation, refining the AI support assistant, and expanding self-service.    Eliminate Root Causes: Analyze ticket data, identify recurring drivers, and translate insights into concrete improvements for Product, Delivery, and Engineering.    Operational Excellence: Define and track KPIs (MTTR, CSAT, deflection, backlog, SLA compliance); lead weekly performance reviews.    Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Customer Success, Delivery, Product management and Development, and our platform teams, to ensure seamless handovers and issue prevention.    Lead in Crises: Act as the calm, structured, and transparent leader, both customers and teams rely on during major incidents and change processes.    Continuous Improvement: Embed retrospectives, feedback loops, and measurable experiments that raise the bar every month.     Your Experience    7+ years’ experience in Digital Transformation, Process Excellence, or Customer / Support Operations, ideally in SaaS or enterprise technology.   Background in strategic consulting roles focused on (Digital) Transformation. Ideally from leading IT-transformation consultancies or high-growth tech scale

Le vrai problème, c'est que les équipes IT sont trop débordées pour vérifier en continu que les bons réflexes sont en place, surtout dans les ETI qui ont l'infrastructure d'un grand groupe et les ressources cyber d'une PME.  Résultat : les équipes passent 80 % de leur temps à mettre en place des contrôles de sécurité et seulement 20 % à corriger les failles.      HARVEN inverse ce ratio  : nos agents IA surveillent en continu, repèrent les failles avant qu'elles soient exploitées et les corrigent automatiquement.     Derrière HARVEN, deux fondateurs experts :  Arthur Auclair  et Pierrick Filippi, choisis par le startup studio  CyGO-Entrepreneurs  (co-fondé par Aurélie Clerc, ex-FDJ, et Laurent Hausermann, ex-Sentryo/Arkoon), qui ne finance que  2 startups par an . On a lancé l'activité et bouclé notre première levée début d'année, on onboarde de nouveaux clients chaque mois, et on vise un  x10 sur les 18 prochains mois .     Votre rôle : faire de HARVEN un indispensable pour nos clients  Notre produit est packagé : le dernier client a été onboardé en  30 minutes , avec des résultats en 1-2 heures et un taux de transformation POC → client de  75-80 % . La valeur ne se joue donc pas sur la technique, elle se joue sur la  relation, l'adoption et la satisfaction .     On cherche la personne qui pilote chaque client du kick-off au run, qui s'assure qu'il tire un maximum de valeur d'HARVEN, et qui construit au passage nos process et nos outils en mode  IA-native . Un rôle clé, au contact direct des clients comme des fondateurs.     C'est un poste business : tu es le  client interne  de la tech et du produit (tu testes, tu remontes les frictions à Pierrick), et tu relaies les opportunités à Arthur sans être commercial toi-même.  Les missions:   1. Déploiement & onboarding -> 25 %     Garant du déploiement  de chaque client, du kick-off au run : tu possèdes le compte de bout en bout.  Piloter l' onboarding packagé  : checklist interne , prérequis validés avant le kick-off, suivi serré derrière. L'objectif pour minimiser le time-to-value en heures et assurer une adoption maximale dans la durée.  Superviser la  mise en service des sources  présence des sources, qualité de la donnée entrante, accompagnement à la  configuration .   Animer les kick-offs  : objectifs, agenda, créneaux de weekly et de COPIL calés, compte-rendu d'actions envoyé derrière.   Systématiser et outiller le playbook de déploiement avec de l'IA  pour le rendre scalable.    2. Relation, adoption & satisfaction -> 30 %    Garder un contact régulier avec chaque client,  créer une vraie relation de confiance  et animer COPIL et QBR. title: Responsable Déploiement / Implementation Manager
description: Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.  Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.  Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.   🧩 Notre équipe Customer Operations   Chez Lifen, nous déployons nos solutions dans les hôpitaux de toute la France pour améliorer le quotidien des soignants et la qualité des soins.  L'équipe Customer Operations est le pont entre nos produits et les établissements de santé. Nous accompagnons chaque hôpital de A à Z dans l'implémentation de nos solutions : Lifen Documents & Lifen Intégration. title: Engagement Manager
location: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: Please do not contact us or apply if you are a recruiter, consultant or outsourcing company.    Deliver with focus. Scale with intent 🚀   Are you a delivery leader who knows how to guide enterprise customers through complex set-ups without over-engineering the journey? Do you care deeply about building scalable, repeatable SaaS delivery rather than one-off custom projects?  At Performativ, we’re building the infrastructure layer for modern wealth management. As our Engagement Manager, you’ll lead the enterprise rollout of our SaaS platform helping customers onboard successfully through structured delivery, clear communication, and lightweight technical engagement.  This is not a professional services consulting role. You won’t be buried in endless customer-specific code or heavy customizations. Instead, you’ll work cross-functionally to help customers adopt our product the right way: cleanly, securely, and in line with platform best practices so they can scale on top of us, not around us.   What You Will Do     Own enterprise set-up programs end to end (kick-off through go-live and hyper-care) against an agreed plan and scope (Statement of Work).  Enable customers to integrate Performativ via standard platform patterns (APIs, SSO, configuration) without custom buildouts, working with product and engineering to flag gaps early and advocate for scalable paths.  Own plan, scope, and change control, keeping scope tied to contract and change visible and decided rather than quietly absorbed, and support the Technical Program Lead on requirements, design documents, and acceptance-criteria sign-off.  Run customer communication, cadence, and governance with reporting that keeps meetings short, and manage risk, dependency, and issue tracking (including customer-side).  Lead a clean handover to Customer Success at go-live or hyper-care exit, including train-the-trainer sessions and supporting materials.  Represent the program in internal capacity and exception reviews, bringing requests the plan cannot absorb back as options rather than committing on the spot.  Build repeatable playbooks, documentation, and artefacts that make the next program faster. You will be measured on this, not only on your own delivery.     How You Will Work   You will run multiple programs at once, in a delivery pod alongside the Technical Program Lead, Integration Engineers, Data Migration Specialists, and Product Engineers. None report to you. Rather you get things done through clarity and relationships, not authority. You will report to the COO. This is an in-office role based at our Copenhagen office.   What We're Looking For     7+ years in program or engagement management, consulting, product management, or another delivery-facing role, with a track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder implementations end to end. description: Enterprise Bot is the leading provider of GenAI, Conversational AI, and automation software, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland. Our mission is to become the world’s #1 AI-driven automation software provider within the next five years.   We work with leading companies such as the SIX Group (Swiss Stock Exchange), SWICA, Generali, and others to enhance customer interactions and automate business processes using our cutting-edge Conversational AI technology.   Our global team includes more than 70 highly skilled professionals from diverse backgrounds.   We foster an open, progressive company culture with state-of-the-art technology and flat hierarchies. At Enterprise Bot, you’ll experience a unique blend of passion, purpose, challenge, and fun.    Tasks    As  a Customer Success Manager  in our conversational AI company, you won't just manage customer accounts – you'll guide them through the entire lifecycle: from discovery and implementation to measurable success with our AI solutions. Your blend of technical expertise, problem-solving skills, and relationship-building talent ensures that customers not only adopt our products but also grow successfully with them. Solution Implementer : Work closely with customers and internal teams to configure conversational AI bots, automation workflows, and integrations – tailored to the specific use cases and business objectives of the customers.    Testing & QA advocate : Coordinate and oversee UAT (User Acceptance Testing), ensure the quality of the bots, fix problems, and guide customers through test iterations until the solutions meet the agreed standards.    Optimization partner : Continuously monitor bot performance and customer feedback. Suggest improvements, automation optimizations, and best practices to increase efficiency and ROI.    Engagement Conductor : Keep customer relationships active and proactive. Conduct regular business reviews, analyze performance reports, and ensure customers achieve their goals.    Relationship architect : Build strong, long-term relationships – as a basis for trust, success and mutual growth.    Adoption catalyst : Conduct training, enablement workshops and documentation to empower customer teams to use our tools effectively and independently.    Feedback Loop Coordinator : Translate customer feedback and needs into concrete recommendations for action and work closely with the product and engineering teams to further develop our solutions. title: Plasma Microwave Modelling Physicist (ECRH, Gyrotrons)
description:
Proxima Fusion is hiring an Alpha Plasma Microwave Modeler in Munich to own the physics simulation pipeline connecting our gyrotron sources to plasma performance. You will model the propagation, polarization and absorption of millimeter waves in the Alpha stellarator, running ray-tracing and beam-tracing codes such as TRAVIS and RAYTRAX and validating against W7-X experimental data to drive the design of the Alpha ECRH launcher. You will model Electron Cyclotron Current Drive and build Python post-processing pipelines. It suits physicists with hands-on experience of an EC propagation or absorption code.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Run ray-tracing and beam-tracing simulations of EC wave propagation and absorption using codes such as TRAVIS, RAYTRAX and more complex beam or full wave model codes

  • Develop an integrated modeling framework that couples wave deposition to transport codes, enabling temperature and density profile optimization and validation of the heating scenario performance

  • Build and maintain Python-based post-processing pipelines to automate scenario scanning and interface simulation outputs with the Alpha integrated design framework

  • Model Electron Cyclotron Current Drive (ECCD) and assess its ability to modify rotational transform and equilibrium in the Alpha quasi-isodynamic configuration

  • Contribute to design reviews, interface control documents, and technical reports to ensure simulation results are traceable and actionable

WHO YOU ARE

  • PhD (or equivalent demonstrated expertise) in plas

title: M&A Intern (m/w/d) Frankfurt am Main
description:

Saxenhammer ist eine international tätige M&A-Boutique, die sich auf Mittelstands- und Wachstumsunternehmen spezialisiert hat. Wir beraten in den Bereichen M&A sowie Debt Financing und unterstützen unsere Klienten, maßgeblich Unternehmer, Gesellschafter und Konzerne, bei der Durchführung von Unternehmensverkäufen und -zukäufen, Kapitalerhöhungen und Finanzierungen.

Mit über 450 erfolgreich abgeschlossenen Transaktionen haben wir in sämtlichen Industrien umfangreiches Branchen-Know-how aufgebaut und entwickeln mit unseren Kollegen in Berlin, München, Frankfurt und der Schweiz zielgenaue Lösungen für unsere Klienten.

title: Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
What we are building

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.


Why This Role Matters

You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to make sure that traffic lands reliably, moves through the system in a shape other teams can build on, and keeps doing so as the number of sites grows.
You join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.

What you will work on

  • Event streaming. Kafka is the spine of the system. You own topic and schema design, partitioning, retention and delivery semantics  and the everyday reality behind them: consumers falling behind, replays, backfills, late and duplicated readings.
  • Backend services in TypeScript. The ingestion services, integrations and APIs around that stream. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is turning that variety into one consistent interface the product squads can rely on.
  • Cloud infrastructure on GCP. Compute, networking, IAM, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability. The goal is a paved road: other engineers ship and debug their own services without going through you.
  • Technical direction. You are senior enough to set it. Where we invest in the platform, what we standardise, what we deliberately leave rough for now  and bringing the rest of the team along with it.

title: Senior Embedded Linux Engineer (all genders) - Yocto · Python · IoT Edge
description:
This position sits close to the embedded world, but it isn't traditional microcontroller firmware work. You'll own the operating system foundation and platform layer of our IoT devices - building and evolving our next-generation embedded Linux image - and develop the Python application layer that runs on top of it, inside our dockerized main application.

You'll work down at the OS and hardware boundary while shipping features up in the application layer. Typical areas include:

  • Designing and maintaining our Yocto-based Linux distribution for ARM devices with limited compute

  • Security on device, inter-process communication, networking, scheduling, observation

  • Over-the-air (OTA) updates for both the OS and applications

  • Integrating peripherals - watchdog, modem, AI accelerator - and improving their observability

  • Bridging the system layer and the application layer through Python and Bash

The work spans from driver- and kernel-level integration in C/C++, to adapting our Linux distribution with Yocto to the underlying hardware layer, to debugging system-level failures such as memory leaks, up to writing the Python software that turns hardware capabilities into product features.

You will be expected to pass a live coding interview for this role.

What to expect

  • Embedded Linux Platform: Design, build, and continuously evolve the next generation of our Yocto-based Linux distribution for ARM-powered IoT

title: Founders Associate - CEO Office (m/f/d) - AI health-tech
description:
🎤 Founders Associate - a letter from the person you'd work with

Most job ads are written by no one, for everyone. I want to do this differently.

I'm Marius, Chief of Staff at voize. This role reports to me, and whoever takes it will work more closely with me than anyone else in the company. So instead of a template, here's what this job is, how I work, and how you can decide whether you'd want to work with me.

💡 What this job actually is

voize is growing fast, and fast-growing companies produce a specific kind of work: topics that matter but belong to no one. A new market needs operational groundwork. An org-wide process needs to be built. A decision needs a sharp analysis behind it. We're building a CEO Office to own exactly this work. You'd be its first hire.

title: Control System Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Your role

You’ll shape how our robots move, sense, and respond, turning control theory into real-world performance

You’ll push existing products further and bring new prototypes to life with both state-of-the-art and experimental methods. In practice, that means:

Your experience and qualifications

  • 3+ years as a control system engineer or mathematician

Intro

Du willst nach dem Studium oder deiner Ausbildung praktisch durchstarten, hast Lust, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten, und suchst ein Umfeld, in dem du von Anfang an mit anpackst und wirklich etwas lernst? Dann steig als Trainee Buchhaltung & Office Management (m/w/d) bei uns ein und unterstütze unser Team in Berlin an der Schnittstelle zwischen Buchhaltung, Office Management und CEO Support!Wir empfangen dich in einem Team, das sich gerne neuen Herausforderungen stellt, dich Schritt für Schritt einarbeitet und dir echte Verantwortung überträgt, sobald du dich sicher fühlst.Wir besetzen diese Position zunächst befristet für ein Jahr, da eine Kollegin aus unserem Team für einige Monate eine berufliche Auszeit nimmt. Im Anschluss schauen wir gemeinsam, wie eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit aussehen kann.Idealerweise startest du zum 1. oder 15. Oktober, damit genug Zeit für eine gute Einarbeitung und Übergabe bleibt.


Deine Aufgaben bei reisetopia

reisetopia ist in den vergangenen Jahren deutlich gewachsen. Als Trainee lernst du dabei nach und nach, worauf es in dieser vielseitigen Position ankommt – ein gutes Auge für Zahlen, Struktur und Prozesse. Du wirst von unserem Team eng begleitet und wächst Schritt für Schritt in folgende Bereiche hinein:

Buchhaltung & Finanzadministration

  • Vorbereitende Buchhaltung: Erfassung, Prüfung und Zuordnung von Belegen in Datev
  • Tägliches Monitoring unserer Bankkonten und Zahlungseingänge sowie Pflege unserer Liquiditätsplanung

  • Übertragung und Aufbereitung der BWA in enger Abstimmung mit unserem CEO
  • Bearbeitung von Reisekostenabrechnungen und Einsammeln von Belegen aus dem Team
Office Management & Unternehmensadministration
  • Organisation von Events und internen Team-A

title: Werkstudent PR & Marketing (m/w/d)
description:
Was dich erwartet

Der erste Eindruck von uns entsteht auf einer Messe, in einem LinkedIn-Beitrag oder in einer Bewertung. Bisher kümmert sich niemand gezielt darum – ab jetzt du. Als Werkstudent PR & Marketing (m/w/d) verantwortest du unseren Außenauftritt eigenständig, in direkter Abstimmung mit unserem CSO. 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du betreust unsere Messeauftritte – von der Vorbereitung über die Umsetzung vor Ort bis zur Nachbereitung.
  • Einmal pro Woche geht ein fachlicher LinkedIn-Beitrag raus. Du entwickelst ihn von der Idee über den Text bis zum fertigen Post.
  • Unser Bild in Bewertungsportalen liegt in deiner Hand – Google und Trustpilot im Blick, Themen daraus ableiten.
  • Du bringst unsere Marke auch nach innen: von kleinen Employer Branding Projekten bis zu den sichtbaren Details im Büro.
  • Du entwickelst eigene Ideen, wo wir sonst noch sichtbar werden sollten, und bringst sie zur Umsetzung.


Was du mitbringst

  • Du studierst Marketing, Kommunikation, Medien, PR oder etwas Vergleichbares.
  • Du hast in diesem Bereich bereits praktisch gearbeitet – Praktikum, Werkstudententätigkeit oder eine vergleichbare Station. Diese Stelle ist kein Einstieg zum Reinschnuppern.
  • Du schreibst sicher auf Deutsch und triffst dabei unterschiedliche Tonalitäten; Englisch ist ein Plus.
  • Du hast ein Auge für Gestaltung und merkst, wenn etwas nicht sauber aussieht.
  • Du kannst 16–20 Stunden pro Woche einbringen und bist regelmäßig bei uns im Büro.


Was wir versprechen

Arbeitsumgebung & Flexibilität

  • Office-First Company
  • Modernes, klimatisiertes Büro mit viel Tageslicht
  • Zentrale Lage zwischen Gleisdreieck und Potsdamer Platz mit sehr guter Anbindung
  • Große Dachterrasse mit Blick über Berlin
  • Arbeitszeiten nach deinem Stundenplan, in Klausurenphase

title: (Senior) AI Product Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
What You'll Do

You’ll identify open AI opportunities, build them from start to finish, and bring them to real users. As a Senior AI Product Engineer, you’ll work across our three product squads: You’ll single-handedly turn unaddressed topics into products, hand them off once they’re up and running, and serve as a sparring partner for the squad PMs on all AI-related topics. For us, “senior” refers to your approach to work, not your years of experience. You’ll report directly to Product Leadership.

Your Responsibilities

  • Independent AI projects (about half of your time)
  • You’ll identify high-impact AI opportunities in our legal workflows - in areas where no specific squad is responsible
  • Validation happens quickly: discussions with attorneys, Legal Ops, and insurers; prototypes built in days
  • You’ll bring the winning solutions into production yourself: routing, chaining, summarization, and agent-based loops
  • You’ll hand off mature features to the squad - complete with documentation, evaluations, and a handover plan
Support for the squads (the other half)
  • Feasibility, costs, model selection, risks: You’ll answer these questions before every AI feature is launched
  • You support the teams in designing evaluations, golden datasets, and guardrails
  • You review concepts before they go into the roadmap - including prompt injection and compliance risks (GDPR, Section 203 of the German Criminal Code)
  • You advance AI best practices: prompt engineering standards, LLM observability, and agent-based coding workflows


What you bring

Must-have

  • Multiple production-ready AI/LLM systems that you’ve shipped to real users and taken responsibility for - no prototypes
  • Demonstrable product ownership: from a vague problem to a finished product
  • Strong Python skills and a solid foundation in software engin

title: Merchant Success Associate
description: About KPay Group      KPay Group (KPay) is a leading fintech company empowering businesses of all sizes with simple, smart, seamless, and secure technology solutions. Serving over  95,000 merchants  across  Hong Kong, Singapore, Japan, and Australia , we help small and medium-sized businesses grow through a one-stop platform for financial management, operations, and digital transformation.  In 2024, KPay secured  USD 55 million in Series A funding —the largest fundraising globally in the payments sector that year. You will work closely with merchants while also handling  transaction data, CRM updates, and basic reporting  to monitor performance and identify issues early. title: Specialist Account Management (m/w/d)
description: Standort:  Berlin, Hamburg oder Remote   Arbeitsmodell:  Hybrid    Über Affinity    Affinity ist ein globales AdTech-Unternehmen mit über 600 Mitarbeitenden in Europa, den USA und Asien. Aufgaben  Als  Specialist   Account Management  bist du die Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden und internen Teams. Du begleitest Kampagnen, analysierst Ergebnisse und unterstützt Kunden dabei, unsere Produkte  Opinary  und  mCanvas  erfolgreich einzusetzen.    Deine Aufgaben      Du betreust Kunden im europäischen Markt und bist Ansprechperson für laufende Kampagnen und Projekte   Du unterstützt Kunden bei der Planung und Umsetzung unserer Werbelösungen.   Du analysierst Kampagnen-Ergebnisse und gibst Empfehlungen zu Formaten, KPIs und Optimierungen.   Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Sales Team zusammen, damit Kampagnen reibungslos umgesetzt werden.   Du erkennst Möglichkeiten, Kunden weiterzuentwickeln und zusätzliche Lösungen einzubringen.   Du pflegst CRM-Daten und nutzt Kunden-Insights, um Aktivitäten strukturiert zu begleiten.    Qualifikation     1–2 Jahre Berufserfahrung  im Account Management, Customer Success, Digital Marketing, Media oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.   Erste Erfahrung mit digitalen Kampagnen oder Werbeformaten wie Display, Video, CTV und Rich Media.   Interesse an digitaler Werbung und daran, wie Marken ihre Zielgruppen erreichen.   Eine strukturierte, zuverlässige Arbeitsweise und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden.   Datenaffinität und idealerweise erste Erfahrung mit CRM-Systemen wie  HubSpot  sowie LLMs, wie z. Bsp Claude.   Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.    Benefits    Ein internationales Unternehmen mit über 600 Mitarbeitenden weltweit.   Flexible Arbeitsmöglichkeiten mit Hybrid-Modell – im Büro oder remote.   Viel Eigenverantwortung, kurze Entscheidungswege und Raum für eigene Ideen.   Die Möglichkeit, dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.   Ein internationales Team mit enger Zusammenarbeit über verschiedene Standorte hinweg.     Wir freuen uns auf Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven. Vielfalt, Chancengleichheit und Inklusion sind für uns selbstverständlich.

title: Graduate Customer Success Manager at Dublin Tech Company (€30-45k base salary + Hybrid)
description: Looking for a job is f*cking hard!   You send off tons of applications only to get ghosted by recruiters and to never get any feedback. We understand how tough it is and that’s why we created Tangent - so you can  get help to get hired.        What is Tangent?       Tangent lets you bypass the recruiters by connecting you directly with your future colleagues. They commit their time to mentor you through the job search process, review your CVs, offer career advice, and  refer you into exclusive job opportunities at their company  (that’s recommending you internally to the recruitment team).       How does it work?        Easy Apply - we don’t make you waste time repeating what’s in your CV  Complete your video intro - just 1 question for 1 min  Connect with the Mentors - get referred and coached through the interview process at their company      Did you know?! If you are referred for a job you’re  9x more likely to be hired  vs applying direct on a job board.       The role:          Graduate Customer Success Manager  at one of Dublin's leading tech employers  You'll be responsible for building strong relationships with customers to ensure they achieve their desired outcomes while using a company's product or service. Your role combines  customer support, account management, and proactive engagement  to drive satisfaction, retention, and growth  Experience in  account management, customer support, sales, training, and project management  translates well into a Customer Success role. Strong  relationship-building, problem-solving, and communication skills  are essential. Backgrounds in  consulting, SaaS, or marketing  can also be valuable, especially if they involve helping clients achieve their goals.  Job Type: Full-time  Salary: €30,000.00-€45,000.00 per year        What do I need?        You must be able to work in the Ireland without needing sponsorship/visa  Be able to work in office or hybrid in Dublin  Excited by the opportunity to connect with mentors and get referred       T he companies we work with typically look for people who are:      Highly proactive and willing to learn  Excellent communicators (written or verbally)  Happy working in a fast-paced environment  Natural relationship-builders  Motivated and driven to achieve outcomes

title: Head of Customer Success & Training
description: About YouTrain   YouTrain builds a military XR training platform for armed forces, law enforcement, and emergency responders. Our products – DronAR, TrainAR, BrothAR, ShootAR, DrivAR, and MissionAR – combine immersive environments with real equipment, enabling scalable training for drone operations, tactical shooting, emergency driving, and mission planning. Our customers and partners include the Bundeswehr, BWI, the Cyber Innovation Hub, and Quantum Systems. We are an international, fast-growing team headquartered in the heart of Hamburg – made for those who protect us.   Role   As  Head of Customer Success & Training , you own YouTrain's post-sale customer operating model and lead the deployment, training, and support organization. You turn purchased YouTrain solutions into operational training capabilities that customers—including armed forces, government organizations, and industrial partners—can use independently, pitch-perfectly, and at scale. Our promise is sustained operational adoption and measurable training capability, not just successful hardware and software delivery—and making that promise deliverable across customer sites and deployments is the core of this role.   What You'll Do      Build and lead the post-sale organization:  Hire, develop, and structure Customer Success, Support & Service, and Training teams as the customer volume scales.   Own strategic customer relationships:  Lead successful onboarding, adoption, customer health, retention, and long-term success after commercial handover.   Drive customer deployments:  Own end-to-end rollout and site readiness across hardware, software, and infrastructure for military and government customers.   Build scalable training & support:  Establish standardized onboarding, Train-the-Trainer and instructor enablement programs, as well as support workflows, SLAs, ticketing, and hardware repair processes.   Lead escalations & cross-functional resolution:  Own major customer issues and coordinate resolution with teams like Product and Engineering.   Turn customer insights into product impact:  Build the customer-to-Product feedback loop and translate operational user needs into structured product requirements.   Track customer health & growth:  Build dashboards, run regular customer reviews, monitor key metrics, and identify expansion opportunities with Business Development. description:
Über uns

Wir sehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum der Möglichkeiten. Wir sehen Chancen. Wir sehen die tiefgreifenden Auswirkungen, die unsere Graphen-Lösungen auf die Umgestaltung der Branche habenwerden. Wir laden dich ein, mit uns gemeinsam den Wandel voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Die Vision lautet: Beweise allen, dass du etwasgrundlegend verändern kannst. Beweise mit deinem Wissen und deinen Fähigkeiten, wie Dinge anders gemacht werden können. Gemeinsam können wir das Paradigma, wie die Welt zusammenhängt, verändern

Unsere Technologie

Die wachsende Nachfrage der Halbleiterindustrie nach leistungsfähigeren Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Stromverbrauch findet ihre Lösung in unserer Technologie. Wir verbinden Chips mitComputernetzwerken mit hohem Durchsatz und geringer Verzögerung. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation steigert die Rechenleistung und Effizienz in einer neuenGrößenordnung

Kurz gesagt, wir verbinden Chips zu leistungsstarken und energieeffizienten Netzwerken und überwinden so die Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie mittels unserer Graphenlösung

title: Accounting Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Verantwortung übernehmen. Accounting weiterdenken.

Du möchtest nicht nur sicherstellen, dass die Buchhaltung zuverlässig läuft, sondern auch aktiv daran mitwirken, wie sie künftig noch effizienter gestaltet werden kann?

Wir sind ein wachsendes Unternehmen im ambulanten Gesundheitsbereich. In den vergangenen Jahren haben wir unsere kaufmännischen Prozesse bereits deutlich digitalisiert, neue Systeme eingeführt und zahlreiche Abläufe optimiert.

Und wir sind noch lange nicht am Ziel.

Unser Unternehmen wächst kontinuierlich – und mit ihm die Anforderungen an unsere Buchhaltung. Unser Ziel : Prozesse so aufzustellen, dass neue Gesellschaften und steigende Umsätze nicht automatisch zu einem proportionalen Anstieg des manuellen Aufwands führen.

Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der Accounting fachlich sicher beherrscht und zugleich den Blick nach vorne richtet. Jemanden, der Verantwortung übernimmt, Prozesse hinterfragt und gemeinsam mit uns an Lösungen arbeitet, die mit unserem Wachstum Schritt halten.

Aufgaben

Was du bei uns verantwortest

  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für das Accounting mehrerer Gesellschaften und sorgst dafür, dass die Buchhaltung im Tagesgeschäft sauber läuft.
  • Du verantwortest Monatsabschlüsse und UStVA sowie gemeinsam mit unseren Steuerberatern die Vorbereitung der Jahresabschlüsse.
  • Auch unser Forderungsmanagement gehört zu deinem Verantwortungsbereich.
  • Du führst unser zweiköpfiges Accounting-Team und entwickelst die Zusammenarbeit und Aufgabenverteilung im Team weiter.
