title: Strategic Account Manager
description: Localisation : Lyon, France    Rémunération : 50-75 k€ + BSPCE (Stock Options)       À propos de nous   Chez Wavo, nous construisons le futur du financement de stocks. Pour les PME, le stock est à la fois une opportunité et une contrainte. Il immobilise de la trésorerie, freine la croissance et crée du risque. Les solutions de financement traditionnelles sont lentes, rigides et basées sur l’historique financier plutôt que sur le potentiel business en temps réel.  Nous adoptons une approche différente. Wavo achète et finance les stocks en amont, sans dette ni garantie personnelle. Les entreprises peuvent ainsi accélérer leur croissance, améliorer leur trésorerie et se concentrer sur leur développement, sans friction financière.  Nous avons levé 3,5M€ pour accélérer notre expansion et déployer notre modèle auprès de plus d’entreprises. Nous sommes soutenus par des investisseurs et des leaders du secteur qui nous donnent les moyens d’aller vite. Notre objectif est clair : devenir la référence du financement de stocks intégré en Europe.  Dans ce contexte, nous recrutons un Strategic Account Manager, pour accompagner nos clients de bout en bout et jouer un rôle central dans l’exécution et la qualité de notre modèle.      Ce que tu feras   En tant que Strategic Account Manager chez Wavo, tu prendras en charge la relation client dans la durée, depuis les premiers échanges jusqu’au suivi des financements dans le temps. Il s’agit d’un rôle central, au croisement du commercial, de l’analyse et de l’opérationnel.     Tu interviendras en amont sur la qualification des prospects, principalement issus de l’inbound. À travers des échanges structurés, tu chercheras à comprendre le business des entreprises, la nature de leurs produits, leur modèle économique et leur capacité à s’inscrire dans notre solution. Ton rôle sera d’évaluer si Wavo est pertinent pour eux, et dans quelles conditions.     Lorsque le dossier avance, tu travailleras sur l’analyse des données mises à disposition par le prospect afin de définir un périmètre finançable cohérent. Cela implique de comprendre la typologie des produits, leur rotation, leur valorisation et leur liquidité, afin de proposer un financement adapté et maîtrisé. Ce volet analytique est central dans le poste : il conditionne la qualité des décisions et la performance du modèle dans la durée.     Tu piloteras ensuite toute la phase d’onboarding et de contractualisation, en lien avec les équipes internes, jusqu’à la mise en place effective du financement. Une fois le financement activé, tu assureras un suivi régulier des clients : monitoring des ventes, ajustements éventuels du périmètre financé, anticipation des prochaines étapes et identification d’opportunités de refinancement.     Au quotidien, tu seras en contact avec des entreprises très différentes, issues de secteurs variés, avec des business models et des contraintes propres. You are a team player, sharing your ideas and help to develop the team and by doing so, contributing making PLM Group a great place to work       Apply for the role, we would love to hear from you! description: En Coface, cada día, nuestros equipos facilitan las transacciones comerciales. Fomentamos una cultura de aprendizaje, colaboración e inclusión en la que asumirás responsabilidades y podrás ver el impacto de tus acciones. title: Account Management Team Lead
description: WHO WE ARE      Adikteev is an AdTech company that helps mobile app publishers grow their revenue through targeted advertising. We deliver personalized ads that drive users to install an app or re-engage with one they've stopped using.     Our clients are mostly mobile gaming leaders but also span e-commerce, on-demand services, and entertainment apps. Recognized for 10+ years as one of the top mobile retargeting platforms, Adikteev now operates globally from Paris, San Francisco, Barcelona and Seoul and has grown to over 120 employees.  Beyond the business, Adikteev is consistently recognized as a great place to work. With an 22-nationality team, a 4.5-day work week, and a strong focus on inclusion, Adikteev is a place where people genuinely stay.      WHAT TEAM YOU’LL BE PART OF      You'll join the Account Management team, operating under the leadership of Antoine, Chief Customer Officer, and coordinated by regional team leads. The team is present globally across EMEA, the US, and APAC, serving some of the world's top mobile app publishers.     In short, Account Managers are the strategic partners of Adikteev's clients. You would own the relationship end-to-end: from onboarding a new client, to making sure their campaigns are live and hitting performance targets, to presenting QBRs and identifying growth opportunities. Day-to-day, this means coordinating closely with the Campaign Management team on performance and optimizations and with Sales on account expansion.     This is a player-coach role: you will lead and grow the APAC AM team while also directly owning a portfolio of strategic clients.      WHAT YOU WILL DO      As Account Management Lead for APAC, you’ll help build and scale one of Adikteev’s highest-potential regions, shaping the team, the client relationships, and the operating model behind our APAC growth. Concretely, this means:       Own and grow a portfolio of strategic clients:     Act as the region’s retargeting & user-acquisition expert and the trusted strategic advisor to your clients;  Own a portfolio of key accounts end-to-end — from onboarding, to hitting performance targets, to QBRs and long-term growth planning;  Identify and lead upsell and expansion opportunities, partnering with Sales on advanced deals;  Turn account insights into clear, actionable feedback for our Product and BI teams;  Set the standard for onboarding, delivery, and client engagement across the team, and share best practices on working with different app developers.        Build and lead the APAC Account Management team:     Lead, coach, and grow a team of two account managers, with a mandate to scale the region over time;  Own your team’s development, career growth, welfare, and retention;  Be the strategic point of escalation for your team and their clients;  Build and continuously refine the operational processes that allow APAC to scale;  Recruit new account managers and build their training and ramp-up plan. title: HEAD OF CUSTOMER SUCCESS
description: À propos   L'ambition.  Fabriq fait rayonner l'industrie européenne en rendant l'usine plus compétitive et l'ouvrier plus autonome. Au-delà du logiciel, l'entreprise construit le projet de société de la relocalisation industrielle.   L'activité.  Fabriq est l'Operating System des ateliers de production. Sa plateforme SaaS digitalise les rituels de Lean Daily Management (AIC, SQCDP, QRQC, Hoshin Kanri, Gemba) pour résoudre les problèmes terrain 3 fois plus vite que le papier ou Excel. Devenu le leader européen de la digitalisation du Lean, Fabriq construit aujourd'hui la couche agentique de cette discipline.   Les preuves.     26 M€ levés au total, dont 22 M€ en juin 2025 menés par Expedition Capital.  Plus de 1000 sites équipés dans 60 pays, pour des leaders comme Safran, Airbus, Renault et LVMH.  Une équipe de 110 personnes qui joue collectif.    Descriptif du poste   Contexte :  Tu rejoins Thibaud (VP Customer) pour prendre la tête d'une équipe CS d'une dizaine de personnes, sur un portefeuille qui bascule du mid-market vers l'enterprise multi-sites et international.   L'Objectif :  Sécuriser le GRR (Gross Revenue Retention) et maintenir le churn sous 5 % sur le portefeuille enterprise, tout en industrialisant le CS.   Les Enjeux     Industrialiser le CS enterprise : Construire et déployer les playbooks d'adoption et de rétention, les cadences QBR, le health scoring et le capacity planning, en semaines et non en quarters.  Hisser les grands comptes au standard enterprise : Installer une discipline solide sur des clients multi-sites et internationaux, où la relation ne peut plus reposer sur un seul sponsor.  Faire progresser l'équipe : Amener le collectif vers le standard enterprise et faire grandir chaque CS, en coachant par l'exemple sur 1-2 comptes stratégiques.  Créer les conditions d'expansion : Démontrer la valeur au niveau ComEx et détecter les signaux d'upsell, en relais avec l'équipe AM.    Profil recherché   Les OBLIGATOIRES     Expérience : 6 à 10 ans en CS B2B SaaS, dont au moins 3 ans de management d'équipe CS.  Enterprise : 3 à 5 ans d'exposition à des comptes enterprise multi-sites dans un contexte de land & expand.  Track-record : Réduction de churn ou amélioration de GRR démontrée, chiffres à l'appui.  Structuration : A construit des playbooks d'adoption et de rétention from scratch, pas hérités.  Posture : Attrait fort pour la mission et le monde industriel. Envie d’aller se confronter au terrain, pas peur de se déplacer.  Langues : Français et anglais courants.     Les "PLUS" (optionnels) :     Usage avancé de l'IA dans les workflows CS.  Passage en scale-up en forte croissance ayant vécu une phase de structuration.  Appétence pour l'expansion et l'upsell.    Process de recrutement    Un premier échange avec Edouard, Talent Acquisition.  Un entretien avec Thibaud, VP Customer.  Un business case à traiter avec François, Co-founder et Thibaud.  Une étape culturelle et de fit avec François et Victoria (VP People).

title: VP of Customer Success

You'll own net revenue retention across renewals, expansion, training, and customer marketing for a global customer base, with a direct line into shaping the product itself.  We're a 125-person EdTech scale-up powering learning in 140+ countries, helping students and teachers thrive through an intelligent platform that combines rich, interactive pedagogy with smart AI and data.   Why join Kognity?     Work on problems that matter – Your work directly influences the lives of teachers and students in over 140 countries. The scale is global, and the outcomes are tangible. A fast-moving, high-performing team – You will work with smart, driven colleagues across the globe on complex problems. Standards and expectations are high, feedback is direct, and the pace is fast.  Continuous growth is the baseline – Everyone is expected and supported to learn quickly, improve constantly and raise their own bar. If you enjoy responsibility, momentum and meaningful challenge, you will thrive here. Advise the leadership team on Customer Success strategy and forecasts alongside the CRO, and lead cross-team collaboration with Sales, Marketing, Product, Content and Enablement     What We're Looking For     Proven track record of growing net revenue retention through renewals and upsell strategies in a SaaS business  Strategic thinking beyond Account Management, with clear prioritisation in a complex environment and strong judgement in ambiguity  Ability to lead and inspire with confidence for maximum revenue outcomes, and to build capability in others  Ability to effectively identify problems with impact on NRR within and outside the CS team, and develop and implement appropriate solution sets  Executive-level communication and cross-functional influence, with the ability to work closely with senior stakeholders across the business     How We Hire     Discovery call with a Recruiter  Hiring manager discussion  Case study  Values discussion  Leadership talk  References    Every qualified person will be evaluated regardless of age, gender, identity, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status or religion. title: Servicechef – Brandlarm och säkerhet
description: Consilium Safety Group är en global ledare inom brand- och gassäkerhetsteknologi med över 100 års erfarenhet. Våra innovativa lösningar skyddar liv, tillgångar och miljö inom marin-, energi-, fastighets- och New Energy-sektorerna. Med huvudkontor i Göteborg och över 55 kontor världen över utvecklar vi morgondagens Safety-Tech genom innovation, kvalitet och teknisk expertis.  Consilium Safety Sweden är koncernens marknads- och försäljningsbolag och erbjuder avancerade brand- och säkerhetssystem – från enskilda komponenter till kompletta integrerade säkerhetslösningar. Vi ansvarar för hela kedjan; projektering, försäljning, installation, driftsättning, service och underhåll. Våra system skyddar människor och verksamheter i allt från skolor och vårdinrättningar till industrier, kontor och andra samhällsviktiga fastigheter.   Vill du leda och utveckla en serviceorganisation där teknik, kundrelationer och engagerade medarbetare står i centrum?   Vi söker nu en  Servicechef till vår verksamhet i Malmö.  Du får en central roll i att leda och utveckla vår serviceavdelning, som består av cirka 20 medarbetare.  Vi är ett företag som utvecklar och säljer lösningar inom brandlarm och säkerhet, och vår serviceverksamhet är en viktig del av vårt erbjudande. Nu söker vi dig som vill ta ett helhetsansvar för verksamheten och samtidigt vara en närvarande och engagerad ledare för våra medarbetare.   Om rollen   Som Servicechef har du det övergripande ansvaret för vår serviceavdelning och dess fortsatta utveckling. Du arbetar både strategiskt och operativt och blir en viktig länk mellan våra kunder, tekniker och företagets övriga organisation.   Ditt Ansvar Omfattar Bland Annat     Personalansvar för cirka 20 medarbetare.  Ansvar för avdelningens ekonomi, budget och resultat.  Planering och uppföljning av serviceverksamheten.  Kundansvar och utveckling av långsiktiga kundrelationer.  Säkerställa hög kvalitet och god service i våra uppdrag.  Arbetsmiljöansvar och ett aktivt arbete för en säker och trivsam arbetsplats.  Leda, coacha och utveckla medarbetarna i deras dagliga arbete.  Utveckla arbetssätt och rutiner för en effektiv och lönsam serviceorganisation.  Uppföljning av serviceprojekt, serviceavtal, arbetstider och resursplanering.  Samverkan med andra delar av organisationen för att skapa en bra helhet för våra kunder.    Du kommer att ha ett nära samarbete med både ledning, kunder och våra tekniker. Rollen innebär därför många kontaktytor och kräver att du trivs med att växla mellan strategiska frågor och den dagliga verksamheten.   Vem söker vi?   Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av serviceledning, gärna från brandlarm, säkerhet, el, installation, fastighetsteknik eller annan teknisk verksamhet.  Du behöver inte kunna allt från början. Det viktigaste är att du har teknisk förståelse, ledarerfarenhet och ett genuint intresse för att utveckla både människor och verksamhet.   Vi Ser Gärna Att Du Har     Erfarenhet av personal- och verksamhetsansvar.

title: Head of Platform Customer Operations (w/m/d)
description: Wer wir sind   Als führende Schweizer E-Commerce-Plattform, mit einem Team von über 4’000 Mitarbeitenden in der Schweiz, Deutschland und Serbien, sind wir auf dem Weg in neue Märkte. Unser Motor dafür ist der Wille, Bestehendes immer wieder neu zu denken. Deshalb suchen wir Menschen, die mit Leidenschaft daran arbeiten, Dinge wirklich besser zu machen. Bei uns findest du die Freiheit und das Vertrauen, eigenverantwortlich zu handeln, mit uns zu wachsen und dabei ganz du selbst zu sein.  Handle galaktisch. Und bleib du . title: Executive Director, Investor Relations
description: Position Overview   A leading organization is seeking a senior investor-relations executive to oversee strategic investor engagement, relationship management, service excellence, and retention. The ideal profile is a highly credible corporate-banking leader with deep knowledge of the local market and a strong network across major corporates, financial institutions, family offices, and public-sector stakeholders.      Key Responsibilities    Lead investor relationship, engagement, retention, and service-excellence strategies.  Act as the senior relationship owner and escalation point for strategic investors and key accounts.  Build trusted relationships with investors, banking partners, major corporates, family offices, and institutional stakeholders.  Coordinate across internal functions to resolve investor requirements efficiently and improve the overall investor experience.  Use investor feedback and relationship intelligence to identify service improvements and growth opportunities.  Establish account-governance, satisfaction, retention, and escalation mechanisms.  Represent the organization at investor meetings, executive forums, and stakeholder engagements.  Lead, coach, and develop relationship-management and investor-service teams. Extensive experience managing large corporate or institutional relationships.  Strong local network and credibility with CEOs, CFOs, business owners, family offices, and senior decision-makers.  Client-centric leadership style with a record of improving service quality, retention, and relationship depth.       Experience and Qualifications    Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field; an advanced degree is preferred.  Typically 15+ years of banking, corporate-relationship, institutional-coverage, or investor-management experience.  Proven leadership of teams responsible for major client portfolios or strategic relationships.  Executive presence, sound judgement, and excellent Arabic and English communication skills are preferred.

title: Training And Quality Manager
description: Role Description   This is a full-time, on-site Training and Quality Manager role based at Wooden Coffee in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.  The role is responsible for designing, delivering, and continuously updating training programs for baristas, supervisors, and support staff, while ensuring consistent service standards and product quality across all locations.  Day-to-day responsibilities include assessing training needs, developing training materials and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), leading workshops and on-the-job coaching, and monitoring employee performance against defined quality standards and KPIs.  The Training and Quality Manager will conduct regular store audits, review customer feedback, and collaborate with Operations leadership to implement process improvements and corrective actions.  The role will also be responsible for maintaining training records, preparing reports on training effectiveness and quality trends, and supporting new store openings and onboarding initiatives to ensure teams are aligned with Wooden Coffee’s brand standards, safety requirements, and hygiene practices.         Qualifications    Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Hospitality Management, Education, or a related field is preferred.  Minimum of 3 years of experience in the Food & Beverage (F&B) sector, preferably within the coffee or café industry.  Experience in developing, delivering, and evaluating training programs, ideally within hospitality, retail, or food and beverage environments.  Strong background in quality assurance, including developing standards, conducting audits, and implementing continuous improvement initiatives.  Proficient in preparing training content, manuals, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), with the ability to facilitate workshops and coach team members at different levels.  Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to motivate employees, provide constructive feedback, and build strong cross-functional relationships.  Strong organizational and time-management skills, with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple training and quality projects simultaneously.  Familiarity with health, safety, food hygiene, and operational standards relevant to coffee shops and food service operations.  Ability to analyze performance data and customer feedback to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for improvement, and recommend practical, data-informed solutions.  Ability to work on-site in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with flexibility to visit different branches and support new store openings as needed.  Prior experience in a supervisory or managerial role within a coffee shop, café, or restaurant environment is highly beneficial.  Relevant professional certifications in training, quality management, or related fields are considered an advantage.

title: Solutions & Project Delivery Manager — BFSI
description: Solutions & Project Delivery Manager — BFSI       Turn customer needs into solutions that work.   At Orlig, we believe every successful transformation begins with listening—listening to customers, operations, data and the people delivering the service.     We are looking for an experienced  Solutions & Project Delivery Manager  who can work with banks, insurers and other financial institutions from the first discovery conversation through to successful implementation.     This is a hybrid role combining  presales solutioning, business analysis and project management . You will not simply hand a proposal to another team after the deal is signed. You will remain responsible for ensuring that what we understand, propose and promise can be successfully delivered.      What You Will Do       Presales and Solutioning    Conduct discovery workshops with Customer Service, Contact Centre, Complaint Management, Operations, Compliance, Risk and IT teams.  Listen to customers and uncover the operational issues behind their stated requirements.  Translate business, operational and regulatory requirements into practical Orlig solution designs.  Prepare solution proposals, presentations, process flows, scope documents, implementation plans and effort estimates.  Deliver product demonstrations based on relevant BFSI use cases.  Coordinate responses for RFPs, RFIs and other tender exercises.  Work with Orlig’s product and technical teams to assess solution feasibility.  Clearly explain what can be delivered through standard product capabilities, configuration, integration or customisation.  Identify assumptions, dependencies and potential delivery risks before commitments are made.       Project Management and Delivery    Manage projects from kick-off through requirements, configuration, development, integration, testing, training, go-live and handover. Rust Engineer

At Deepslate, we are building Speech to Speech Voice AI models that sound and act indistinguishably from a human. And we believe everyone should be able to use them.

That is exactly why we started Deepslate.

We are building the future of communication.

We aren't trying to build another standalone platform; instead, we are the intelligence engine powering countless other applications. Whether it's integrated as a module by a CRM provider, plugged into another Voice AI platform, or directly embedded into an enterprise system by our integration partners, our model is built to work wherever it is needed.

Many core parts of our model stack are written in Rust. At the heart of it is our inference engine, written entirely in Rust.

Your mission is to build and improve these systems. You will work on the inference engine, take ownership of other Rust projects, and help decide how everything fits together. We need someone who enjoys writing good Rust code and can design software that stays understandable and maintainable as it grows.

Our models need to respond in real time. The software you build will directly influence how fast and reliable they are in an actual conversation.

description:
About Kestra

Kestra is the universal orchestration platform: open source, declarative, and designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, and AI/agentic systems.

Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide, including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, and Crédit Agricole, Kestra orchestrates mission-critical workloads at scale. The open-source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars, hundreds of contributors, and a fast-growing global community.

About the role

Kestra runs arbitrary, user-defined code at scale. Our users write workflows that execute scripts, containers, and queries against their own production systems, through hundreds of community-built plugins, on a platform whose entire source code is public. That is an unusually rich attack surface, and securing it is a genuinely hard engineering problem rather than a checklist exercise.
You would be our first dedicated security hire. We're looking for a Senior Security Engineer to own and elevate the end-to-end security posture of our platform, infrastructure, and open-source ecosystem.
This is a unique, hybrid role for someone who excels at both sides of security: actively breaking systems to find vulnerabilities (hands-on penetration testing) and actively fixing them (opening PRs, patching infrastructure, and managing supply chain risks). If you want to build a world-class security foundation for a fast-growing open-source and SaaS platform, this role is for you.
This is a hands-on engineering role, not a GRC or compliance one.

What you would do

Your first six months would focus on the first three points below. The rest is where the role grows.

title: Customer Evidence Manager
description:
Role Description

Dropbox is hiring a Customer Evidence Manager to own and drive the customer-proof infrastructure that powers our managed sales motion. This is a senior individual-contributor role for a commercially minded, creatively grounded customer marketer who understands that the value of a customer story is not that it gets published — it is that it protects customer trust, gives buyers credible, accurate proof and moves a deal forward. You are the editorial authority on what good looks like, not the person writing every script: execution (writing, video, design) is delivered through agency partners you brief and direct.

Enterprise buyers do not decide on brand claims. They decide on credible proof from organizations like theirs: customer stories, ROI evidence, video testimonials, peer reviews, and competitive validation. In this role, you will produce that evidence and ensure it reaches sellers and customers at the moments it can have the greatest commercial impact.

You will own the program outcomes and operational rigor — setting the creative and editorial bar for what makes a great customer story, directing the agency partners who produce the work, and deploying that proof into active deals — and measuring evidence's impact on pipeline, win rates, and sales-cycle velocity. You will partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Campaign Enablement, and product teams to prioritize proof for the full suite of Dropbox products and solutions, including AI capabilities, multi-product platform adoption, and priority vertical workflows. You will get substantial senior Sales and Marketing leadership exposure and a direct, measurable line to revenue during a pivotal shift in how Dropbox goes to market.

Responsibilities

  • Identify advocates, coordinate outreach with account teams, manage consent and approvals, record participation preferences, and avoid customer fatigue.
  • Set the creative and editorial direction and maintain the evidence taxonomy, freshness, and discoverability of the asset library — case studies, ROI studies, video testimonials, peer/G2 reviews, customer voice, and competitive proof.
  • Manage the sales content library (Highspot, Deeto, or comparable) — organize assets by deal stage, customer profile, vertical, and product; set and enforce freshness standards; and proactively surface content gaps.
  • Run a recurring Sales–Marketing feedback session to understand seller needs, assess content performance in live deals, and prioritize new evidence.
  • Ensure the right proof reaches the right seller for the right deal stage proactively, and track evidence utilization by account executive and deal stage to close adoption gaps.
  • Partner with Marketing Operations to build campaign attribution and reporting in Salesforce, measuring evidence's influence on pipeline, win rate, and sales-cycle velocity.
  • Provide monthly reporting to Sales and Marketing

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Role Description

As a Customer Success Manager at Dropbox, you will own the post-sale relationship for a portfolio of customers, with a focus on helping them realize measurable value from their investment while driving product adoption, retention, and Net Revenue Retention (NRR).

You will serve as a trusted advisor throughout the customer journey, developing a deep understanding of your customers’ business priorities, desired outcomes, stakeholders, and evolving needs. You will use customer insights, product adoption signals, stakeholder relationships, and demonstrated business value to proactively identify opportunities, address risks, and strengthen the customer’s long-term relationship with Dropbox.

You will partner closely with Sales and cross-functional teams to align on customer strategy, navigate more complex commercial situations, identify growth opportunities, and deliver successful customer outcomes.

The successful candidate is results-driven, customer-focused, and comfortable navigating complex customer organizations. They bring strong Customer Success fundamentals along with demonstrated experience influencing or owning renewals, mitigating customer risk, and delivering measurable retention outcomes in a B2B SaaS environment.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain strong relationships across customer organizations, serving as a trusted advisor to business leaders, executive sponsors, administrators, and other key stakeholders throughout their journey with Dropbox.
  • Own a portfolio of customers and proactively manage customer health, adoption, value realization, stakeholder engagement, renewal readiness, and retention risk.
  • Develop and execute Mutual Success Plans that connect Dropbox solutions to customer priorities, desired outcomes, and measurable business value.
  • Own customer renewals across your portfolio, including developing renewal strategies, assessing renewal likelihood, identifying and mitigating risks, leading customer renewal conversations, coordinating cross-functional actions, and driving each renewal to an outcome.
  • Lead strategic customer engagements, including Success Business Reviews and value conversations, that demonstrate outcomes, uncover changing business needs, strengthen stakeholder alignment, and reinforce the customer’s case for continued investment.
  • Partner closely with Account Management/Sales and cross-functional teams to develop and execute account strategies that support customer retention, successful renewals, and appropriate growth opportunities.
  • Use product usage, customer sentiment, business context, stakeholder engagement, and other customer signals to prioritize actions across your book of business and proactively address accounts requiring intervention.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in B2B SaaS Customer Success, Account Management, or a comparable post-sale cus

title: Associate Director of Bioinformatics (Women's Health and Organ Health)
description:
Natera is seeking an Associate Director to lead a team of Bioinformatics Scientists in our Women's Health and Organ Health research organization. You will oversee the scientific planning and execution of research and assay-development of diagnostic projects, and you will be responsible for creating production-ready pipeline components. You will manage your team and its professional growth, the research strategy behind new product development, and the handoff of research work into production.

The role calls for deep experience in algorithm and assay development, NGS data processing across multiple modalities, and the full life cycle of diagnostic product research and development in a regulated (CLIA) setting. You will evaluate new technologies and NGS assays, implement methods to optimize performance, and help define the product profile from a bioinformatics perspective, with input from R&D, Product, and Laboratory Directors.

Primary Responsibilities:

Team Leadership and Development: Lead and mentor a team of Bioinformatics Scientists. Own their professional growth, their responsibilities, and the standard the team holds itself to.

Research Strategy: Own the research strategy behind new product development, from scoping through execution, working with cross-functional stakeholders on what the team takes on and in what order.

Assay Science: Lead bioinformatics analysis for assay development and optimization, and troubleshoot experiments alongside laboratory scientists. This spans multi-omic approaches including methylation and fragmentomics and other cell-free DNA (cfDNA) derived features. It also spans short-read and long-read sequencing and both hybrid-capture and amplicon target enrichment.

Study Design and Data Quality: Partner with laboratory teams on study design at the research and feasibility stage, covering new technology assessment, optimization, and performance determination. Make sure the resulting data holds up before anyone builds on it.

Analysis Method Improvement: Advise and prototype improvements to analysis pipelines, including variant detection, quality control, and modality-specific processing: methylation calling, fragment-size and end-motif analysis, error suppression for deep targeted panels, and structural-variant calling.

Production Readiness and Handoff: Move research prototypes into stable production workflows. Hold the team to software engineering practice, including version control, testing, continuous integration and delivery, and containerization. Automate the routine parts of research data management, pipeline execution, and reporting so the team's time goes to science.

title: Strategic Client Manager
description:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

Our largest fleet clients are hugely important to Flock: they have more vehicles, more data and more opportunity to benefit from everything our connected proposition can offer, and we want to give them an even better experience as we grow. We’re looking for a Strategic Client Manager to become the primary face of Flock for our largest customers, owning the relationship and making sure they get the very best from us.

Nearly all of our business comes through brokers, and that remains central to how we work: you’ll sit at the heart of the client, broker and Flock relationship, working closely with our Broker Development Managers and teams across the business to deliver a brilliant joined-up service. You’ll report to our Head of Distribution, and use AI day to day to prepare for meetings, understand accounts, manage client queries and improve reporting, freeing up more time for relationships and problem-solving.

title: AI scientist for Quantum Computing (Massy)
description:
About Quandela:

Quandela is a European deeptech company building modular, scalable and energy-efficient spin-photonic quantum computers.

We develop the full quantum computing stack, from semiconductor quantum emitters and photonic processors to control systems, software and applications. Our platforms are available through the cloud and as on-premises systems.

Our ambition is to build fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of solving problems beyond the reach of classical computation.

The role:

We are looking for an AI Scientist to join Quandela’s AI and Quantum Machine Learning team in Massy (near Paris)

You will develop and evaluate machine-learning approaches for quantum computing, covering both:

  • AI for quantum systems, including calibration, control, decoding for quantum error correction;
  • quantum and hybrid machine learning, including rigorous comparisons with state-of-the-art classical methods, using MerLin, Quandela's framework for quantum machine learning.

You will work on research with colleagues across AI, quantum algorithms, software, product and hardware.

The Massy team is a central part of Quandela’s AI activities. This role therefore offers significant ownership and the opportunity to help shape and grow the team over time.

What You'll Do:

  • Design, implement and train machine-learning and quantum machine-learning models.
  • Develop AI methods to improve the calibration, control and performance of quantum systems.
  • Benchmark classical, quantum and hybrid methods using meaningful baselines and evaluation metrics.
  • Contribute actively to the development of the MerLin framework.
  • Contribute to publications and collaborations with academic partners, including research ecosystem.

description:
At DemoUp Cliplister, we’re not just about content creation; we’re revolutionizing how over 3,000 brands and retailers like MediaMarkt, Otto, Fnac, Microsoft, Logitech, and Bosch bring their products to life with innovative solutions like video, augmented reality, and user-generated content.   • You have a proven track record of overachievement and hitting sales targets.

title: Head of Finance & Data (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Zahlen sind deine Leidenschaft, und du willst die Datenbasis dahinter nicht nur nutzen, sondern selbst gestalten? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Als Head of Finance & Data (m/w/d) bist du das strategische und technische Fundament für unser weiteres Wachstum.

In dieser vielseitigen Doppelrolle verbindest du messerscharfe Zahlenkompetenz mit einem echten Gespür für Datenarchitektur und Reporting-Infrastruktur. Du baust nicht nur ein stabiles Controlling auf, sondern gestaltest parallel die technische Grundlage, auf der unser gesamtes Unternehmen datenbasierte Entscheidungen trifft. Kurz: Du hältst uns den Rücken frei und lenkst aktiv unseren Erfolgskurs mit.

  • Strukturen schaffen: Du baust belastbare Controlling-Strukturen und Reportings mit einer klaren, zukunftsorientierten Steuerungslogik auf.

  • Data-Infrastruktur gestalten: Du treibst den Aufbau unserer automatisierten Datenpipelines voran (u. a. BigQuery, angebunden an Shopify, Klaviyo und weitere Quellen) und sorgst dafür, dass Kennzahlen zuverlässig, aktuell und zentral verfügbar sind.
  • BI & Controlling verzahnen: Du entwickelst unsere Dashboards und Reporting-Tools (z. B. Looker Studio) so weiter, dass Finance-Kennzahlen und operative Daten in einem konsistenten Bild zusammenlaufen.
  • Prozesse skalieren: Du etablierst effiziente, smarte Prozesse im Finance- und Data-Bereich, die mit uns mitwachsen.
  • Sparring auf Augenhöhe: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem CEO zusammen und berätst ihn als geschätzter Sparringspartnerin in allen strategischen Finanz- und Datenfragen.


Das steckt in deiner Haut

title: AI Growth Marketer (m/w/d) - remote
description:
Deine Rolle

Wir sind ein kleines, agiles Marketing-Team. Jede und jeder übernimmt hier Ownership, entwickelt eigene Strategien und setzt sie selbst um. Seit wir konsequent mit AI arbeiten, sehen wir deutlich mehr Chancen zu wachsen, als wir bisher angehen können. Deshalb holen wir jemanden dazu, der sich alles übergreifend ansieht, die größten Hebel erkennt und sie selbst in die Hand nimmt.
Du verantwortest Growth-Projekte end-to-end, auf bestehenden Kanälen und auf neuen, die Du selbst findest. Du baust selbst, stellst selbst live in der App, im App Store oder auf der Website, und wertest die Daten danach aus. Die Wege sind kurz, der komplette Projektzyklus liegt bei Dir.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Chancen in unseren Produkten finden. Du gehst regelmäßig durch Website, App Stores, Content, Jobboards und den Funnel bis Premium und findest die Stellen mit dem größten Hebel für Registrierungen und Umsatz.
  • Chancen im Markt erkennen. Du schaust genauso nach außen: Welche Trends und Plattformen bewegen unsere Zielgruppe gerade, welche Segmente oder Märkte lohnen einen Einstieg, welche Wachstumskanäle sollten wir aktivieren, die wir heute nicht nutzen, und was machen Wettbewerber.
  • Chancen bewerten und priorisieren. Du schätzt vorher ab, was realistisch drin ist und was es bringt, und bringst eine Shortlist ins Team. 
  • Selbst bauen und selbst live stellen. Du baust Landing Pages, Tests und Kampagnenbausteine mit AI und veröffentlichst sie selbst. Kein Ticket bei Engineering, kein Warten auf Design, keine Warteschlange. 
  • Testen und messen. Du setzt A/B-Tests auf der Website, in den App Stores und auf unseren weiteren Plattformen auf, wertest sie sauber aus und iterierst. 
  • App Store Optimisation. Du testest Screenshots, Icon, Titel und Beschreibungen laufend weiter.

title: Business Development Representative

About League

Getting healthcare is often the easy part — finishing it is where things fall apart: people book the appointment and skip the follow-up, fill the prescription and stop taking it, get the referral and never make the call. That gap costs health plans and health systems money, and it costs people their health. League closes that gap — identifying what each person needs to do next, clearing what’s in their way, and getting it done, for the 70 million+ people whose care already runs through our platform. Health plans and health systems trust us to do this at scale. Organizations like Manulife, SCAN, Geisinger, and Medibank on the payer side, and Baptist and Shoppers Drug Mart on the provider side.

League is an AI-first company and this role is built that way. Your central mandate is to run League's go-to-market system with rigor, and to make it better from the inside.

Outreach and pipeline creation

title: Software Engineer - Simulation Platform
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Shape the future of Proxima’s simulation platform: imagine and build with us

Deine Mission

Das Produkt steht. Jetzt entscheidet sich, wie wir darüber sprechen.

Das ist kein Callcenter-Job. Keine Kaltakquise, keine gekaufte Liste, keine Quote pro Stunde.
Du kontaktierst Betriebe, die uns bereits kennen. Installationspartner, mit denen wir seit Monaten oder Jahren arbeiten. Sie wissen, wer Bees & Bears ist — sie wissen nur noch nicht, was wir gerade Neues für sie gebaut haben.

Warum es diese Stelle gibt: Wir bringen ein neues Produkt an den Start, das unseren Partnerbetrieben einen konkreten Engpass löst. Technisch ist es fertig. Was jetzt zählt, ist die Einführung — und die passiert nicht über eine Mail. Sie passiert in Gesprächen.

Deine Aufgabe: Diese Gespräche führen. Du bekommst eine Einarbeitung und einen Gesprächsleitfaden. Nach acht Wochen sollte auch dieser Leitfaden noch besser sein, weil du hundert Gespräche geführt hast. Wer nur die Liste abarbeiten will, ist hier falsch. Wer wartet, bis jemand den nächsten Schritt vorgibt, auch.

Wohin die Rolle wächst: Sie startet fokussiert: ein Produkt, ein definierter Partnerkreis, ein Gespräch nach dem anderen. Sie ist aber nicht als Telefonjob angelegt, sondern als Einstieg ins Partner Management — eigene Partner, Ende zu Ende, von Erstkontakt bis laufender Betreuung. Wie schnell das geht, hängt an dir, nicht an einem Kalender.

  • ANRUFEN, NICHT ABTELEFONIEREN: Du stellst das neue Produkt bei Bestandspartnern vor. Nicht Skript vom Blatt, sondern ein Gespräch, das beim Gegenüber ankommt.
  • DEN PITCH WEITERENTWICKELN: Du merkst, welcher Einstieg funktioniert und welcher Einwand immer wieder kommt. Du behältst das nicht für dich, du änderst den Leitfaden.

title: Finance & AI Automation Intern (Remote Part-time)
description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. The category is growing rapidly because AI doesn't work on bad data. Behind the product sits a group of three companies in two currencies, and a small finance team that keeps all of it correct. We're hiring a Finance & AI Automation Intern to run core finance processes and automate the manual work out of them.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

The Role

You'll join the Finance team that covers Soda Data NV (Belgium), Soda Data Inc. (US) and NannyML NV, the Belgian company we acquired in 2025. The work is real from week one: invoice processing, month-end reporting, payroll data preparation, expense management, and intercompany recharges across three entities, two currencies and three accounting systems.

The second half of the job is making that work disappear. Finance at Soda builds agentically: Claude and other AI tools are part of the daily workflow, not an experiment on the side. You'll learn a process, run it until you know it cold, and then automate it. Sometimes that means an AI agent on GitHub, sometimes a well-designed formula - you pick the right tool and defend the choice.

description:
About Genesis AI

Genesis AI builds the simulation platform powering the next generation of robotics and embodied AI. Our flagship product, Genesis World, is a unified multi-physics simulation engine paired with Nyx, our in-house GPU-accelerated, path-traced photorealistic renderer. Together they provide a platform for training robotics and embodied AI at scale; letting teams simulate complex physical worlds with high fidelity and speed, from a laptop to datacenter-grade GPUs, and close the gap between simulation and the real world.

About the Role

A simulator is only as useful as the content that runs inside it. Training embodied agents at scale means large volumes of assets that are simultaneously physically valid and visually convincing and that is a pipeline problem before it is an art problem.

We're hiring a Senior Engineer to build the path from raw input to sim-ready asset: geometry from a range of sources going in; clean meshes, correct collision proxies, plausible physical properties, materials that hold up under a path tracer, and reliable metadata coming out.

The bar is throughput and repeatability. An asset that needs a human pass to be usable doesn't scale, so the pipeline has to make good decisions on its own and flag the cases where it can't.

Part of that autonomy comes from agents embedded in the graph itself. Nodes can call models to produce input content, drive generation, pick parameters, interpret a mesh before deciding how to treat it, or judge whether a result is acceptable. Making that reliable is its own engineering problem: agents are non-deterministic, they fail in ways a mesh operator doesn't, and they need guardrails, structured outputs, retries and verification around them. description:
About the role

We're looking for an IT Manager to own the day-to-day IT that keeps the company running smoothly and securely as we grow. This covers our people's devices, the office network, the tools everyone uses, and the support they rely on. It's a hands-on role for someone who enjoys solving practical problems and making everyday IT work well, reporting into the CIO and based in London.

You'll operate the controls and standards that the security team sets, and you'll be the person who makes them real in day-to-day work.

title: Data Annotator
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a Data Annotator within the Visual Navigation team, you work at the foundation of how our autonomous systems interpret their environment. You review large volumes of image datasets and apply precise, consistent annotations that directly feed the training and validation of our computer vision and machine learning models. You collaborate closely with our Computer Vision, Data Architecture, and Machine Learning teams to ensure the data you deliver meets the rigor required for real-world deployment.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze, label, and annotate diverse image datasets to support the training and validation of our AI models.

  • Follow detailed annotation guidelines precisely, maintaining consistency across large batches of work.

  • Review AI model outputs for accuracy and contextual relevance, flagging discrepancies against expected results.

  • Perform annotation peer-review with other members of the Annotation team to ensure consistency and quality.

description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As Automated Testing Module Lead, you take ownership of how Harmattan validates its autonomy and flight-software stack. Today, our software is validated mostly against real hardware, a process that consumes airframes, range time, and crew while sampling only a handful of nominal trajectories. The cases we actually build for, such as degraded GNSS, sensor dropout, electronic warfare, and multi-agent situations, are rarely reached economically that way. Your mission is to establish the scenario library, execution strategy, and interface bricks to turn our existing simulation platform into a fast, reliable, and continuous validation engine.

This is a senior, hands-on technical leadership role. You inherit an active team of four engineers across Paris and Lausanne, with a target of around eight by mid-2027. Beyond leading the team, you become the technical authority on our scenario-based testing: defining what runs across SITL, HITL, and CI, holding critical technical boundaries with adjacent teams, and bridging the gap between simulation fidelity and real flight data.

description:
We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Aircraft Painter to join our aviation maintenance team. In this role, you will be responsible for preparing and painting aircraft surfaces to meet high industry standards. As an Aircraft Painter, you will work on a variety of aircraft types, ensuring the external appearance and protective coating of the aircraft meet both aesthetic and regulatory standards. Your expertise in surface preparation, painting, and finishing will be crucial in ensuring aircraft are ready for operation and maintain their durability in various conditions.

  • Prepare aircraft surfaces for painting by cleaning, masking, and sanding areas to remove old paint or contaminants.

  • Follow precise instructions and blueprints to create custom designs, logos, or lettering on aircraft.

  • Repair and touch up paintwork as necessary, ensuring aircraft meet regulatory and aesthetic standards.
  • Maintain and clean painting equipment and tools, ensuring they are in proper working order.

title: STAGE - ASSISTANT(E) VISUAL DESIGN CREATION (H/F) - NOVEMBRE 2026 (6 MOIS)
description:
LA MAISON
 
Jacquemus a été fondé par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l’art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l’appartement parisien d’Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d’ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street) et Dubai.
 
Pour accompagner la forte croissance de la Maison, nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) Assistant(e) en VISUAL DESIGN CREAT

title: Cdi - Knitwear Designer - Menswear & Womenswear
description:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS

Jacquemus was founded by Simon Porte Jacquemus in 2009 in Paris, France.

Dedicated to the memory of the designer’s late mother, the brand draws inspiration from a passion for culture. The Jacquemus ready-to-wear and accessories collections for men and women reference the French way of life and universal gestures of beauty, encompassing influences from fine art photography to decorative arts, cinema, painting, and sculpture.

Throughout the years, Jacquemus has staged runway productions in unique and unexpected locations, including a Parisian swimming pool, the Musée Picasso, a lavender field in Provence, a wheat field outside Paris, a salt marsh in the Camargue, and a beach in Hawaii. More recently, the brand has embraced settings such as the canal of the Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), the Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), Casa Malaparte (La Casa) and Auguste Perret’s Parisian apartment (La Croisière).

Based in the 8th arrondissement of Paris, Jacquemus is an independent fashion house with over 300 employees. Renowned for its fast-growing digital presence and its worldwide business spread, the brand has created innovative retail experiences around the world before opening its first permanent flagship store at 58 Avenue Montaigne in Paris in 2022. LA MAISON JACQUEMUS

Jacquemus a été fondé par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Lead customer journey planning and identify opportunities to improve acquisition, engagement, retention and lifetime value.    Own and evolve the Crusaders membership programme, including the proposition, benefits, pricing, fulfilment and member experience.    Support and deliver Matatū membership and ticketing initiatives.    Establish customer service standards and ensure a connected experience across ticketing, memberships, hospitality, merchandise and match day.    Oversee customer lifecycle communications supporting acquisition, engagement and retention.    Lead customer database strategy, governance, segmentation, insights and reporting.    Maintain hands-on involvement with Ticketmaster, Archtics, Account Manager and associated customer systems.    Lead and develop the Ticketing and Memberships Lead, while providing oversight of seasonal customer service resources.    Build strong relationships across the organisation and with external partners, including Ticketmaster and Venues Ōtautahi.     About You    You may currently work in customer experience, memberships, loyalty, ticketing, fan engagement or another customer-led environment.   You will bring:    Experience leading customer, membership, loyalty, fan engagement or customer experience programmes.   Experience growing customer acquisition, engagement and retention.   Experience using CRM systems and customer databases.   An understanding of customer journeys, segmentation and customer experience principles.   Strong planning, organisation and project management skills.   Confidence using data and customer insights to inform decisions.   Experience leading and developing people.   Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.   The ability to balance excel

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Fast ansettelse  By  Buskerud,Drammen  Søknadsfrist  2026-10-04  Søk på stillingen   Customer Success Manager   Våre kunder investerer betydelige ressurser i teknologi og digitale tjenester for å skape bedre, mer effektive og mer bærekraftige tjenester. Samtidig blir leveransene stadig mer komplekse, med mange aktører, fagmiljøer og avhengigheter.  Vi søker en Customer Success Manager som kan skape helhet, struktur og fremdrift, og sikre at kundenes mål omsettes til dokumenterte resultater.  Du får ansvar for å følge kundene gjennom avtaleperioden og bidra til at de oppnår ønsket verdi av løsningene og tjenestene vi leverer. Rollen kombinerer strategisk rådgivning med operativ oppfølging, og du samarbeider tett med kunden, våre partnere og fagmiljøene i Atea.  Rollen innebærer reiseaktivitet til kunder i regionen.   Dette får du ansvar for   Som Customer Success Manager får du et helhetlig ansvar for å sikre at kundene lykkes med investeringene de har gjort i teknologi og digitale tjenester.   Du Vil Blant Annet:     Etablere og følge opp kundesuksessplaner som sikrer gevinstrealisering, måloppnåelse og kontinuerlig forbedring ved å identifisere risiko og muligheter.   Sørge for at teknologi tas i bruk og skaper ønsket effekt.   Bygge sterke relasjoner og være en strategisk rådgiver for kunden gjennom hele avtaleperioden.   Koordinere fag- og leveransemiljøer i Atea og hos våre partnere for å sikre helhetlige leveranser, høy kvalitet og etterlevelse av avtalte forpliktelser.      Hvem tror vi vil lykkes hos oss?   Vi tror du vil trives i rollen hvis du liker å skape oversikt, få mennesker med ulik kompetanse til å trekke i samme retning og omsette planer til konkrete resultater.  Du er trygg i dialog med ledere, fagpersoner og operative brukergrupper. Du bygger tillit, arbeider strukturert og skaper fremdrift uten nødvendigvis å ha formelt personal- eller linjeansvar.  Du forstår også sammenhengen mellom kundeverdi, leveransekvalitet og lønnsomhet. Når noe ikke går som planlagt, tar du initiativ til å finne årsaken, involvere de riktige personene og følge opp tiltakene. Har du erfaring med å skape verdi for kunder i komplekse miljøer, har du et godt utgangspunkt for å lykkes. title: Responsable des Opérations de Services (F/H)
description: Notre client évolue dans le secteur de l'Ingénierie et développe des solutions technologiques à forte valeur ajoutée destinées à des entreprises innovantes présentes à l'international.  Le/la Responsable des Opérations de Services assure la coordination des opérations de service et veille à la qualité des prestations délivrées aux client·e·s. Ce rôle stratégique contribue à l'efficacité opérationnelle, à la satisfaction client et à la performance globale.    Superviser les opérations de service et garantir le bon traitement des demandes et réclamations.  Organiser et piloter les activités des équipes de service réparties sur plusieurs zones géographiques.  Répartir la charge de travail et accompagner la planification opérationnelle.  Définir et déployer les programmes de formation et de montée en compétences.  Suivre les indicateurs clés de performance (SLA, délais de résolution, satisfaction client, qualité de service, utilisation des ressources).  Produire les reportings et contribuer aux revues de performance.  Identifier les axes d'amélioration continue et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives nécessaires.  Analyser les incidents récurrents afin d'améliorer les processus et l'expérience client.  Collaborer avec les équipes techniques, commerciales et de direction sur les sujets transverses.  Contribuer à l'identification d'opportunités de développement de services auprès des client·e·s.  Prévoir 30% de déplacements majoritairement en zone EMEA    Indemnités Grands Déplacements  ,    Notre client recherche un·e professionnel·le disposant d'une solide expertise en gestion des opérations de service, support technique ou service après-vente dans un environnement technique et en management d'équipe.  La maîtrise des indicateurs de performance, de la gestion des escalades et des outils de ticketing ou CRM est attendue.  La pratique professionnelle de l'anglais est requise.  Connaissance des domaines de CEM (compatibilité électromagnétique), tests RF ou environnements de haute technologie similaires appréciée.  Prévoir 30% de déplacements majoritairement en zone EMEA    ,   Michael Page  est un cabinet de recrutement spécialisé depuis plus de 40 ans dans le recrutement en CDI, en intérim, en management de transition, ainsi que du recrutement de dirigeants et des recrutements volumiques, en France et à l'international.   Notre mission :  aider les entreprises à trouver les talents qui contribueront à leur succès et accompagner les candidats dans la réalisation de leurs ambitions professionnelles, dans une grande diversité de métiers et de secteurs d'activité

title: SALES & CUSTOMER SUPPORT SPECIALIST
description: Divisione BLOK DPI | CRAI S.p.A.      Una divisione in crescita. Molte delle più importanti realtà industriali del Paese già al nostro fianco. E una squadra che vuole crescere ancora.   BLOK è la divisione DPI di  CRAI S.p.A.  dedicata alla protezione dell’udito professionale.  Stiamo crescendo velocemente e oggi lavoriamo con  molte delle più importanti realtà industriali italiane , seguendo progetti che ci portano ogni giorno a confrontarci con aziende, stabilimenti e professionisti in tutta Italia.  Per continuare a crescere vogliamo inserire una nuova persona nel nostro team.   Cerchiamo una persona organizzata, proattiva, con attitudine commerciale e voglia di fare. Qualcuno a cui piaccia lavorare con i clienti, trovare soluzioni e far avanzare le attività.      COSA FARAI CON NOI     Entrerai nel cuore operativo e commerciale della divisione BLOK.  Sarai uno dei punti di contatto tra  cliente, commerciali, tecnici e azienda , accompagnando il cliente nelle diverse fasi del rapporto con noi.     Ti occuperai di:   gestire un portafoglio clienti B2B, comprese aziende strutturate e  Key Client ;  mantenere un contatto diretto e continuativo con i clienti;  effettuare  telefonate e videoconference  di supporto al cliente, sviluppo commerciale e assistenza nelle attività;  svolgere prime call esplorative con clienti e potenziali clienti;  preparare offerte commerciali e preventivi;  seguire le opportunità commerciali e supportarne lo sviluppo;  organizzare appuntamenti e coordinare le visite dei nostri commerciali e tecnici presso le sedi dei clienti;  supportare il cliente nell’organizzazione e nella gestione delle attività programmate;  coordinarti con i diversi reparti CRAI per dare risposte rapide e concrete;  seguire il cliente anche nella fase di  post-vendita , mantenendo e sviluppando la relazione;  individuare nuove necessità e possibili opportunità commerciali;  partecipare a  trasferte, incontri ed eventi . Una telefonata con un cliente, un’offerta da preparare, una videoconference, un appuntamento da organizzare, un tecnico da coordinare, una nuova opportunità da seguire o una richiesta da risolvere.  È un ruolo per chi  ama l’operatività, il contatto con le persone e vedere concretamente avanzare il proprio lavoro. title: USM Strategic Programs Manager
description: Job Description:    Are you a strategic thinker with a passion for aviation and an understanding of Used Serviceable Material (USM)? title: Bliv Kundedirektør i Private Banking Syddanmark og stå i spidsen for et vigtigt vækstområde
location: Odense, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
description: Vil du stå i spidsen for et ambitiøst Private Banking-team og være med til at udvikle et af Nykredits vigtigste vækstområder? Som Kundedirektør i Syddanmark får du ansvaret for at drive udviklingen af både medarbejdere, kunderelationer og forretning i et område med stort potentiale.   Du bliver en del af et strategisk vigtigt vækstområde i Nykredit, hvor du får ansvaret for at lede og udvikle et dygtigt team af Private Bankere. Sammen arbejder vi for at levere den bedste rådgivning og skabe de bedste kundeoplevelser.  Vi søger dig, der ikke kun har evnerne, men også interessen for at opbygge og vedligeholde relationer, så vi i fællesskab skaber et godt samarbejde og gode relationer, både i teamet og på tværs i organisationen.   Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver bliver at:     sikre, at strategien bliver omsat til konkrete handlinger i teamet  fremme medarbejdertilfredsheden, hvor samarbejde og personlig såvel som faglig udvikling er i fokus  være med til at sikre, at Private Banking er forankret i sunde værdier og faglig ekspertise  skabe et engageret team, der arbejder målrettet på at optimere kundeoplevelserne  formidle tryghed og tillid, så både kunder og kolleger oplever dig som en tillidsskabende og troværdig leder.       Er det dig, vi leder efter?   Vi søger dig, som er motiveret, resultatorienteret og har en solid faglig og relevant baggrund.  Din praktiske erfaring med at yde kvalificeret rådgivning til formuende kunder kombineret med din ambition om at tage kundeoplevelsen til næste niveau er vigtigt for os.  Du har et godt analytisk blik og en struktureret tilgang, og med dine kommunikative evner og din oprigtige nysgerrighed er du i stand til at identificere dine medarbejderes færdigheder og bidrage til deres udvikling.  Med din handleevne, medmenneskelighed og engagement skaber du resultater, der forandrer, nytænker og forbedrer vores relationer til kunderne, samtidig med at du bidrager til at realisere vores fælles mål om at skabe værdi, overblik og tryghed for vores kunder.  Til gengæld lover vi både udvikling og muligheder til dig, der vil og kan.   Dit nye team   Du bliver en del af et team bestående af 21 Private Bankere, fire formuerådgivere samt et team af investeringsrådgivere. Vi samarbejder bredt med kolleger i Nykredit, herunder både med Lokalbanker, International og Private Banking Elite.  Hos os betyder godt humør, højt aktivitetsniveau og gode resultater meget, og du skal være indstillet på en afvekslende hverdag, hvor du sjældent sidder på den samme plads to dage i træk.  Vi har en frisk og uformel omgangstone - og lægger vægt på et positivt mindset.  Du har primært base i Odense, men får også mulighed for at arbejde fra forskellige lokationer i Regionalbank Syddanmark gennem vores lokalbanker.   Vil du vide mere?   Du er velkommen til at kontakte mig, Direktør Private Banking, Bjarne Claussen, på mobil 25 27 03 76 eller mail BCL@nykredit.dk, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen. description: Job Description   Job Location: Elancourt  Working Model: Hybrid  Training Manager Market Area Southern Europe   TRAINING MANAGER MARKET AREA SOUTHERN EUROPE    (France, Italy, Spain)    Are you passionate about developing people, improving ways of working, and building impactful training programs that support business success?  We are looking for a Training Manager for the Market Area Southern Europe to design, implement, and continuously improve training and onboarding across the region within internal organization and dealer network. This position is located in Elancourt, France.   About The Role   In this regional role, you will work closely with departments and stakeholders to identify training needs, develop practical learning solutions, and support managers in implementing and following up on training activities.  You will play an important part in ensuring that employees have the knowledge, tools, and capabilities needed to succeed in their roles, while helping strengthen onboarding, training quality, and consistent working methods across the region.  The role suits a confident, energetic communicator who is comfortable delivering training sessions personally, facilitating groups, engaging with new people, and influencing stakeholders through collaboration, urgency, and initiative.   Your Key Responsibilities     Collaborate with departments and stakeholders to identify training needs and ensure alignment with company objectives.  Design and develop training programs for new hires and ongoing competence development.  Build and maintain a sustainable onboarding program.  Analyse existing work processes and contribute to the development of improved working methods.  Evaluate the effectiveness of training programs and drive continuous improvement.  Work closely with other Training Managers across Europe to share ideas, align ways of working, and benefit from a strong peer network.  Support managers with implementation, follow-up, and practical application of training activities.  Support train-the-trainer activities by helping trainers become more effective in their roles.  Deliver and facilitate training sessions personally, ensuring an engaging, practical, and business-relevant learning experience.  Contribute as a member of the Market Area Southern Europe management team, bringing a training and capability development perspective to business priorities.  Act as the point of contact for external training providers.     What We Are Looking For     A bachelor’s degree and a minimum of five years of relevant professional experience are required, preferably in areas such as Consultative Sales, Sales Training, Learning & Development, or related commercial functions.   Candidates should demonstrate a strong understanding of sales methodologies, adult learning principles (pedagogy and work science), and the ability to design, facilitate, and deliver impactful training programs that support business objectives and drive effectiveness. About us

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an entrepreneurial Expansion Manager to focus on market expansion and build and scale Distribusion’s airport transfer operator network across Europe. This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants to build a business within a company. Working within Distribusion’s broader airport commercial strategy, you will own a clearly defined sub-segment end to end - from identifying attractive markets and securing operator partnerships to launching them and delivering measurable commercial growth.
You will have the opportunity to build the approach from scratch, deliver highly visible results and take on broader responsibility as the segment scales.


What you will do

  • Translate the broader airport strategy into a prioritised expansion plan, based on market potential, coverage gaps and clear business cases

  • Build a repeatable market-entry playbook, incorporating market feedback and lessons from execution

Otovo ist ein führendes Unternehmen im Bereich erneuerbarer Energien, spezialisiert auf die Installation von Photovoltaik-Anlagen für Privathaushalte. Gegründet 2016 in Norwegen, sind wir heute in mehreren europäischen Ländern aktiv und seit 2021 auch in Deutschland tätig. Unser Ziel: Solarenergie für alle zugänglich, kosteneffizient und unkompliziert zu machen.

Otovo wurde gegründet, um ein einfaches, aber wichtiges Problem zu lösen: Hausenergiesysteme zuverlässig und sorgenfrei zu gestalten. Unser Team legt Wert auf Sicherheit, technische Exzellenz und exzellenten Kundenservice. Wir glauben, dass verlässliche Energie keine komplizierten Prozesse erfordern sollte.

Dafür bieten wir unseren Kunden einen Rundum-Service – von der Installation bis zur regelmäßigen Wartung – und sorgen dafür, dass Probleme schnell und effizient gelöst werden.

Deine Aufgaben

title: Founder Associate (gn) @ AI Venture, Berlin
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

AI is being built into more products every month, and every interaction consumes tokens. As usage grows, the costs add up quickly. The first race was adoption. The next one is efficiency, because inference costs increasingly decide what companies can afford to build and ship. We are building the efficiency layer for production AI. Our systems make AI dramatically leaner, cutting token usage and lowering the cost of every interaction without giving up the quality standards that matter. We work with enterprise software companies, and we want to become a core part of the global AI ecosystem.

About the Role

You will work directly with our founder and CEO on whatever matters most that week. A lot of it is commercial: working out who needs us, getting into conversations with them, understanding what they run and what it costs them. The rest is everything else that needs doing when a company is this young. We closed our pre-seed in 3 weeks and are now preparing our first customer pilots, so there is a lot of ground to cover and very few people to cover it. This is a rare seat for someone early in their career / you will see how a company gets built and you will build a good part of it yourself.

title: CENTRALE LYON - PhD Silicon Photonics for Scalable Energy-Efficient AI Hardware Accelerators
description:
The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) applications across cloud and edge environments is driving the need for highly efficient hardware capable of supporting increasingly demanding workloads. Among these, matrix multiplication – particularly General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) – remains the dominant computational kernel in modern AI models, including deep neural networks and transformer architectures. Conventional electronic accelerators, while highly optimized, face growing challenges related to energy consumption, data movement, and scalability.

Silicon photonics has emerged as a promising technology to address these limitations by enabling highbandwidth, low-latency, and potentially energy-efficient computation through optical signal processing. In particular, recent advances in photonic computing leveraging phase-change materials (PCM) offer new opportunities for implementing reconfigurable and non-volatile computational primitives directly in the optical domain.

This PhD is part of the CAMELIA program (ASIC and Numérique agencies) within the targeted project LEAF, and aims to explore a hybrid photonic–electronic computing paradigm for AI acceleration. The central objective is to design and evaluate silicon photonics-based architectures for efficient GEMM operations, building on recent work demonstrating a reconfigurable photonic GEMM architecture based on PCM and stochastic computing.

The proposed research will focus on extending this tile-based photonic GEMM approach toward large-scale matrix operations under realistic conditions. Key challenges include managing PCM-related constraints such as limited precision and quantization effects, mitigating noise and variability, and addressing interface latency between photonic and electronic domains.

  • Provide regulatory guidance and training to cross-functional teams.
