title: Finance & AI Automation Intern (Remote Part-time)
description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. The category is growing rapidly because AI doesn't work on bad data. Behind the product sits a group of three companies in two currencies, and a small finance team that keeps all of it correct. We're hiring a Finance & AI Automation Intern to run core finance processes and automate the manual work out of them.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

The Role

You'll join the Finance team that covers Soda Data NV (Belgium), Soda Data Inc. (US) and NannyML NV, the Belgian company we acquired in 2025. The work is real from week one: invoice processing, month-end reporting, payroll data preparation, expense management, and intercompany recharges across three entities, two currencies and three accounting systems.

The second half of the job is making that work disappear. Finance at Soda builds agentically: Claude and other AI tools are part of the daily workflow, not an experiment on the side. You'll learn a process, run it until you know it cold, and then automate it. Sometimes that means an AI agent on GitHub, sometimes a well-designed formula - you pick the right tool and defend the choice.

Als Azure Infrastructure Engineer verantwortest du hauptsächlich den Aufbau, Betrieb und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Microsoft-Cloud-Infrastruktur. Du stellst eine stabile, sichere und hochverfügbare Azure-Plattform bereit und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem IT-Team die zukünftige Cloud-Architektur des Unternehmens weiter. title: Area VP Sales, EMEA West
description:
At Semperis, our mission is to be a Force for Good. Starting with being a great place to work. We believe that when people feel valued, supported, and empowered, they do their best work. That’s why we focus on creating an employee experience rooted in purpose, growth, and balance. Semperis has been recognized as one of America’s Fastest-Growing Cybersecurity Companies by the Inc. 5000, a DUNS 100 Top Startup to Work For, and a multi-year Inc. Best Workplace awardee.

Semperis is looking for an Area Vice President of Sales to lead our EMEA West business and help shape the next phase of growth across France, Spain, Portugal, Italy, and Benelux.

Reporting to the VP of Sales, EMEA, you will lead and develop a team of Enterprise Sales Directors responsible for growing Semperis across their respective territories. This is a hands-on regional leadership role with direct influence on net-new ARR, team performance, customer outcomes, and market presence.

Semperis operates in one of the most important areas of enterprise cybersecurity: protecting the identity systems organisations depend on to operate and recover. We are looking for a leader who can help enterprise customers understand the business value of identity security and resilience, while building the team and operating discipline needed to capture the opportunity across EMEA West.

What you will do

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Enterprise Sales Directors to deliver net-new ARR against regional goals

  • Recruit, attract, and retain high-calibre enterprise sales talent as the organisation scales

  • Establish a clear operating rhythm across pipeline generation, deal inspection, forecasting, QBRs, performance reviews, and regional planning

  • Own the annual regional sales plan and build a disciplined pipeline engine that balances activity, opportunity quality, conversion, and coverage

  • Embed a consistent, methodology-led sales process using MEDDPICC or equivalent approaches; coach the team on qualification, territory planning, account strategy, value selling, and deal execution

description: Job Description    About Us   Headquartered in Singapore, SATS Ltd. is one of the world’s largest providers of air cargo handling services and Asia’s leading airline caterer. SATS Gateway Services provides airfreight and ground handling services including passenger services, ramp and baggage handling, aviation security services, aircraft cleaning and aviation laundry. description: Unternehmen : Vaillant GmbH  Standort : Dietikon-CHE  Land : Schweiz (CH)  Marke : Vaillant   Vertragstyp : Unbefristet  Arbeitszeit : Teilzeit / Vollzeit  Kurzbeschreibung  In deiner Funktion verantwortest du den Innendienst an unserem Hauptsitz in Dietikon und führst dabei ein Team von 10 Mitarbeitenden. Dabei berichtest du direkt an den Leiter Verkauf, Marketing und Innendienst.   Was wir gemeinsam bewegen     Als Führungskraft mit Weitblick schaffst du ein Umfeld, in dem Zusammenarbeit und Eigeninitiative gefördert werden.  Mit deinem Gespür für Kundenbedürfnisse sorgst du für eine serviceorientierte und effiziente Abwicklung im Innendienst, von der Offerte bis zur Fakturierung sowie der Disponierung unserer Kundendiensttechniker  Du unterstützt deine Mitarbeitenden bei komplexen Kundenanliegen und sorgst für eine lösungsorientierte Betreuung unserer Kundschaft.  Als verbindende Persönlichkeit bringst du Vertrieb, Service, Logistik und weitere Schnittstellen effizient zusammen, um eine hohe Kundenzufriedenheit sicherzustellen.  Mit einem wachen Auge für Optimierungen treibst du Prozessverbesserungen sowie Digitalisierungsprojekte aktiv voran.  Du übernimmst Verantwortung, setzt strategische und operative Ziele konsequent um und entwickelst deinen Bereich nachhaltig weiter.  Dank deiner betriebswirtschaftlichen Kenntnisse behältst du Kennzahlen, Budgets und Reportings im Blick und leitest daraus zielführende Massnahmen ab.     Was uns gemeinsam erfolgreich macht     Dein Fundament ist eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Grundausbildung mit Weiterbildung im Bereich Betriebswirtschaft, Verkauf oder Führung, die dir das nötige Rüstzeug für diese anspruchsvolle Rolle mitgibt.  Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung im Innendienst oder in einer vergleichbaren Funktion, idealerweise in der Haustechnikbranche oder einem verwandten Umfeld, macht dich zur gefragten Fachperson.  Mit MS Office arbeitest du sicher, und auch ERP-/CRM-Systeme nutzt du souverän – idealerweise SAP und/oder Salesforce.  Du denkst unternehmerisch, erkennst Zusammenhänge und bringst neue Impulse ein.  Deine ausgeprägte Serviceorientierung und Kommunikationsstärke helfen dir überzeugend aufzutreten.  Belastbarkeit, Flexibilität und eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise gehören zu deinen Stärken.  Stilsicheres Deutsch bringst du mit und gute Englischkenntnisse setzen wir voraus und Französischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil. Die Mehrsprachigkeit ermöglicht dir eine souveräne Kommunikation in unserem dynamischen Umfeld.     Worauf Sie zählen können   Wir alle verbringen viel Zeit auf Arbeit und dein persönliches Wohlbefinden liegt uns am Herzen. Daher bieten wir dir:    Ein stabiles, zukunftsorientiertes Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs mit langfristiger Perspektive.  Ein motiviertes Team in einem familiären Umfeld, das Herausforderungen gemeinsam meistert und für eine positive Arbeitsatmosphäre sorgt.  Raum für Eigengestaltung und die aktive Mitgestaltung deiner Aufgaben und Prozes

title: Product Manager - Marketplace
description:
Supabase is the open-source Postgres development platform that 7M+ developers and thousands of enterprises depend on every day. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Product Manager, Marketplace to join our Product Team to lead our marketplace and integration surfaces.

The marketplace is the two-sided surface of the Supabase ecosystem. On one side, Partners and developers build integrations on top of Supabase primitives like Auth, Storage, and Edge Functions, then publish them for the world to use. On the other, our developers come to discover new capabilities and wire them into their projects without leaving their workflow. Done well, it is the shortest path between a developer with a problem and the exact capability that solves it.

That surface is about to matter more than ever. As the number of capabilities explodes, and as agents begin to assemble software on a developer's behalf, the marketplace becomes the distribution and discovery layer for the whole ecosystem: how both developers and, increasingly, their agents find, trust, and compose what they need. This role owns it.

What you'll be responsible for:

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for the marketplace, the two-sided surface where Partners and developers publish integrations and where Supabase's developer customers discover and install them.

  • Make it effortless for a developer to find the right capability and integrate it. Own discovery, search, listings, and the whole path from install to working integration, so a new capability connects to Supabase primitives and runs inside a developer's project with minimal glue code.

  • Make publishing an integration fast and rewarding, so Partners and developers bring their best work to the marketplace and keep it current, and so the catalog stays deep where developers need it.

  • Set the quality bar and the listing standards, and build the review, guardrail, and versioning mechanisms, with Engineering and our Partnerships team, that keep the catalog trustworthy as it scales.

  • Own what a healthy marketplace looks like: define the metrics across both supply and demand, instrument the surface end to end, and let the signal rather than opinion drive what gets built next.

  • Position the marketplace as the distribution layer for agent-driven development, where capabilities get discovered and composed on a builder's behalf rather than browsed and installed by hand.

title: Graphene Device Physics Modeling Expert (f/m/d)
description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

 

The Role

We are looking for a Graphene Device Physics Modeling Expert, to develop and refine physics based models for graphene photonic devices. Working at the intersection of research and software development you will translate state-of-the-art research into reliable simulation capabilities that support device design and development.

title: Produktentwickler (m/w/d) Frische
description:
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams an unserem Standort in Visbek suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Produktentwickler (m/w/d) Frische

Informationen über unseren Betrieb

In Visbek befindet sich das Herzstück der Plukon Food Group in Deutschland. Hier sind gleich drei wesentliche Bestandteile unserer Unternehmensgruppe ansässig: Die Plukon GmbH ist die deutsche Verwaltungszentrale von Plukon. Von hieraus steuern Management und Verwaltung die Geschäftsaktivitäten. Ebenfalls am niedersächsischen Standort angesiedelt ist die Plukon Visbek GmbH. Hier handelt es sich um einen Geflügel-Verarbeitungsbetrieb, der auf die Herstellung tiefgekühlter Convenience-Produkte spezialisiert ist. Last but not least hat auch die Plukon Agri GmbH in Visbek ihren Sitz. Plukon Agri ist als Partner unserer Landwirte für den Verkauf von Eintagsküken und den Einkauf von Schlachtgeflügel zuständig.

Deine Tätigkeiten: 

  • Entwicklung neuer Produkte von der Rohware bis zum Endprodukt

  • Bearbeitung / Erstellung von Musteranfragen / Mustern

  • Begleitung von Erstproduktionen und Linientests

  • Rezepturmanagement und Projektdokumentation

  • Organisation und Prüfung neuer Zutaten

  • Bearbeitung von Spezifikationen (Rohwaren, Endartikel)

  • Aktualisieren der bereits bestehenden Produktionsprozesse und -abläufe

  • Prozess- und Produktoptimierung im Rahmen von Neuentwicklungen

  • Deklarationsprüfung

  • Zusammenarbeit mit Laboren und Forschungseinrichtungen

title: Mitarbeiter in der Qualitätssicherung/Produktkontrolleure (m/w/d)
description:
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams an unserem Standort in Storkow suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Mitarbeiter in der Qualitätssicherung/Produktkontrolleure (m/w/d)

Informationen über unseren Betrieb

Unser Produktionsstandort in Storkow ist pulsierender Knotenpunkt unserer Tätigkeiten. Der Betrieb gilt als Musterbeispiel für eine innovative Geflügelproduktion. In Storkow vereinen sich Fachwissen und fortschrittliche Technologie, um tagtäglich eine Vielzahl frischer und hochwertiger Hähnchenprodukte herzustellen. Unsere Produkte liefern wir unter unseren eigenen Marken Friki, FairMast und Stolle an den Lebensmittelhandel in ganz Deutschland. Darüber hinaus produzieren wir einen großen Teil unserer Produkte für exklusive Marken unserer Handelspartner. 

Deine Tätigkeiten: 

  • Durchführung von Qualitätskontrollen entlang des gesamten Produktionsprozesses (Anlieferung, Schlachtung, Zerlegung, Verpackung)

    (HACCP, LMHV, VO (EG) 853/2004 etc.)

  • Durchführung von Hygienekontrollen und mikrobiologischen Schnelltests

  • Überprüfung von Prozessparametern und Produktmerkmalen (z. B. Temperatur, Sensorik etc.)

  • Erstellung und Pflege qualitätsrelevanter Dokumentationen und Prüfberichte

  • Meldung und Nachverfolgung von Abweichungen sowie Einleitung von Sofortmaßnahmen

  • Unterstützung bei Audits und Zertifizierungsmaßnahmen (IFS, QS, BIO, Tierschutzlabel)

  • Schulung und Sensibilisierung von Mitarbeitenden im Bereich Hygi

The company

It's still difficult for business owners to sell their business, or buy others, in the sub-£10m enterprise value market. Information asymmetry, lack of knowledge and low transaction values make it hard, and most M&A firms shy away from the segment because they can't serve it profitably. A generation of owner-managers is approaching retirement, and most of them have no realistic route to a sale.

manda exists to fix that. We match buyers with sellers in the part of the market everyone else ignores, and we finance acquisitions ourselves so buyers arrive pre-qualified and often pre-financed. We've sold the first businesses, funded the first acquisition loans, and we're now opening the platform up beyond the businesses that already bank with us.

manda is part of iwoca, one of Europe's leading fintech lenders. Since 2012 iwoca has provided more than £4 billion in funding and its mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments. That backing is why we can serve this market where others can't: a deep footprint in the SME economy with 150,000+ UK customers, the data and infrastructure of an established lender, and the ability to build clean, automated processes instead of running an advisory firm on spreadsheets.

We're looking for a Marketing Manager to own how business owners find manda, iwoca's M&A platform. You'll be our first marketing hire, joining as we open the platform to business owners who don't yet bank with iwoca. Almost everything about how we reach them is still to be decided, and you'll be the one deciding it.

title: CENTRALE LYON - Post Doctoral Open and Flexible System-Level Evaluation Framework for Emerging AI Computing Architectures
description:
Emerging computing technologies – non-volatile and ferroelectric memories, analog and digital in-memory computing, silicon photonics, 3D integration, and heterogeneous chiplets – offer major gains in energy efficiency, latency, bandwidth, and functionality. Their potential cannot, however, be established from device or circuit results alone: it requires a rigorous link between technology characteristics, architectural choices, workload mapping, and application-level figures of merit.

The Electronics group at the Lyon Institute of Nanotechnology (INL) is seeking a (m/f) postdoctoral researcher to develop an open, modular and extensible system-level evaluation framework for design space exploration (DSE) and system-design-technology co-optimization (SDTCO) of emerging computing architectures. The focus is at the interface of computer architecture, accelerator design, performance modelling and hardware-software codesign, while making systematic use of lower-level device, circuit and array results so that architectural conclusions remain physically credible.

The objective is to convert low-level results – compact models, measured or simulated KPIs, variability and reliability constraints, and multi-objective Pareto fronts – into parameterized architectural models supporting efficient exploration of accelerators for emerging AI workloads. The framework must enable both bottom-up projection, from device/circuit/array choices toward system performance, and top-down constraint propagation, from targets for energy, latency, throughput, accuracy, robustness and area toward technology and circuit requirements. It will consolidate ongoing INL activities in predictive system assessment, DTCO, emerging memories, compute-in-memory and photonic computing, integrating or extending existing components with emphasis on openness, reproducibility and reusability.

description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Kriya sits inside that story as Allica's platform for building new credit products. We already offer invoice finance to mid-market SMEs. We are now evaluating how best to launch unsecured lending products to SMEs, building on the well-known MarketFinance loans franchise, but backed by Allica's balance sheet, cost of funds, and 30,000+ SME customer base.

Role Description
Small businesses can't afford to wait around. When a cash flow gap or a growth opportunity appears, the SMEs we serve need funding that moves at the same speed they do, which is exactly the gap Kriya's unsecured lending products are built to fill.

We are looking for a Commercial Finance BDM to help drive new business across Kriya's unsecured, high-velocity SME lending products. This is an entrepreneurial, high-activity sales role: you'll build and manage your own pipeline of prospects, qualify fast, and take ownership of your numbers. Every conversation with a prospective customer is different, and how well you manage your own pipeline rather than any one big deal is what will make the difference to your results. You will also have Allica’s wider distribution network to make the most of.

The products:

  • Invoice Finance, Export lending, SME loans and working capital products

title: Junior Complaints & Compliance Specialist
description:
Complaints and Compliance Specialist

Location: Berlin (office first)

The team

The Complaints team sits within Operations and works every day to make sure merchants who run their businesses on SumUp get fair, fast, and compliant resolutions whenever something goes wrong with a payment. As payment volumes grow, so does the complexity of the cases the team handles, from delayed payouts to disputed chargebacks, and this role exists to build the specialist skills needed to resolve these cases with precision and care. Joining now means learning the mechanics of payment processing from the ground up, working closely with Risk, Engineering, and Finance, and helping shape how SumUp responds to some of its most sensitive merchant and regulatory moments.

What you'll do

  • Investigate and resolve merchant complaints tied to payment processing, including authorisations, settlements, payouts, and chargebacks
  • Dig into processor logs, payment gateways, and payout systems to find the root cause of each issue and document the findings clearly
  • Draft clear, compliant final responses to merchants that meet regulatory timelines and internal SLAs

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to own AI at one of the fastest-growing AI legal tech companies in Europe. Over 2,000 lawyers use JUPUS every day, and the AI behind it is already in production and already in front of customers. You'd own the team, the technical roadmap, and the standard everything gets built to.

Your Challenge and Opportunity in This Role

Legal work is document-heavy, judgement-heavy, and almost untouched by AI. We've trained on over a million German court rulings and handled over a million cases, so the hard part isn't proving AI belongs here. The hard part is doing it well enough that a lawyer will put their professional judgement behind the output.

title: Integrations Engineer (SDK)
description:
Voice is becoming the primary interface for technology. For the first time in history, we can use natural language to control and interact with our devices, services, and applications, and we're only at the beginning of the adoption of Voice and Physical AI across industries. Current voice interactions, however, still lack a fundamental human skill: nuanced understanding of audio scenes and environments. Navigating complex auditory scenes, distinguishing between multiple voices, or focusing on a main speaker are all part of the challenge of "teaching machines to hear like human beings."

At ai-coustics, we're building the audio intelligence layer and developer tooling to enable more robust and intelligent voice agents and Physical AI applications. Today, Voice AI companies like Perplexity, PolyAI, LiveKit, AssemblyAI or Telli use our SDK to prepare their agents for real-world acoustic challenges. Our models power thousands of agents worldwide and process millions of hours each month.

We are backed by leading early-stage investors including Connect Ventures, Partech, Inovia Capital, as well as angel investors from HuggingFace, DeepMind and Amazon with deep expertise in AI and developer infrastructure. These partners share our vision and are helping us build a world-class team operating with high levels of responsibility and velocity. We look for people who take ownership, think systemically, and want to solve challenging real-world problems in close collaboration with our customers.

Role overview

We're looking for an Integrations Engineer to make our SDK easy to adopt on the platforms voice agent developers actually build on. Our core SDK is native and ships with wrappers for Python, Node.js, C, C++, Rust and WebAssembly, plus plugins for LiveKit Agents and Pipecat. You will own the plugins and the public surface of the language wrappers, keep them released in lockstep with the core SDK and work with upstream open-sour

title: Praktikum Social Media, Content & Community bei Try It (m/w/d)
description:
100 % remote · Teilzeit möglich · Start nach Absprache

Die Jacke, die du ständig trägst. Das Secondhand-Teil, für das dir noch eine Kombination fehlt. Ein Blick in einen anderen Kleiderschrank – und plötzlich eine Idee für deinen eigenen.

Your wardrobe has more in it.

Ich bin Christopher, Gründer von Try It. Ich entwickle eine App, mit der du deine Kleidung erfassen, Outfits zusammenstellen und neue Möglichkeiten in deiner eigenen Garderobe entdecken kannst. Was du davon trägst, entscheidest du.

Jetzt suche ich jemanden, der Lust hat, Try It mit mir sichtbar zu machen und eine Community mit aufzubauen. Jemanden mit eigenen Ideen, einem Gespür für Mode und Menschen und Freude daran, selbst Inhalte zu gestalten – gerne auch vor der Kamera.

Vielleicht kennst du eine kleine Fashion-Community, deren Humor du sofort verstehst. Du kannst erklären, warum du bei bestimmten Creatorn hängen bleibst. Oder du hast schon selbst etwas veröffentlicht, das Menschen miteinander ins Gespräch gebracht hat.

Diese Perspektive möchte ich kennenlernen.

Ich bringe die App, die Geschichte dahinter und mich selbst ein. Du bringst deinen Blick mit. Ich möchte mit dir Ideen entwickeln, filmen, ausprobieren und herausfinden, was Menschen an Try It begeistert. Wenn du sagst: „Christopher, zeig das mal“ oder „Ich würde das anders erzählen“, bin ich dabei.

Aufgaben

Was du mitgestalten kannst

Deine Schwerpunkte vereinbare ich mit dir passend zu deinen Erfahrungen, deinen Lernzielen und deiner verfügbaren Zeit.

  • Eigene Inhalte entwickeln und umsetzen. Ein Lieblingsteil anders kombinieren, beim Zusammenlegen Kleidung aufnehmen oder zeigen, was tatsächlich im Reisekoffer landet: Du erkennst solche Momente und machst daraus Reels, TikToks oder Storys. Try It wird dabei in echter Nutzung sichtbar.
  • Vor und hinter der Kamera mitwirken.</

title: (Senior) DevOps Engineer - Infrastructure & Security (m/f/d)
description:
Du willst Infrastruktur nicht nur betreiben, sondern verantworten? Bei uns gehört dir der komplette Stack – vom Proxmox-Cluster im eigenen Rechenzentrum über Firewalls und VPNs bis zu AWS und den Deployment-Pipelines.

Testsieger ist eines der größten Vergleichsportale Deutschlands: 4,2 Millionen Produkte, Testberichte, Kundenbewertungen und ein integrierter Preisvergleich, der Millionen Nutzer zum richtigen Kauf führt. Ein 20-köpfiges Team mit direkten Wegen und ohne Konzern-Overhead.

Du übernimmst die Rolle des technischen Owners für unsere Infrastruktur – mit einem Team an deiner Seite, und einem Engineering-Team, das auf dich zählt.

Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest den Betrieb unserer Linux-Serverlandschaft: On-Premise-Cluster (Proxmox, ZFS) und AWS
  • Du betreibst und härtest Netzwerk und Security: Firewalls, VPN, Zugriffskontrolle, Zertifikate, Hardening – inklusive der Netzanbindung an unseren größten Partner
  • Du automatisierst mit Ansible und hältst Infrastruktur versioniert, reproduzierbar und dokumentiert
  • Du betreust unsere Container-Plattform (Docker, Nomad, Traefik) und die CI/CD-Pipelines (GitHub Actions), damit die Teams sicher und schnell shippen
  • Du administrierst MySQL in Produktion: Backups, Performance, Recovery
  • Du baust Monitoring, Logging und Alerting aus (Grafana, New Relic) und führst Incidents zur Ursache
  • Du bist Sparringspartner für Engineering, Data und Product – und erklärst, warum Dinge so gebaut sind, wie sie gebaut sind

Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Betrieb von Linux-Serverumgebungen (Debian/Ubuntu) – du weißt, wie man Systeme auch ohne Assistenz von A nach B bringt
  • Fundierte Netzwerkkenntnisse: TCP/IP, Routing, DNS, Load Balancing, Firewall- und VPN-Administration
  • Nachweisbare Praxis in Infrastructure Security: Hardening, Access Control, Security Best Practices
  • Ansible in Produktion, Container
